text: Ka Mošupulogo, boramahlale ba go tšwa Sekolong sa Yunibesithi ya Stanford sa tša maphelo ba tsebišitše ka go hlangwa ga sedirišwa se sefsa sa tekolo seo se ka beakanyago disele ka mehuta: chip yeo e gatišegago ye nnyane yeo e ka tšweletšwago ka go šomiša metšhene ya go gatiša ya inkjet ya sente ye tee ya U.S. ka o tee.
text_en: On Monday, scientists from the Stanford University School of Medicine announced the invention of a new diagnostic tool that can sort cells by type: a tiny printable chip that can be manufactured using standard inkjet printers for possibly about one U.S. cent each.

text: Banyakišiši ba ketapele ba re se se ka tliša temogo ya kankere, tuberculosis, HIV le malaria go balwetši kapela dinageng tša letseno la fase, moo ditekano tša go phela tša malwetši a bjalo ka kankere ya letswele di ka bago seripa sa tša dinaga tšeo di humilego.

text_en: The protest started around 11:00 local time (UTC+1) on Whitehall opposite the police-guarded entrance to Downing Street, the Prime Minister's official residence.

text: Ka bo 11:29, mogwanto o ile godimo go Whitehall, wa feta Trafalgar Square, kgauswi le Strand, wa feta Aldwych go ya godimo ka Kingsway go lebantša Holborn moo mokgatlo wa Conservative Party o be o swere Foramo ya bona ya Seruthwane hoteleng ya Grand Connaught Rooms.

text_en: Each show would also provide recommendations for books that children should look for when they went to their library.

text_en: John Grant, from WNED Buffalo (Reading Rainbow's home station) said "Reading Rainbow taught kids why to read,... the love of reading — [the show] encouraged kids to pick up a book and to read."

text: Ba bangwe ba dumela, go akaretša le John Grant, gore bobedi bja go phuhlama ga tša ditšhelete le šikinyego ka gare ga filosofi ya mananeo a telebišene a thuto di bile le seabe go feleng ga tatelano ya pontšo.
text_en: It is believed by some, including John Grant, that both the funding crunch and a shift in the philosophy of educational television programming contributed to ending the series.

text: Ledimo, la goba di maele tše e ka bago tše 645 (1040 km) bodikela bja dihlakahlaka tša Cape Verde, le ka hwelela pele le tšhošetša mafelo afe goba afe a naga, balebeleledi ba boso ba a bolea.
text_en: The storm, situated about 645 miles (1040 km) west of the Cape Verde islands, is likely to dissipate before threatening any land areas, forecasters say.

text: Gabjale Fred e na le memoya ya dimaele tše 105 ka iri (165 km/h) gomme e sepelela go ya leboabodikela.
text_en: Fred currently has winds of 105 miles per hour (165 km/h) and is moving towards the northwest.

text_en: Fred is the strongest tropical cyclone ever recorded so far south and east in the Atlantic since the advent of satellite imagery, and only the third major hurricane on record east of 35°W.

text_en: 250 years later, Guinness has grown to a global business that turns over 10 billion euros (US$14.7 billion) every year.

text: Jonny Reid, mothekga-mootledi wa sehlopha sa A1GP sa New Zealand, o dirile histori lehono ka go otlela ka lebelobelo a feta godimo ga Leporogo la Boemakepe la Auckland la mengwaga ye 48, go la New Zealand, ka semolao.
text_en: Jonny Reid, co-driver for the A1GP New Zealand team, today made history by driving the fastest over the 48-year-old Auckland Harbour Bridge, New Zealand, legally.

text: Mr Reid o kgonne go otlela sefatanaga sa A1GP sa New Zealand, Black Beauty ntsho ka lebelo la go feta 160km/h ga šupa go feta leporogo.
text_en: Mr Reid managed to drive the New Zealand's A1GP car, Black Beauty at speeds over 160km/h seven times over the bridge.

text: Maphodisa a New Zealand a bile le mathata ka go šomiša dithunya tša bona tša di speed radar go bona lebelo leo Mrn Reid a bego a le kitima ka lebaka la ka moo Black Beauty e lego fase ka gona, gomme nako fela yeo maphodisa a kgonnego go ngwala Mrn Reid e be e le ge a fokoletša lebelo go 160km/h.
text_en: The New Zealand police had trouble using their speed radar guns to see how fast Mr Reid was going because of how low Black Beauty is, and the only time the police managed to clock Mr Reid was when he slowed down to 160km/h.

text: Dikgweding tše 3 tša go feta, bagolegwa ba go feta 80 ba lokolotšwe go tšwa Sentareng ya Peelo ntle le go bonwa molato semmušo.
text_en: In the last 3 months, over 80 arrestees were released from the Central Booking facility without being formally charged.

text: Ka Aporele ngwageng wo, tokomane ya thibelo e ntšitšwe ke Moahlodi Glynn kgahlanong le lekala mabapi le go gapeletša go ntšwa ga bao ba swerwego diiri tša go feta 24 ka morago ga go tšeiwa ga bona bao ba sa hwetšago theeletšo ka mokomišina wa kgorotseko.
text_en: In April this year, a temporary restaining order was issued by Judge Glynn against the facility to enforce the release of those held more than 24 hours after their intake who did not receive a hearing by a court commissioner.

text: Mokomišinare o bea peile, ge eba e ya dumelelwa, gomme a dira ditatofatšo tšeo di tlišitšwego ke lephodisa leo le swerego gore di be semmušo. Ditatofatšo ka morago di lokelwa ka gare ga tshepedišo ya khomphutha moo molato o šalwago morago.
text_en: The commissioner sets bail, if granted, and formalizes the charges filed by the arresting officer. The charges are then entered into the state's computer system where the case is tracked.

text: Theeletšo e swaya gape letšatšikgwedi bakeng sa tokelo ya mogononelwa ya tsheko ya lebelo.
text_en: The hearing also marks the date for the suspect’s right to a speedy trial.

text_en: Peter Costello, Australian treasurer and the man most likely to succeed Prime Minister John Howard as Liberal party leader has thrown his support behind a nuclear power industry in Australia.

text: Mr Costello o boletše gore ge go gogwa ga maatla a nuclear go thuša ekonomi, Australia e swanetše go ya go e šomiša.
text_en: Mr Costello said that when nuclear power generation becomes economically viable, Australia should pursue its use.

text: Ge e ka ba ya go rekišwa, re swanetše re be le yona. Se sa ra gore, ga go na kganetšo ya molao go maatla a nuclear" Mr Costello o boletše.
text_en: "If it becomes commercial, we should have it. That is, there's no in-principle objection to nuclear energy" Mr Costello said.

text_en: Brazil is the largest Roman Catholic country on Earth, and the Roman Catholic Church has consistently opposed the legalization of same-sex marriage in the country.

text_en: The National Congress of Brazil has debated legalization for 10 years, and such civil marriages are currently only legal in Rio Grande do Sul.

text_en: The original bill was drafted by former mayor of São Paulo, Marta Suplicy. The proposed legislation, after being amended, is now in the hands of Roberto Jefferson.

text_en: Protesters hope to collect a petition of 1.2 million signatures to present to the National Congress in November.

text: Ka morago ga gore go bonagale gore malapa a mantši a be a nyaka thušo ya semolao go lwa le go rakwa, kopano e ile ya tswarwa ka Matšhe 20 go la East Bay Community Law Center bakeng sa bahlaselwa ba bomenetša bja dintlo.
text_en: After it became apparent that many families were seeking legal help to fight the evictions, a meeting was held on March 20 at the East Bay Community Law Center for the victims of the housing scam.

text: Ge bahiri ba thoma go bolela tšeo di ba hlagetšego, malapa a mantšhi ao a amegago a thomile go lemoga gore Carolyn Wilson wa OHA o utswitše ditšhelete tša bona tša dipeeletšo tša tshireletšo, gomme a tšabela ka ntle ga toropo.
text_en: When the tenants started sharing what had occurred to them, most of the families involved suddenly realized that Carolyn Wilson of the OHA had stolen their security deposits, and skipped out of town.

text: Bahiri go la Lockwood Gardens ba dumela gore go ka ba go na le malapa a mangwe a 40 goba go feta ao a lebanego le go rakwa, ka ge ba lemogile gore maphodisa a OHA le wona a nyakišiša dithoto tše dingwe tša dintlo tša setšhaba go la Oakland tšeo di ka bago di swerwe ke bomenetša bjo bo fošagetsego bja dintlo.
text_en: Tenants at Lockwood Gardens believe that there may be another 40 families or more to face eviction, since they learned that OHA police are also investigating other public housing properties in Oakland that may be caught up in the housing scam.

text_en: The band's management company, HK Management Inc., gave no initial reason when they canceled on September 20, but blamed logistical reasons by the next day.

text: Maemedi ba molao ba go tuma ba Greek, Sakis Kechagioglou le George Nikolakopoulos ba golegilwe go la Athens kgolegong ya Korydallus, ka ge ba bonwe molato wa go huma ka stela ya go se molaong le bomenetša.
text_en: The famous Greek lawyers, Sakis Kechagioglou and George Nikolakopoulos have been imprisoned in the Athens' jail of Korydallus, as they were found guilty of graft and corruption.

text: Ka baka la se, taba ye kgolo ka gare ga motse wa molao wa Greek e tsošitšwe ka go bonagatša ditiro tša go se be molaong ga baahlodi, baemedi ba molao, bakgopedi ba ditšhelete le baemedi tšeo ba di dirilego mengwageng ya go feta.
text_en: As a result of this, a big scandal within the Greek legal community has been raised through the exposure of illegal actions that judges, lawyers, solicitors and attorneys have done during the previous years.

text: Dibeke tše mmalwa tša go feta, ka morago ga tsebišo yeo e patlaladitšwego ke raditaba Makis Triantafylopoulos go ponagatšo ya gagwe ya go thuma ya Telebišene "Zoungla" go Alpha Tv, moleloko wa Palamente le moemedi, Petros Mantouvalos o tlogedišišwe bjalo ka leloko la kantoro ya gagwe o bile ka gare ga hlomosetšo le bomenetša bja go se be molaong.
text_en: A few weeks ago, after the information published by the journalist Makis Triantafylopoulos in his popular Television show "Zoungla" in Alpha TV, the member of Parliament and lawyer, Petros Mantouvalos was abdicated as members of his office had been involved in illegal graft and corruption.

text: Godimo ga moo, moahlodi wa godimo Evangelos Kalousis o golegilwe ka ge a bonwe molato wa bomenetša le maitshwaro a go se kgahliše.
text_en: Moreover, top judge Evangelos Kalousis is imprisoned as he found guilty of corruption and degenerate behaviour.

text: Roberts o ganne go gana go bolela gore o dumela gore bophelo bo thoma neng, potšišo ye bohlokwa ge o nagana ka tsela ya maleba ya go ntšhwa ga mpa, a re seo e ka se be maitshwaro a maleba go ka bolela ka dintlha tša dikgetsi tše bjalo.
text_en: Roberts flatly refused to say about when he believes life begins, an important question when considering the ethics of abortion, saying that it would be unethical to comment on the specifics of likely cases.

text: O ile, kafao, a boeletša polelo ya gagwe ya ka pele gore Roe v. Wade e be e le "molao wo o beilwego wa naga", a gatelela bohlokwa bja dipušo tša go tšwelapele tša Kgorotseko ye Kgolo.
text_en: He did, however, reiterate his earlier statement that Roe v. Wade was the "settled law of the land", emphasizing the importance of consistent Supreme Court rulings.

text: O netefaditše gape gore o dumela go thokelo la sephiri yeo go bolelwago ka yona yeo sephetho sa Roe se bego se ithekgile ka yona.

text: Di molecules tša meetse di ka dira gore letlalo la go se bonagale godimo ga meetse tšeo di dumelelago dilo tša go tswana le nalete go phaphamala ka godimo ga meetse.
text_en: The water molecules make an invisible skin on the water’s surface that allows things like the needle to float on top of the water.

text: Legare godimo ga ice skate ya sebjalebjale le na le bomathoko go go bedi ga go ba le monga gare ga wona. Mathoko a a mabedi a dumelela bakeng sa go kgomarela aese ka tsela ye kaone, le ge a tšhekame.
text_en: The blade on a modern ice skate has a double edge with a concave hollow between them. The two edges allow for a better grasp of the ice, even when tilted.

text: ka lebaka la gore bofase bja legare bo kobegile ga nnyane, bjale ka ge legare le eya ka lehlakoreng le tee goba le lengwe, mafelelo ao a kgomanego le aese le wo a kobega.
text_en: Because the bottom of the blade is slightly curved, as the blade tilts to one side or the other, the edge which is in contact with the ice also curves.

text: Se se dira gore skater se retologe. Ge eba di skate di ka šutela ka letsogong la go ja, skater se sokologela ka letsogong la go ja, ge di skate di ka šutela ka letsogong la ngele, skater se sokologela ka letsogong la ngele.
text_en: This causes the skater to turn. If the skates tilt to the right, the skater turns right, if the skates tilt to the left, the skater turns left.

text: Go boele maemong a tšona a mafolofolo a morago, di swanetše di tloše mafolofolo a tlaleletšo ao di a hweditšego go tšwa seetšeng.
text_en: To return to their previous energy level, they must get rid of the extra energy they got from the light.

text: Di dira se ka go ntša karolwana ye nnyane ya seetša ya go bitšwa "photon".
text_en: They do this by emitting a tiny particle of light called a "photon".

text: Borasaentsheba betša tshepeditšo ye "phatlalatšo yeo e tutueditšwego ya mahlasedi" ka lebaka la gore di atoms di tutueditšwe ke seetša sa go phadima, e dira gore phatlalatšo ya seetša sa photon, gomme seetša ke mohuta wa mahlasedi.
text_en: Scientists call this process "stimulated emission of radiation" because the atoms are stimulated by the bright light, causing the emission of a photon of light, and light is a type of radiation.

text: seswantšho se se latelago se bontša di atoms di ntša di photons. Ee, nneteng di photon di tloga e le tše nnyane go feta tšeo di lego godimo ga seswantšho.
text_en: The next picture shows the atoms emitting photons. Of course, in reality photons are a lot smaller than those in the picture.

text: Diphotons di tloga e le tše dinnyane go feta dilo tšeo di dirago di atoms!
text_en: Photons are even smaller than the stuff that makes up atoms!

text: Ka morago ga diiri tše makgolokgolo tša go šoma dithapšana tša ka gare ga lebone dia swa gomme lebone la sehlwe le šoma.
text_en: After hundreds of hours of operation the filament in the bulb eventually burns out and the light bulb no longer works.

text: Lebone le hloka go tšhentšwa. Go bohlokwa go hlokomela ka go tšhentša lebone.
text_en: The light bulb then needs replacing. It is necessary to be careful in replacing the light bulb.

text: Sa pele, selo sa go thima lebone se swanetše se thimiwe goba thapo e kgaulwe.
text_en: First, the switch for the light fixture needs to be turned off or the cable disconnected.

text: Se ke ka lebaka la gore mohlagase wa go elela go ya ka gare ga sokete moo karolo ya tšhipi ya lebole e dulago go ka fa lešhoko la mohlagase le šoro ge o ka kgoma ka gare ga sokete goba motheo wa tšhipi wa lebone mola e sale gannyane ka gare ga sokete.
text_en: This is because electricity flowing into the socket where the metallic part of bulb sits can give you a severe electric shock if you touch the inside of the socket or the metal base of the bulb while it is still partly in the socket.

text: Setho se golo ga tshepedišo ya madi ke pelo, yeo e pompago madi.
text_en: The major organ of the circulatory system is the heart, which pumps the blood.

text: madi a tloga go tšwa ka pelong ka metapo yeo e bitšwago di arteries gomme a boela morago ka pelong ka metapo yeo e bitšwago mašika. Metapo ye mennyanenyane e bitšwa capillaries.
text_en: Blood goes away from the heart in tubes called arteries and comes back to the heart in tubes called veins. The smallest tubes are called capillaries.

text: Meno a triceratops a be a ka kgona go kgatla e seng go matlakala fela efela le makala a go tatafa kudu le medu.
text_en: A triceratops' teeth would have been able to crush not only leaves but even very tough branches and roots.

text: Borasaentsheba bangwe banagana gore di Triceratops di jele cycads, tšeo e lego mehuta ya semela seo e tlwalegilego go la Cretaceous.
text_en: Some scientists think Triceratops ate cycads, which are a type of plant that was common in the Cretaceous.

text: Dimela tše di lebelelega bjalo ka mohlare o monnyane wa mo palm ka ntlhora ya mphaphahlogo, le matlakala a go phadimela.
text_en: These plants look like a small palm tree with a crown of sharp, spiky leaves.

text: Triceratops e ka ba e šomišitše molomo wa yona wa go kgwahla go ngwata matlakala pele ga go ja kutu.
text_en: A Triceratops could have used its strong beak to strip off the leaves before eating the trunk.

text: Boramahlale ba bangwe ba bolela gore dimela tše di kotsi kudu ka mpholo ka fao ga go tshepagale gore di dinosaur di di jele, le ge lehono sloth le diphoofolo tše dingwe bjalo ka parrot (tšeo di tšwago go di dinosaurs) di ka ja matlakala a go ba le mpholo goba dienywa.
text_en: Other scientists argue that these plants are very poisonous so it is unlikely that any dinosaur ate them, even though today the sloth and other animals like the parrot (a descendant of the dinosaurs) can eat poisonous leaves or fruit.

text: Naa maatlakgogedi a lo a ka nkgoga bjang? Ge o ka ema bogodimong bja lo, o ka kala bonnyane go feta lefaseng.
text_en: How would Io's gravity pull on me? If you stood on the surface of Io, you would weigh less than you do on Earth.

text: Motho wa go kala dipaounte tše 200 (90kg) mo Lefaseng a ka kala tekano ya dipaounte tše 36 (16kg) go lo. Bjale matlakgogedi, ee, a goga bonnyane go wena.
text_en: A person who weighs 200 pounds (90kg) on Earth would weigh about 36 pounds (16kg) on Io. So the gravity, of course, pulls less on you.

text: Letšatši ga le na legogo bjalo ka Lefase leo o ka kgonago go ema godimo ga lona. Letšatši le dirilwe ka dikgase, mollo, le plasma.
text_en: The Sun doesn't have a crust like the Earth that you can stand on. The whole Sun is made out of gases, fire, and plasma.

text: Moya o wa sesefala ge o subelela go tšwa bogareng bja Letšatši.
text_en: The gas becomes thinner as you go farther from the center of the Sun.

text: Karolo ya kantlentle yeo re e bonago ge re lebelela Letšatši e bitšwa photosphere, yeo e e ra gore "bolo ya seetša".
text_en: The outer-part we see when we look at the Sun is called the photosphere, which means "ball of light".

text: Ka morago ga mengwaga ye e ka bago ye diteke tše tharo, ka 1610, setsebi sa dinaledi sa mo-Italy Galileo Galilei o šomišitše teleskope go lebelela gore Venus e la le ma manoga, bjalo ka ge ngwedi o na le wona.
text_en: About three thousand years later, in 1610, Italian astronomer Galileo Galilei used a telescope to observe that Venus has phases, just as the moon does.

text: Mamanoga a direga ka le baka la gore fela lehlakore la Venus (goba la Ngwedi) la go lebana le Letšatši le laetilwe. Mamanoga a Venus a thekgile theory ya Copernicus ya gore dipolanete di dukuloga lefase.
text_en: Phases happen because only the side of Venus (or of the Moon) facing the Sun is lighted. The phases of Venus supported the theory of Copernicus that the planets go around the Sun.

text: Bjale, mengwaga ye mmalwa ka morago ka 1639, radinaledi wa Moismane wa go bitšwa Jeremiah Horrocks o bone tshepelo ya Venus.
text_en: Then, a few years later in 1639, an English astronomer named Jeremiah Horrocks observed a transit of Venus.

text: England e itemogetše lebaka le letelele la khutšo morago ga poetšo ya Danelaw.
text_en: England had experienced a long period of peace after the reconquest of the Danelaw.

text: Efela ka 991 Ethelred o lebane le Borantwa ba Dikepe tše ntšintši go feta mola go tloga pele ga ngwakgolo wa Guthrum.
text_en: However in 991 Ethelred was faced with a Viking fleet larger than any since Guthrum's a century earlier.

text: Madira a a be a etilwe pele ke Olaf Trygvasson, mo-Norwegian wa dikganyogo tša go tšea morago naga ya gagwe go pušo ya Danish.
text_en: This fleet was led by Olaf Trygvasson, a Norwegian with ambitions to reclaim his country from Danish domination.

text: Ka morago ga ditšhitišo tša sešole, Ethelred o ile a kgona go dumelelana le dipeelano le Olaf, woo a boetšego Norway go ya go leka go hwetša mmušo wa gagwe ka katlego yeo e hlakantšwego.
text_en: After initial military setbacks, Ethelred was able to agree to terms with Olaf, who returned to Norway to try to gain his kingdom with mixed success.

text: Hangeul ke leletere leo le hlotšwego ka morero leo le tumulego ka go dirišwa letšatši ka letšatši. Leletere le hlotšwe ka 1444 ka nako ya pušo ya Kgoši Sejong (1418-1450).
text_en: Hangeul is the only purposely invented alphabet in popular daily use. The alphabet was invented in 1444 during the reign of King Sejong (1418 – 1450).

text: Kgoši Sejong e be e le kgoši ya bone ya Bogoši bja Joseon gape ke o mongwe wa bao ba kgethegago kudu.
text_en: King Sejong was the fourth king of the Joseon Dynasty and is one of the most highly regarded.

text: Go tloga mathomong o theile leletere la Hangeul gore ke Hunmin Jeongeum, yeo e bolelago gore "modumo wa nnete bakeng sa taelo ya batho".
text_en: He originally named the Hangeul alphabet Hunmin Jeongeum, which means "the correct sounds for the instruction of the people".

text: Gona le di theory tše dintši tša gore se-Sanskrit se bile gona bjang. yengwe ya tšona ke ka moo bafaladi ba ma-Aryan go tšwa bodikela go ya India ba tlilego le leleme la bona.
text_en: There are many theories to how Sanskrit came into existence. One of them is about an Aryan migration from the west into India who brought their language with them.

text: Sanskrit ke leleme la kgalekgale gomme le bapetšega le leleme la se-Latin la go bolelwa Yuropa.
text_en: Sanskrit is an ancient language and is comparable to the Latin language spoken in Europe.

text: Puku ya go ngwalwa pelepele lefaseng yeo e tsebegago e ngwadilwe ka se-Sanskrit. Ka morago ga kgoboketšo ya Upanishads, se-Sanskrit se ile sa hwelela ka baka la lenaneo la go ya godimo.
text_en: The earliest known book in the world was written in Sanskrit. After the compilation of Upanishads, Sanskrit just faded due to hierarchy.

text: Sanskrit ke polelo ya go hlakhlakana ya go topela, yeo e hlanketšego goba mothopo bakeng sa maleme a mantši a sebjalebjale a India, bjalo ka ge se-Latin e le mothopo bakeng sa maleme a mantši a Yuropa go tswana le se-French le se-Spanish.
text_en: Sanskrit is a very complex and rich language, which has served to be the source for many modern Indian languages, just like Latin is the source for European languages like French and Spanish.

text: Ka go fela ga ntwa ya go lwela France, Germany e thomile go eithokišetša go hlasela dihlakahlaka tša Britain.
text_en: With the battle for France over, Germany began to get ready to invade the island of Britain.

text: Germany e theeile hlaselo "Operation sealion". Bontši bja dibetša tša boima tša Mašole a Britain le diabelwa tša bona di be di timetše ge ba be ba huduga go tšwa Dunkirk, ka fao bošole bo be bo fokola kudu.
text_en: Germany code-named the attack “Operation Sealion”. Most of the British Army's heavy weapons and supplies had been lost when it evacuated from Dunkirk, so the army was fairly weak.

text: Efela Madira a Bogoši a be a sa tiile kudu go feta Madira a German (“Kriegsmarine”) gape gomme a ka be a hlahlamolotše sehlopha se sengwe le se sengwe sa hlaselo seo se rometšwego go lefelo la English.
text_en: But the Royal Navy was still much stronger than the German Navy (“Kriegsmarine”) and could have destroyed any invasion fleet sent across the English Channel.

text: Efela, ke dikepe tše di nnyane kudu tša Bošole bja ka Meetseng bja Mošate tšeo di bego di beilwe kgauswi le ditsela tša hlaselo ka ge ba bagolo ba mašole ao a ka meetseng ba be ba tšhogile gore ba ka nweletšwa ke hlaselo ya lefaufau ya Germany.
text_en: However, very few Royal Navy ships were based near the likely invasion routes as the admirals were afraid they would be sunk by German air attack.

text: A re thomeng ka tlhalošo ya mabapi le maano a Ithali. Ithali e be e le "moratho" wa Jeremane le Japane.
text_en: Let's start with an explanation about Italy's plans. Italy was mainly the "little brother" of Germany and Japan.

text: E be e na le mašole a bokowa le mašole a meetseng a bokowa, le ge ba be ba sa tšwa go aga dikepe tše diswa pele ga go thoma ga ntwa.
text_en: It had a weaker army and a weaker navy, although they had just built four new ships right before the beginning of the war.

text: Dinepo tše kgolo tša Italy e be e le dinaga tša Afrika. Go thopa dinaga tšeo, ba be ba tlo hloka go ba le hlomamišo ya madira, gore madira a kgone go selaganya Lewatle la Meuterranean gomme a šwahlele Afrika.
text_en: Italy's main goals were African countries. To capture those countries, they would need to have a troop launching pad, so as troops could sail across the Mediterranean Sea and invade Africa.

text: Ka seo, ba ile ba tswanela ke go tloša metheo ya Britain le dikepe go la Egypt. Ka ntle le ditiragatšo tšeo, dikepe tša ntwa tša Italy di be di sa swanela go dira se sengwe gape.
text_en: For that, they had to get rid of British bases and ships in Egypt. Besides those actions, Italy's battleships were not supposed to do anything else.

text: Gabjale go Japan. Japan e be ele naga ya sehlakahlake, bjalo ka Britain.
text_en: Now for Japan. Japan was an island country, just like Britain.

text: Dikepe tša ka fase ga meetse ke dikepe tšeo di diretšwego go sepela ka fase ga meeste, gomme di dule fao bakeng sa lebaka le letelele.
text_en: Submarines are ships designed to travel underwater, and remain there for an extended amount of time.

text: Dikepe tša ka fase ga meetse di šomišitšwe ka gare ga Ntwa ya Lefase ya I le Ntwa ya Lefase ya II. Kua morago di be di nanya kudu gomme di thuntšetša kgauswi.
text_en: Submarines were used in World War I and World War II. Back then they were very slow and had a very limited shooting range.

text: Mathomong a ntwa ba be ba sepelela kudu go ya bogodimo bja lewatl, efela ge radar e thoma go tšwelapele gomme e thoma go nepathwii dikepe tša ka fase ga meetse di gapeletšegile go ya ka fase ga meetse go efoga go bonwa.
text_en: In the beginning of the war they mostly travelled on top of the sea, but as radar began developing and becoming more accurate the submarines were forced to go under water to avoid being seen.

text: Dikepe tša ka fase ga meetse tša Germany di be di bitšwa U-Boats. Ma-Germany a be a tloga a kgona go sepediša le go šomiša dikepe tša bona tša ka fase ga meetse.
text_en: German submarines were called U-Boats. The Germans were very good at navigating and operating their submarines.

text: Ka lebaka la go atlega ga bona ka dikepe tša ka fase ga meetse, ka morago ga ntwa ga go tshepšwe ge e ba maJeremane a sa na le tše ntšhi.
text_en: Because of their success with submarines, after the war Germans aren't trusted to have many of them.

text: Ee! Kgoši Tutankhamun, nako tše dingwe o bitšwa bjalo ka "Kgoši Tut" goba "Kgoši ya Lesogana", ke wo mongwe wa dikgotši tša kgale tša go tsebalega tša Egypt dinako tša sebjalebjale.
text_en: Yes! King Tutankhamun, sometimes referred to as "King Tut" or "The Boy King", is one of the most well known ancient Egyptian kings in modern times.

text: Sa go makatša, o be a sa tšerwe go ba o bohlokwa ka nako tša kgale gomme o be a sa rekotiwa ka gare ga malokelelo a mantši a dikgoši.
text_en: Interestingly, he was not considered to be very important in ancient times and was not recorded on most ancient king lists.

text: Efela, go hwetšagala ga lebitla la gagwe ka 1922 go mo dirile setsebalegi. Mola mabitla a mantši a kgale a utswetšwe, lebitla le le tlogetšwe le sa tshwenywa le ga tee.
text_en: However, the discovery of his tomb in 1922 made him a celebrity. While many tombs of the past were robbed, this tomb was left virtually undisturbed.

text: Bontši bja dilo tšeo di bolokilwego le Tutankhamun di bolokilwe gabotse, go akaretšwa dikete tša didirwa tšeo di dirilwego ka metato ye mebotse le maswika a go se hwetšagale.
text_en: Most of the items buried with Tutankhamun have been well preserved, including thousands of artefacts made from precious metals and rare stones.

text: Hlolo ya maotwana e dirile dikariki tša Assyria gore di be bofefo, tša lebelo, le go itukišetša bokaone go tšabela mašole le dikariki tše dingwe.
text_en: The invention of spoke wheels made Assyrian chariots lighter, faster, and better prepared to outrun soldiers and other chariots.

text: Mesebo go tšwa go bora ba bona e be e ka phunyeletša tlhamo ya mašole a manaba. Ka bo 1000 B.C., ma Assyria a tsebišitše banamedi ba dipitsi ba mathomo.
text_en: Arrows from their deadly crossbows could penetrate the armor of rival soldiers. About 1000 B.C., the Assyrians introduced the first cavalry.

text: Banamedi ba dipere ke sešole seo se lwago se nametše dipere. Sala e be e sešo ya dirwa, kafao banamedi ba dipere ba ntwa ba Assyria ba lwele ba le godimo ga mekokotlo ya dipere tša bona e se a apešwa selo.
text_en: A cavalry is an army that fights on horseback. The saddle had not yet been invented, so the Assyrian cavalry fought on the bare backs of their horses.

text: re tseba boradipolotiki, ramahlale, le dibine tše ntši tša Greek. Kgonagalo ya go ba motho wa go tsebaga kudu ka setšo se ke Homer, seriti sa mehleng sa sefofu, wo a beakantšego dikarolo tše pedi tša mmakgonthe tša dingwalwa: direto Iliad le Odyssey.
text_en: We know many Greek politicians, scientists, and artists. Possibly the most known person of this culture is Homer, the legendary blind poet, who composed two masterpieces of Greek literature: the poems Iliad and Odyssey.

text: DI Sophocles le di Aristophanes e sa le dingwalwa tšeo sa tumilego gomme dipapadi tša tšona di tšeiwa bjalo ka tša goba magareng ga mešomo ye mebotsebotse ya lefase la literature.
text_en: Sophocles and Aristophanes are still popular playwrights and their plays are considered to be among the greatest works of world literature.

text: O mongwe wa tuma wa mo Greek ke radipalo Pythagoras, kudu o tsebega bakeng sa theorem ya gagwe ya go tuma ya dikamano tša mahlakore a nngele a dikhutlo-tharo.
text_en: Another famous Greek is a mathematician Pythagoras, mostly known for his famous theorem about relations of the sides of right triangles.

text: Gona le ditekano tša go fapafapana ka palo ya batho bao ba bolelago seHindi. Go balelwa gore e ka ba magereng ga leleme la bobedi le labone leo le bolelwago kudu mo lefaseng.
text_en: There are varying estimates for how many people speak Hindi. It is estimated to be between the second and fourth most commonly spoken language in the world.

text: Palo ya diboledi tša maleme a setlogo e fapana go ya ka gore mebolelwana ya go batamelana e badilwe goba aowa na.
text_en: The number of native speakers varies depending on whether or not very closely related dialects are counted.

text: Tekano yeo e naganelwago go tloga go diboledi tše dimilione tše 340 go ya go dimilione tše 500, le bontši bja batho ba go ka lekana dimilione tše 800 ba ka kwešiša polelo.
text_en: Estimates range from 340 million to 500 million speakers, and as many as 800 million people can understand the language.

text: Hindi le Urdu di tswana ka go bolelwa efela di fapana ka go ngwalwa; ka gare ga poledišano yengwe le yengwe, diboledi tša maleme a a mabedi gantši di na le go kwešišana.
text_en: Hindi and Urdu are similar in vocabulary but different in script; in everyday conversations, speakers of both languages can usually understand each other.

text: Ka bo ngwagakgolo wa bo 15, leboa la Estonia le be le le ka fase ga kgathelelo ye kgolo ya Germany.
text_en: Around the 15th century, northern Estonia was under great cultural influence of Germany.

text: Baruti ba bangwe ba Majereman ba be ba nyaka go tliša Modimo kgauswi le batho ba setlogo, ka fao ba hlola leleme la thuto la Seistoniya.
text_en: Some German monks wanted to bring God closer to the native people, so they invented the Estonian literal language.

text: Ebe e theilwe godimo ga le la letere ya Greman le seka se tee "Õ/õ" se okeditšwe.
text_en: It was based on the German alphabet and one character "Õ/õ" was added.

text: Ge nako e sepela, mantšu a mantši ao a bego a adimilwe go tšwa German a kopane. Se e bile mathmo a tshedimošo.
text_en: As time passed, many words that were borrowed from German coalesced. This was the beginning of enlightenment.

text: Ka setšo, mojalefa go tirone o tla lebathwii bošoleng ka morago ga go fetša sekolo.
text_en: Traditionally, the heir to the throne would go straight into the military after finishing school.

text: Le ge go le bjalo, Charles o ile unibesiti go la Trinity College, Cambridge moo a ithutetšego Anthropology le Archaeology, gomme ka morago Histori, a hwetša 2:2 (kgrata ya fase ya bobedi).
text_en: However, Charles went to university at Trinity College, Cambridge where he studied Anthropology and Archaeology, and later History, earning a 2:2 (a lower second class degree).

text: Charles e be e le leloko la mathomo la Lelapa la Bokgoši bja Britain la go fiwa tikrii.
text_en: Charles was the first member of the British Royal Family to be awarded a degree.

text: Turkey ya Yuropa (bohlabela bja Thrace goba Rumelia ka Balkan peninsula) e akaretša 3% ya naga.
text_en: European Turkey (eastern Thrace or Rumelia in the Balkan peninsula) includes 3% of the country.

text: Naga ya Turkey e feta dikilomitara tše 1,600 (1,000 mi) ka bo telele gomme 800 km (500 mi) ka bophara, ka sebopego sa go ngaka go ba khutlotharo.
text_en: The territory of Turkey is more than 1,600 kilometres (1,000 mi) long and 800 km (500 mi) wide, with a roughly rectangular shape.

text: Lefelo la Turkey, go akaretša matsha, di tšea bobedi bja dikilomitara tše 783,562 (300,948 sq mi), yeo e lego gore bobedi bja dikilomitara tše 755,688 (291,773 sq mi) di go borwa bodikela bja Asia gomme bobedi bja dikilomitara tše 23,764 (9,174 sq mi) di Yuropa.
text_en: Turkey's area, including lakes, occupies 783,562 square kilometres (300,948 sq mi), of which 755,688 square kilometres (291,773 sq mi) are in south west Asia and 23,764 square kilometres (9,174 sq mi) in Europe.

text: Lefelo la Turkey le e dira gore e be naga ya bo 37 ka bogolo lefaseng, gomme e nyakile goba saese ya Metropolitan France le United Kingdom di hlakane.
text_en: Turkey's area makes it the world's 37th-largest country, and is about the size of Metropolitan France and the United Kingdom combined.

text: Turkey e dikaneditšwe ke mawatle mahlakoreng a mararo: Lewatle la Aegean go ya go bodikela, Lewatle le Leso go ya leboa le Lewatle la Mediterranean go ya borwa.
text_en: Turkey is encircled by seas on three sides: the Aegean Sea to the west, the Black Sea to the north and the Mediterranean Sea to the south.

text: Luxembourg e na le histori ye telele efela boikemo bja yona bo thoma go tloga ka 1839.
text_en: Luxembourg has a long history but its independence dates from 1839.

text: Dikarolo tša lehono tša Belgium e be e le karolo ya Luxembourg kgale efela ya ba Belgian ka morago ga Mpherefere wa Belgian wa di 1830.
text_en: Present-day parts of Belgium were part of Luxembourg in the past but became Belgian after the 1830s Belgian Revolution.

text: Luxembourg e dutše e lekile go dula e le naga ya go se tšee lehlakore efela e be e le go bobedi Ntwa ya Lefase I le Ntwa ya Lefase II ka Germany.
text_en: Luxembourg has always tried to remain a neutral country but it was occupied in both World War I and World War II by Germany.

text: Ka 1957 Luxembourg e bile leloko la go thoma mokgatlo woo lehono o tsebegago bjalo ka European Union.
text_en: In 1957 Luxembourg became a founding member of the organization which is today known as the European Union.

text: Drukgay Dzong ke sebo seo se senyegilego le lefelo la baitlami ba ma-Buddhist karolong ya ka godimo ya Selete sa Paro (go la Phondey Village).
text_en: The Drukgyal Dzong is a ruined fortress and Buddhist monastery in the upper part of the Paro District (in Phondey Village).

text: Go a nyamiša gore ka 1649, Zhabdrung Ngawang Namgyel o hlotše sebo go dira segopotšo sa phenyo ya gagwe gahlanong le madira a Tibetan-Mongol.
text_en: It is said that in 1649, Zhabdrung Ngawang Namgyel created the fortress to commemorate his victory against the Tibetan-Mongol forces.

text: Ka 1951, mollo o dirile gore go šale fela mašaledi a drukgyal Dzong, bjale ka seswantšho sa Zhabdrung Ngawang Namgyal.
text_en: In 1951, a fire caused for only some of the relics of the Drukgyal Dzong to remain, such as the image of Zhabdrung Ngawang Namgyal.

text: Ka morago ga mollo, sethokgwa se ile sa bolokwa le go tšhireletšwa, e dula e le yengwe ya dikgogedi tša go kgahliša tša Bhutan.
text_en: After the fire, the fortress was preserved and protected, remaining to be one of Bhutan's most sensational attractions.

text: Ngwagakgolong wa bo 18 Cambodia e ikhweditše e patagane gare ga baagišane ba maatla, Thailand le Vietnam.
text_en: During the 18th century Cambodia found itself squeezed between two powerful neighbors, Thailand and Vietnam.

text: Ma-Thais a hlasetše Cambodia makga a mmalwa ka ngwakgolo wa bo 18 gomme ka 1772 ba senya Phnom Phen.
text_en: The Thais invaded Cambodia several times in the 18th century and in 1772 they destroyed Phnom Phen.

text: Mengwageng ya mafelelo ya ngwagakgolo wa bo 18 ma-Vietnamese le wona a ile a hlasela Cambodia.
text_en: In the last years of the 18th century the Vietnamese also invaded Cambodia.

text: Dipersente tše lesomeseswai tša Venezuelans ga di šome, gomme bontši bja bona ba šomago bo šoma ekonoming yeo e sego ekonomi.
text_en: Eighteen percent of Venezuelans are unemployed, and most of those who are employed work in the informal economy.

text: Bobedi bja boraro bja ma-venezuela bao ba šomago ba dira bjalo ka legorong la tirelo, go fihla kotara bo šoma ka intasetereng gomme bohlano bo šoma ka go tša temo.
text_en: Two thirds of Venezuelans who work do so in the service sector, nearly a quarter work in industry and a fifth work in agriculture.

text: Intasetere ye bohlokwa bakeng sa Venezuelan ke oile, moo naga yeo e lego ye kgolo ya go iša ka ntle, le ge peresente ye tee fela e šoma ka gare ga intasetere ya oile.
text_en: An important industry for Venezuelans is oil, where the country is a net exporter, even though only one percent work in the oil industry.

text: Pejana go boikemo bja naga, bokgoni bja Dirapa tša Singapore Botanic bo thušitše go fetola sehlakahlake go ba Toropo ya Serapa sa theropiki.
text_en: Early in the nation's independence, Singapore Botanic Gardens' expertise helped to transform the island into a tropical Garden City.

text: Ka 1981, Vanda Miss Joaquim, lelomo la go tswakana, le kgethilwe bjalo ka lelomo la naga.
text_en: In 1981, Vanda Miss Joaquim, an orchid hybrid, was chosen as the nation's national flower.

text: Ngwaga o mongwe le o mongwe ka bo Ocktobere dimilion tša go lekana 1.5 tša diphoofolo tša go ja nama di sepelela go lebiša leganateng laborwa, go tsela Noka ya Mara, go tšwa mebotong ya leboa bakeng sa pula.
text_en: Every year around October nearly 1.5 million herbivores travel towards the southern plains, crossing the Mara River, from the northern hills for the rains.

text: Gomme go boela morago leboa ka sa ka bodikela, go selaganya leboeletša noka ya Mara, ka morago ga dipula ka bo Aporele.
text_en: And then back to the north through the west, once again crossing the Mara river, after the rains in around April.

text: Selete sa Serengeti se na le Serengeti National Park, the Ngorongoro Conservation Area le Maswa Game Reserve ka Tanzania le Maasai Mara National Reserve ka Kenya.
text_en: The Serengeti region contains the Serengeti National Park, the Ngorongoro Conservation Area and Maswa Game Reserve in Tanzania and the Maasai Mara National Reserve in Kenya.

text: Go ithuta go dira phatlalatšo ya ditaba ga kgokagano go nyaka mabokgoni a setlogo a kopano, gammogo le didirišwa tšeo di rutilwego dithutong tša kgokagano (go nyaka ditaba, go lokiša audio le viseo, go dira kanegelo, bjbj.)
text_en: Learning to create interactive media requires conventional and traditional skills, as well as tools mastered in interactive classes (storyboarding, audio and video editing, story telling, etc.)

text: Moakanyetšo wa go kgokagana o hloka gore o lebeledišiše dikakanyo tša gago mabapi  le tšweletšo ya diphatlalatši gammogo le go ithuta go nagana ka ditsela tše di fapafapanego.
text_en: Interactive design requires that you re-assess your assumptions about media production and learn to think in a non-linear ways.

text: Go dira bokgabo ga go kopantša go nyaka dikarolo tša projeke di kgokagane mmogo, efela di be le kgopolo le ge di ikeme di nnoši.
text_en: Interactive design requires that components of a project connect to each other, but also make sense as a separate entity.

text: Sa go se kgahliše ka dikgalase tša kgogelopele ke gore hlakahlakano ya thebo le palo ya dielement tša dikgalase tšeo di hlokegago go hwetša bontši bja botelele bja thebo go feta ga dikgalase tša prime.
text_en: The disadvantage of zoom lenses is that the focal complexity and number of lens elements required to achieve a range of focal lengths is much greater than for prime lenses.

text: Se e ba taba ye nnyane ka ge batšweletši ba dikgalase ba fihlelela maemo a godimo ka go tšweletša dikgalase.
text_en: This is becoming less of an issue as lens manufacturers achieve higher standards in lens production.

text: Se se dumeletše dikgalase tša go gogela kgauswi go tšweletša diswantšho tša makgethe go bapetšega le tšeo di tšerwego ka dikgalase tša botelele bjoo bo beilwego sa ruri.
text_en: This has allowed zoom lenses to produce pictures of a quality comparable to that achieved by lenses with fixed focal length.

text: Bothata bjo bongwe bja dikgalase tša go bonela kgauswi ke mafelelo a go bulega (lebelo) ga dikgalase ka mehla go ba fasana.
text_en: Another disadvantage of zoom lenses is that the maximum aperture (the speed) of the lens is usually lower.

text: Se se dira gore go šomiša dikgalase tša go gogelakgauswi go be boima ka gare ga maemo a seetša sa fae ntle le lebonethagi.
text_en: This makes inexpensive zoom lenses hard to use in low-light conditions without a flash.

text: Bjo tee bja mathata ao a tlwaelegilego ge o leka go fetolela movie go mokgwa wa DVD ke go balela go feta.
text_en: One of the most common problems when trying to convert a movie to DVD format is the overscan.

text: Bontši bja dithelebišene bo dirilwe ka mokgwa wa go kgahla setšhaba.
text_en: Most televisions are made in a way to please the general public.

text: Bakeng sa lebaka le, se sengwe le se sengwe seo o se bonago mo TV se bile le go fokotšwa, ka godimo, ka fase le ka mahlakoreng.
text_en: For that reason, everything you see on the TV had the borders cut, top, bottom and sides.

text: Se se dirilwe go netefatša gore seswantšho se khupetša sekerene ka moka. Seo se bitšwa overscan.
text_en: This is made to ensure that the image covers the whole screen. That is called overscan.

text: Ka go hloka mahlatse, Ge o dire DVD, mahlakore a yona a ka no tla ripega gape, gomme ge e ba dingwalwa tša bofase bja bedio di fase kgauswi kudu, di ka se tšweletšwe ka moka.
text_en: Unfortunately, when you make a DVD, it's borders will most likely be cut too, and if the video had subtitles too close to the bottom, they won't be fully shown.

text: Medieval castle ya setlogo e hueditše monagano, e tsoša diswantšo tša di jousts, mekete ya dijo le boradipere ba ma-Arthurian.
text_en: The traditional medieval castle has long inspired the imagination, conjuring up images of jousts, banquets and Arthurian chivalry.

text: Le go ema gare ga ditshenyegelo tše sekete go bonolo go tliša medumo le menkgo ya dintwa tšeo di fetilego kgale kgopolong, go kwa ekare o kwa lešata la dipele le go dupelela letšhogo le gola go tloga meleteng ya kgolego.
text_en: Even standing amidst thousand year-old ruins it is easy to bring to mind the sounds and smells of battles long gone, to almost hear the clatter of hooves on the cobbles and to smell the fear rising from the dungeon pits.

text: Efela e ka ba megopolo ya rena ke ya nnete? Gobaneng mešate e agilwe? E bopilwe le go agiwa bjang?
text_en: But is our imagination based on reality? Why were castles built in the first place? How were they designed and built?

text: Go tlwaelega bakeng sa lebaka, Ntlomošate ya Kirby Muxloe ke ntlo yeo e thiišitšwego go na le goba ntlomošate ya nnete.
text_en: Typical for the period, Kirby Muxloe Castle is more of a fortified house than a true castle.

text: Mafenstere a yona a magolo a go bona tša ka gare le maboto a masese di be di ka se kgone go lwantšha hlaselo ya maikemišetšo sebaka se setelele.
text_en: Its large glazed windows and thin walls would not have been able to resist a determined attack for long.

text: Ka bo 1480, ge go thoma go agwa ga yona go thoma ke Lord Hasting, naga e be e tloga e na le khutšo le tšhireletšo e be e hlokega fela kgahlanong le sihlopa tše nnyane tša bahlakodi.
text_en: In the 1480s, when its construction was begun by Lord Hastings, the country was relatively peaceful and defense was only required against small bands of roving marauders.

text: Go lekanetša maatla e be e le tshepedišo yeo dinaga tša Europe di nyakilego go e tšwelapele di tswere bolaodi bja pušo mebušong ya Yuropa ka moka.
text_en: The balance of power was a system in which European nations sought to maintain the national sovereignty of all European states.

text: Kwešišo e be e le gore dinaga ka moka tša Yuropa di be di tswanela ke go thibela naga ye tee go ba ye maatla, gomme kafao mebušo ya naga gantši e fetola bao ba thekganago lebona gore go kgone goba le teka-tekano.
text_en: The concept was that all European nations had to seek to prevent one nation from becoming powerful, and thus national governments often changed their alliances in order to maintain the balance.

text: Ntwa ya Hlatlamo ya Spain e swaile ntwa ya pele yeo tabakgolo ya yona ebe e le tekatekano ya maatla.
text_en: The War of Spanish Succession marked the first war whose central issue was the balance of power.

text: Se se swaile phetogo ye bohlokwa, ka ge maatla a Yuropa a ka se sa ba le maatla a go ba dintwa tša sedumedi. Ka fao, Ntwa ya Mengwaga ye Masometharo e ka ba ntwa ya mafelelo ya go bitšwa ntwa ya sedumedi.
text_en: This marked an important change, as European powers would no longer have the pretext of being religious wars. Thus, the Thirty Years' War would be the last war to be labeled a religious war.

text: Tempele ya Artemis go la Ephesus e sentšwe ka Julae 21, 356 BCE ka tiro ya go tšhuma thoto ya go dirwa ke ma-Herostratus.
text_en: The temple of Artemis at Ephesus was destroyed on July 21, 356 BCE in an act of arson committed by Herostratus.

text: Go ya ka padi, tšutšumetšo ya gagwe e be e le go thuma go sa kgathale selo. Baefeso, ba kwatile, ba begile gore leina la Herostratus ga sa ka la rekotwa.
text_en: According to the story, his motivation was fame at any cost. The Ephesians, outraged, announced that Herostratus' name never be recorded.

text: Rahistori wa Greek Strabo ka morago o ile a bolela leina, ke ka fao re tsebago ka gona lehono. Tempele e sentšwe bošegong bjo tee bjoo Alexander the Great a belegweng ka bona.
text_en: The Greek historian Strabo later noted the name, which is how we know today. The temple was destroyed on the same night that Alexander the Great was born.

text: Alexander, bjalo ka kgoši, o neetše ka go lefela go agaleswa tempele, efela moneelo wa gagwe o gannwe. Ka morago, ge Alexander a hlokofetše, tempele e agilweleswa ka 323 BCE.
text_en: Alexander, as king, offered to pay to rebuild the temple, but his offer was denied. Later, after Alexander died, the temple was rebuilt in 323 BCE.

text: Netefatša gore letsogo la gago le iketlile ge le sa kgotla dinoutu gabotse - gape o leke go se šute kudu ka menwana ya gago.
text_en: Make sure your hand is as relaxed as possible while still hitting all the notes correctly - also try not to make much extraneous motion with your fingers.

text: Ka tsela ye, o tla itapiša ga nnyane ka moo go kgonegago. Gopola ga go na hlokego ya go kgotla dikonopi ka maatla a mantši e le go oketša bolumu bjalo ka ge o šomiša piano.
text_en: This way, you will tire yourself out as little as possible. Remember there's no need to hit the keys with a lot of force for extra volume like on the piano.

text: Godimo ga accordion, go hwetša volume ya tlaleletšo, o šomiša tša fase ka maatla a mantši goba lebelo.
text_en: On the accordion, to get extra volume, you use the bellows with more pressure or speed.

text: Bodumedi bja sephiri bo ka latela kamano le temogo ya boitsebišo le, goba temogo ya therešo ye kgolo, le therešo ya semoya, goba Modimo.
text_en: Mysticism is the pursuit of communion with, identity with, or conscious awareness of an ultimate reality, divinity, spiritual truth, or God.

text: Modumedi o nyaka maitemogelo thwii, go kwa, goba go bona ka gare ga bophelo bjo bokgethwa/sekgethwa goba dikgethweng.
text_en: The believer seeks a direct experience, intuition, or insight into divine reality/the deity or dieties.

text: Balatedi ba latela mekgwa ye mengwe ya go phela, goba metlo yeo e lebantšwego go godiša maitemogelo ao.
text_en: Followers pursue certain ways of living, or practices that are intended to nurture those experiences.

text: Bodumedi bja sephiri bo ka fapanywa le mekgwa ye mengwe ya tumelo ya bodumedi le thorišo ka kgatelelo ya yona go maitemogelo a botho a maemo a moswananoši a go temogo, kudu a khutšo, dikgopolo, lethabo, goba mokgwa wa go thaba kudu.
text_en: Mysticism can be distinguished from other forms of religious belief and worship by its emphasis on the direct personal experience of a unique state of consciousness, particularly those of a peaceful, insightful, blissful, or even ecstatic character.

text: Bo-Sikh ke bodumedi go tšwa go kontinente ya ka fasana go la India. E thomile seleteng sa Punjab nakong ya ngwagakgolo wa bo 15 go tšwa go arogeng ga lekala ka gare ga setlogo sa Hindu.
text_en: Sikhism is a religion from the Indian sub-continent. It originated in the Punjab region during the 15th century from a sectarian split within the Hindu tradition.

text: Ma-Sikhs a bona sedumedi sa bona e le seo le aroganego go tšwa go Hinduism le ge ba dumela medu le setlogo tša sona tša se-Hindu.
text_en: Sikhs consider their faith to be a separate religion from Hinduism though they acknowledge its Hindu roots and traditions.

text: Ma-Sikhs a bitša tumelo ya bona Gurmat, yeo e tumilego bakeng sa "tsela ya guru". Guru ke karolo ye kgolo ya ditumelo ka moka tša ma-India efela Sikhism e bohlokwa moo e lego karolo ya motheo ya ditumelo tša Sikh.
text_en: Sikhs call their religion Gurmat, which is Punjabi for "way of the guru". The guru is a fundamental aspect of all Indian religions but in Sikhism has taken on an importance that forms the core of Sikh beliefs.

text: Sedumedi se thomilwe ka ngwagakgolo wa bo 15 ke Guru Nanak (1469–1539). Ka morago gwa latela ka go hlatlama di guru tše dingwe tše senyane.
text_en: The religion was founded in the 15th century by Guru Nanak (1469–1539). There followed in succession a further nine gurus.

text: Le ge go le bjalo, ka June 1956, ditshepišo tša Krushchev di eile tša išwa tekong ge mengwanto go la Poland, moo bašomi ba bego ba gwanta kgahlanong le hlaelelo ya dijo le go fokoletšwa megolo, e ilego ya fetogela go ba mogwanto kgahlanong le Communism.
text_en: However, in June 1956, Krushchev's promises were put to the test when riots in Poland, where workers were protesting against food shortages and wage cuts, turned into a general protest against Communism.

text: Le ge mafelelong, Krushchev a rometša ka ditanka go bošetša molao, o ile a fa tsela go tše dingwe tša dinyakwa tša ekonomi le go dumela go kgetha Wladyslaw Gomulka wa go tsebalega bjalo ka moetapele o moswa.
text_en: Although in the end, Krushchev sent in tanks to restore order, he did give way to some economic demands and agreed to appoint the popular Wladyslaw Gomulka as the new prime minister.

text: Hlabologo ya ma-Indus Valley e be e le hlabologo ya Bronze Age ka leboa-bodikela bja India go dikanetša Pakistan ya sebjalebjale le dilete tše dingwe go la leboa-bohlabela bja India le leboa-bohlabela bja Afghanistan.
text_en: The Indus Valley Civilization was a Bronze Age civilisation in the northwest Indian subcontinent encompassing most of modern-day Pakistan and some regions in northwest India and northeast Afghanistan.

text: Hlabologo e godile gabotse ka meeding ya Noka ya Indus moo e tšerego leina la yona.
text_en: The civilisation flourished in the basins of the Indus River wherefore it derives its name.

text: Le ge ba badi ba dipuku ba bangwe ba gononwa gore ka ge hlabologo le yona e ile ya ba gona ka gare ga meedi ya Noka ya Sarasvati yeo ga bjale e omilego, e swanetše go bitšwa Hlabologo ya Indus-Sarasvati, mola ba bangwe ba e bitša Hlabologo ya Harappan ka morago ga Harappa, lefelo la yona la mathomo la go epollwa ka bo 1920.
text_en: Although some scholars speculate that since the civilisation also existed in the basins of the now dried up Sarasvati River, it should be aptly called the Indus-Sarasvati Civilization, while some call it the Harappan Civilization after Harappa, the first of its sites to be excavated in the 1920s.

text: Hlago ya bošole ya pušo ya Roma e thušitše ka gare ga tšweletšo ya ditšwelopele tša dihlare.
text_en: The militaristic nature of the Roman empire aided in the development of medical advances.

text: Dingaka di thomile go thwalwa ke Mmuši Augustus gomme ešita le go hloma Mekgahlo ya pele ya Roma go dirišwa morago ga ditlamorago tša dintwa.
text_en: Doctors began to be recruited by Emperor Augustus and even formed the first Roman Medical Corps for use in the aftermath of battles.

text: Dingaka tša go bua di be di na le tsebo ya dirobatši tša go fapafapana go akaretša morphine go tšwa go digogwa tša go tšwa go dipeu tša le lomo la mo-poppy le scopolamine go tšwa go dipeu tša herbane.
text_en: Surgeons had knowledge of various sedatives including morphine from extracts of poppy seeds and scopolamine from herbane seeds.

text: Ba kgona go ripa ditho tša mmele go boloka balwetši go tšwa go gangrene gape le tourniquets le arterial claps go emiša kelo ya mmadi.
text_en: They became proficient at amputation to save patients from gangrene as well as tourniquets and arterial clamps to stem blood flow.

text: Go feta mengwagakgolo ye mentši mmušo wa Roman o tlišitše poelo ye kgolo karolong ya dihlare le go hlola tsebo ye ntši yeo re e tsebago lehono.
text_en: Over multiple centuries, the Roman empire led to great gains in the field of medicine and formed much of the knowledge we know today.

text: Origami ya Pureland ke origami ya go ba le dipeeletšo tša gore sehlopa se tee fela se ka dirwa ka nako ye tee, dihlopa tša go hlakahlakana bjalo ka dihlopa tša go boetša morago ga di adumelelwa, gomme dihlopa ka moka di na le mafelo a go lebana thwii.
text_en: Pureland origami is origami with the restriction that only one fold may be done at a time, more complex folds like reverse folds are not allowed, and all folds have straightforward locations.

text: E dirilwe ke John Smith ka bo 1970 go thuša di-folder tšeo di hlokago bokgoni goba bao ba nago le bokgoni bjo bonnyane ka difatanaga.
text_en: It was developed by John Smith in the 1970s to help inexperienced folders or those with limited motor skills.

text: Bana ba ba le temoga ya mathata a morafo e sa le ba bannyane gomme mathata a a morafe a ama maitshwaro a bona.
text_en: Children develop an awareness of race and racial stereotypes quite young and these racial stereotypes affect behavior.

text: Bakeng sa mohlala, bana bao ba ihlathago le morafe wa bonnyane woo o kgethollwago bjalo ka wo o sa šomego gabotse sekolong ba na le  go se šome gabotse sekolong ge ba thoma go ithuta ka kgethollo yeo e tswalwantšhwago le morafe wa bona.
text_en: For instance, children who identify with a racial minority that is stereotyped as not doing well in school tend to not do well in school once they learn about the stereotype associated with their race.

text: MySpace ke wepesaete ya boraro ya go tsebega kudu yeo e šomišwago ka United States gape e na le diphorofaele tše dimilion tše 54 gabjale.
text_en: MySpace is the third most popular website used in the United States and has 54 million profiles currently.

text: Diweposaete tše di hweditše šedi ye ntši, kudu ka lefapeng la thuto.
text_en: These websites have gotten a lot of attention, especially in the education setting.

text: Gona le dintlha tše botse bakeng sa diwepesaete tše, tšeo di akaretšago, go kgona go beakantša ga bonolo letlakala la legoro leo le ka akaretšaga mekero ya inthanete, dibidio, diswantšo, le tše dingwe.
text_en: There are positive aspects to these websites, which include, being able to easily setup a class page which can include blogs, videos, photos, and other features.

text: Letlakala le le ka hwetšwa gabonolo ka go abelana efla ka aterese ya wepesaete, ye e dirago gore gobe bonolo go gopola le bonolo go ngwala pel ga baithuti bao ba nago le mathata a go šomiša sekgotla-maletere goba ga mopeleto.
text_en: This page can easily be accessed by providing just one web address, which makes it easy to remember and easy to type in for students who may have trouble using the keyboard or with spelling.

text: E ka direlwa motho ka noši go e dira gore e balege ga bonolo ebile gape le mmala o montši goba o monnyane go ya le ka moo go nyakegago.
text_en: It can be customized to make it easy to read and also with as much or little color as desired.

text: Bolwetši bja go Hlaelela ka go fa Šedi "ke bolwetši bja tsehpedišo ya methapo ya hlogo bjoo hlaloso ya bona ya kgale e lego boraro bjo tee bja dika go akaretša go akgofega, go go arošega bonolo, mafolofolo a feteletšego goba mafolofolo a go fetišiša".
text_en: Attention Deficit Disorder "is a neurological syndrome whose classic defining triad of symptoms including impulsivity, distractibility, and hyperactivity or excess energy".

text: Ga se bogole bja go ithuta, ke bothata bja go ithuta; bo "ama diperesente tše 3 go iša go 5 tša bana ka moka, mohlomongwa bontši bja dimilion tše 2 tša bana ba ma-Amerika".
text_en: It is not a learning disability, it is a learning disorder; it "affects 3 to 5 percent of all children, perhaps as many as 2 million American children".

text: Bana bao ba nago ke ADD ba swara boima go šetša mošomo wa sekolo, efela ba kgona go šetša dilo tšeo ba ipshinago ka tšona ge ba di dira bjalo ka go raloka dipapadi goba go bogela dipopaye tšeo ba di ratago goba go ngwala mafoko ntle le maswao-dikga.
text_en: Children with ADD have a hard time focusing on things like school work, but they can concentrate on things they enjoy doing like playing games or watching their favorite cartoons or writing sentences without punctuation.

text: Bana ba ba na le go tsena ka gare ga mathata a mantši, ka lebaka la gore ba "itsentšha ka gare ga maitshwaro a kotsi, ba tsena ka gare ga dintwa, gomme ba hlotla molao" go kgona go tutuetša mabjoko a bona, ka ge mabjoko a bona a sa kgone go tutuetšwa ke mekgwa yeo e tlwaelegilego.
text_en: These children tend to get into a lot of trouble, because they "engage in risky behaviors, get into fights, and challenge authority" in order to stimulate their brain, since their brain can not be stimulated by normal methods.

text: ADD e ama dikamano le ditaka tše dingwe ka lebaka la gore bana ba bangwe ga ba kgone go kwešiša gore ke ka lebaka la eng ba iswara ka tsela ye ba iswarago ka gona goba ka lebaka la eng ba peleta ka moo ba peletago ka gona goba gore maemo a bona a go butšwa kgopolong a fapane.
text_en: ADD affects relationships with other peers because other children can not understand why they act the way that they do or why they spell they way they do or that their maturity level is different.

text: Bjale ka ge bokgone bja go hwetša tsebo le go ithuta bo fetogile ka tsela yeo e boletšwego ka godimo lebelo leo ka lona tsebo e bego e hwetšwa le fetogile.
text_en: As the ability to obtain knowledge and to learn changed in such a way as mentioned above the base rate at which knowledge was obtained changed.

text: Thela ya go hwetša tsebišo e be e fapane. Go be go se sana kgathelelo ka gare ga go kgopotšo ya batho, efela bokgone bja go gopola dingwalwa bo bile bjoo o elwago šedi le go feta.
text_en: The approach to obtaining information was different. No longer did pressure reside within individual recall, but the ability to recall text became more of a focus.

text: Gabotsebotse, Tsošološo e dirile phetogo e kgolo go tsela yeo go ithutwago ka gona le tshepedišo ya tsebo.
text_en: In essence, the Renaissance made a significant change in the approach to learning and the dissemination of knowledge.

text: Go fapana le dikgabo tše dingwe, ditšhwene ga di sa šomiša matsogo a tšona go sepela goba go rwala boima goba go fofa mehlareng.
text_en: Unlike other primates, hominids no longer use their hands in locomotion or bearing weight or swinging through the trees.

text: Letsogo le leoto la chimpanzee le a swana ka tekano le botelele, go laetša tšhomišo ya letsogo sa go rwala boima ge e sepela e kwatame.
text_en: The chimpanzee's hand and foot are similar in size and length, reflecting the hand's use for bearing weight in knuckle walking.

text: Letsogo la motho ke le le kopana go geta letsogo, ka di phalanges tša go se kgopame.
text_en: The human hand is shorter than the foot, with straighter phalanges.

text: Marapo a letsogo la Fossil mengwaga ye dimilion tše pedi go iša go tše tharo e bontša šefte ye ka go ikgetha ga letsogo go tšwa go šuthišeng go ya go phetolelong.
text_en: Fossil hand bones two million to three million years old reveal this shift in specialization of the hand from locomotion to manipulation.

text: Batho ba bangwe ba dumela gore go itemogela ditoro tša maitirelo tša go ba molaleng gantši go a lapiša.
text_en: Some people believe that experiencing many artificially induced lucid dreams often enough can be very exhausting.

text: Lebaka le legolo la kgopolo ye ke poelo ya ditoro tšeo o nago le taolo ya tšona tša go oketša botelele bja nako gare ga maemo a REM.
text_en: The main reason for this phenomenon is the result of the lucid dreams expanding the length of time between REM states.

text: Ka di REM tšeo di fokotšegilego bakeng sa bošego bjo bongwe le bjo bongwe, maemo ao go ona o tlogago o itemogela go robala ga nnete gomme mmele wa gago wa kaonafala goba go go tlwaelegego go thoma go ba bothata.
text_en: With fewer REMs per night, this state in which you experience actual sleep and your body recovers becomes infrequent enough to become a problem.

text: Se se no lapiša tše ekarego o tlo tsoga metsotso ye masomepedi goba masometharo a mangwe le a mangwe go lebelela TV.
text_en: This is just as exhausting as if you were to wake up every twenty or thirty minutes and watch TV.

text: Katlego e ya le gore ke ga kae moo bjoko bja gago bo lekago go lora ka nnete bošegong bo tee.
text_en: The effect is dependent on how often your brain attempts to lucidly dream per night.

text: Dilo ga se tša sepela botse bakeng sa ma-Italian ka Leboa la Afrika go tloga mathomong. Ka beke fela ya pego ya ntwa ya Italy ka June 10, 1940, British 11th Hussars e be e thopile Fort Capuzzo ka Libya.
text_en: Things did not go well for the Italians in North Africa almost from the start. Within a week of Italy's declaration of war on June 10, 1940, the British 11th Hussars had seized Fort Capuzzo in Libya.

text: Hlaselong ya bohlabela bja Bardia, ma Britain a tswere Moentšenere o Mogolo wa Bošole bja Bolesome bja Italy, General Lastucci.
text_en: In an ambush east of Bardia, the British captured the Italian Tenth Army's Engineer-in-Chief, General Lastucci.

text: Ka di 28 June, Marshal Italo Balbo, Molaodipharephare wa Libya le mojalefa wa Mussolini, o bolailwe ke mollo ge a fologa sefofane Tobruk.
text_en: On June 28, Marshal Italo Balbo, the Governor-General of Libya and apparent heir to Mussolini, was killed by friendly fire while landing in Tobruk.

text: Papadi ya sebjalebjale ya go bitšwa fencing e ralokwa mamanogeng a mantši, go tšwa go baithuti ba ithuta yunibesiti go ya go setsebi le phadišano ya Olympic.
text_en: The modern sport of fencing is played at many levels, from students learning at a university to professional and Olympic competition.

text: Papadi e ralokwa ka mokgwa wa bobedi, wa legoreng o tee o mongwe a le raloka le yena.
text_en: The sport is primarily played in a duel format, one fencer dueling another.

text: Golf ke taloko yeo dibapadi di šomišago sa go betha go bethela dinkgokolwana ka gare ga melete.
text_en: Golf is a game in which players use clubs to hit balls into holes.

text: Melete ye lesomeseswai e ralokilwe ka nako ya mehla, dibapadi di thoma go molete wa pele seemong gomme di fetša go wa bo lesomeseswai.
text_en: Eighteen holes are played during a regular round, with players usually starting on the first hole on the course and finishing on the eighteenth.

text: Sebapadi seo se tšeago di stroke tše mmalwa, goba di swing tša sehlopa, go fetša papadi se a fenya.
text_en: The player who takes the fewest strokes, or swings of the club, to complete the course wins.

text: Papadi e ralokwa godimo ga mabjang, gomme mabjang go rarela mošoba a ripelwa fasana gomme a bitšwa botala.
text_en: The game is played on grass, and the grass around the hole is mown shorter and called the green.

text: Mohlomongwe mohuta wa boeti bja go tlwaelaga ke seo bontši bja batho ba bo tswalanyago le boeti: Boeti bja Boithabišo.
text_en: Perhaps the most common type of tourism is what most people associate with traveling: Recreation tourism.

text: Se ke ge batho ba eya lefelong leo le fapanego kudu go tšwa go bophelo bja bona bja go tlwaelega bja tšatši-ka-tšatši gomme ba ipšhina.
text_en: This is when people go to a place that is very different from their regular day-to-day life to relax and have fun.

text: Mabopo, diphaka tša maina le mafelo a dikampa gantši e ba mafelo a go tlwaelega a go etelwa gantši ke baeti.
text_en: Beaches, theme parks and camp grounds are often the most common places frequented by recreational tourists.

text: Ge e ba nepo ya yoo a etelago lefelo le itšego ke go nyaka go tseba histori le setšo sa lona gona mohuta wo wa ketelo o tsebega bjalo ka boeti bja setšo.
text_en: If the objective of one’s visit to a particular place is to get to know its history and culture then this type of tourism is known as cultural tourism.

text: Baeti ba ka etela mafelo a go tsebalega a go fapafapana a naga ye itšego goba ba ka no kgetha go lebelela lefelo le tee fela.
text_en: Tourists may visit different landmarks of a particular country or they may simply opt to focus on just one area.

text: Ma-colonist, ka go bona tiragalo ye, ba ile ba bitša matlafatšo.
text_en: The Colonists, seeing this activity, had also called for reinforcements.

text: Madira a matlafatša maemo a pele go be go akaretša dihlopa tša 1 le 3 tša New Hampshire tša banna ba 200, ka fase ga Kolonel John Stark le James Reed (bobedi ka morago bo beile balodi).
text_en: Troops reinforcing the forward positions included the 1st and 3rd New Hampshire regiments of 200 men, under Colonels John Stark and James Reed (both later became generals).

text: Banna ba Stark ba tšere maemo kgauswi le legora mafeleleong a leboa la maemo a Colonist.
text_en: Stark's men took positions along the fence on the north end of the Colonist's position.

text: Ge pulego ya fasana e bula sekgoba kgauswi le Noka ya Mystic kgauswi le leboabohlabela bja peninsula, ba ile ba pakišetše go oketša legora le le kopana la maswika go ya leboa go felelela mafelelong ameetse godimo ga lebopo le lennyane.
text_en: When low tide opened a gap along the Mystic River along the northeast of the peninsula, they quickly extended the fence with a short stone wall to the north ending at the water's edge on a small beach.

text: Gridley goba Stark ba beile setseka tekano ya maoto a 100 (30 m) pele ga legora gomme ba laetša gore go se be le yo a thuntšago go fihla batlwaelegi ba le feta.
text_en: Gridley or Stark placed a stake about 100 feet (30 m) in front of the fence and ordered that no one fire until the regulars passed it.

text: Leano la America le ithekgile ka go hlomamiša dihlaselo tšeo di beakantšwego go tšwa mafelong a mararo a go fapana.
text_en: The American plan relied on launching coordinated attacks from three different directions.

text: Moalodi John Cadwalder a ka thomiša hlaselo ya go arogantša kgahlanong le sehlopa sa mašole a Britain go la Bordentown, e le go thibela matlafatšo yengwe le yengwe.
text_en: General John Cadwalder would launch a diversionary attack against the British garrison at Bordentown, in order to block off any reinforcements.

text: Molaodi James Ewing a ka tšea bahlanani ba tšhoganetšo ba 700 go ya go tsela noka go la Trenton ferry, ba thopa leporogo la godimo ga Assunpink Creek gomme ba thibela madira a mangwe le a mangwe a manaba gore ba se ke ba tšaba.
text_en: General James Ewing would take 700 militia across the river at Trenton Ferry, seize the bridge over the Assunpink Creek and prevent any enemy troops from escaping.

text: Madira a hlaselo a banna ba 2,400 a tla tshela noka di mile tše senyane go ya leboa la Trenton, gomme a arogana ka dihlopa tše pedi, se tee ka fase ga Greene gomme se tee ka fase ga Sullivan, gore ba kgone go hlasela pele lehlaba.
text_en: The main assault force of 2,400 men would cross the river nine miles north of Trenton, and then split into two groups, one under Greene and one under Sullivan, in order to launch a pre-dawn attack.

text: Ka phetogo ya go tšwa go kotara go ya go go kitima ga seripa sa mile, lebelo ga e sa le selo se bohlokwa gomme kgotlelelo e ba hloko ya go felelela.
text_en: With the change from the quarter to the half mile run, speed becomes of much less importance and endurance becomes an absolute necessity.

text: Ka nnete mokitimi wa mile wa seripa wa maemo a pele, monna yoo a ka kgonago metsotso ye mebedi, o swanetše go ba le tekano ya maleba ya lebelo, efela kgotlelelo e swanetše gore e betlwe ka maswao ka moka.
text_en: Of course a first-class half-miler, a man who can beat two minutes, must be possessed of a fair amount of speed, but endurance must be cultivated at all hazards.

text: Mabelo a mangwe a go tshelaganya naga ka marega, a hlakantšwe le mošomo wa gymnasium bakeng sa karolo ya ka godimo ya mmele, ke tokišetšo ye kaone bakeng sa sehla sa go kitima.
text_en: Some cross country running during the winter, combined with gymnasium work for the upper part of the body, is the best preparation for the running season.

text: Mekgwa ya phepo ye kaone e le tee e ka se kgone go tšweletša go kgona go go kaone, efela e ka ama go phela gabotse go go feleletšego ga dibapadi tše di nnyane.
text_en: Proper nutritional practices alone cannot generate elite performances, but they can significantly affect young athletes' overall wellness.

text: Go boloka tekanyo yeo e phelegilego ya enetši, go ithuta mekgwa ye mekaone ya go dula o na le meetse, le go kwešiša dikarolo tša go fapana tša mekgwa ya go emela ye mengwe go ka thuša boramabelo go kaonafatša mešomo ya bona le go oketša go ipshina ga bona ka papadi.
text_en: Maintaining a healthy energy balance, practicing effective hydration habits, and understanding the various aspects of supplementation practices can help athletes improve their performance and increase their enjoyment of the sport.

text: Go kitima sekgobeng sa gare ke papadi yeo e sa bitšego; le ge go le bjalo, go na le dikgopolo tše dintši tše di fošagetšego mabapi le diripa tše mmalwa tša sedirišwa seo se nyakegago go tšea karolo.
text_en: Middle distance running is a relatively inexpensive sport; however, there are many misconceptions regarding the few pieces of equipment required to participate.

text: Di dirišwa di ka rekwa ka ge di hlokega, efela bontši bo tla ba le kgomo ye nnyane goba bo ka se be le yona lega tee go tiragatšo.
text_en: Products can be purchased as needed, but most will have little or no real impact on performance.

text: Dibapadi di ka ikwela di nyaka setšweletšwa le ge se sa tšweletši meputso ya nnete.
text_en: Athletes may feel that they prefer a product even when it provides no real benefits.

text: Atom e ka tšeiwa bjalo ka yengwe ya dipoloko tše bohlokwa tša go aga ka gare ga dilo ka moka.
text_en: The atom can be considered to be one of the fundamental building blocks of all matter.

text: Ke entite ya go hlakahlakana yeo e nago, go ya ka modele wo o nolofaditšwego wa Bohr, le bogare bja nucleus bjo bo dukulogilego ke dielektron, tša go nyaka go swana le dipolanete tša go dukuluga letšatši - bona Seswantšho 1.1.
text_en: Its a very complex entity which consists, according to a simplified Bohr model, of a central nucleus orbited by electrons, somewhat similar to planets orbiting the sun - see Figure 1.1.

text: Di nucleus di na le dikarolo tše pedi - di neutrons le di protons.
text_en: The nucleus consists of two particles - neutrons and protons.

text: Diprotone di na le tšweletšo ye posetifi mohlagase mola di neutrons di se ne tšweletšo. Di electron di na le tšweletšo ye negetifi ya mohlagase.
text_en: Protons have a positive electric charge while neutrons have no charge. The electrons have a negative electric charge.

text: Go Hlola motšwasehlabelo, o swanetše o lebelele pele lefelo la go netefatša polokego ya gago.
text_en: To Check the victim, you must first survey the scene to ensure your safety.

text: O swanetše o hlokomele maemo a mohlokofatšwa ge o thoma go mmatamela ga mmogo le dilo tše dingwe tša go makatša.
text_en: You need to notice the victim's position as you approach him or her and any automatic red flags.

text: Ge o ka gobala o leka go thuša, o ka dira gore dilo di senyege le go feta.
text_en: If you get hurt trying to help, you may only serve to make matters worse.

text: Thuto e hweditše gore kgathelelo ya mokgopolo, letšhogo le hlakahlakano go tšweletš kamano gare ga bohloko le go bao ba nago le bogolofadi bja bohloko bja ka fasana ga mokokotlo.
text_en: The study found that depression, fear and catastrophising mediated the relationship between pain and disability in lower back pain sufferers.

text: Ke ditlamorago fela tša masetlapelo, e sego kgatelelo ya monagano le letšhogo tšeo di bego e le tša peelano ya dikopano tša PA tše dintši beke ka beke.
text_en: Only the effects of catastrophizing, not depression and fear was conditional of regular weekly structured PA sessions.

text: Bao ba tšeago karolo ka gare ga ditiragalo tša ka mehla ba hlokile thekgo yengwe ka tebelelo ye mpe ya bohloko ya go pharologanya dipapano tša bohloko bja bolwetši bja go se fole le go se ikwele ba dudišegile goo go tšwago go sepeleng ga go tlwaelega.
text_en: Those participating in regular activity required more support in terms of negative perception of pain distinguishing the differences of chronic pain and discomfort feel from normal physical movement.

text: Pono, goba go kgona go bona go ya le ka tshepedišo ya go bona ya ditho tša go bona goba mahlo.
text_en: Vision, or the ability to see depends on visual system sensory organs or eyes.

text: Gona le go agega go gontši ga mahlo, go tloga go kopakopano go ya le ka dinyakwa tša sephedi.
text_en: There are many different constructions of eyes, ranging in complexity depending on the requirements of the organism.

text: Mekgwa ya go aga ya go fapana e na le makgone a go fapana, e kgomega ka go fapanego ga mahlakore a botelele gomme e na le dikgata tša go fapana tša bokopana, gape e hloka ditshepedišo tše itšego ya go se tswane ya go fa kgopolo ya thokelo le dipalo tša go fapana gore e šome gabotse.
text_en: The different constructions have different capabilities, are sensitive to different wave-lengths and have differing degrees of acuity, also they require different processing to make sense of the input and different numbers to work optimally.

text: Tlalo ya diphedi ke kgoboketšo ya diphedi tša mohuta o itšego ka gare ga lefelo leo le filwego.
text_en: A population is the collection of organisms of a particular species within a given geographic area.

text: Ge batho ka moka setšhabeng ba swana ka seka se itšego sa phenotypic ba tsebega bjalo ka monomorphic.
text_en: When all individuals in a population are identical with regard to a particular phenotypic trait they are known as monomorphic.

text: Ge batho ba bontša diphapano tva go fapana tša seka se itšego ba polymorphic.
text_en: When the individuals show several variants of a particular trait they are polymorphic.

text: Dihlopa tša madira a ditšotši a gwanta gomme a dula mafelong a go fapfapana.
text_en: Army ant colonies march and nest in different phases as well.

text: Nakong ya bahloka-šope, madira a mašole a gwanta bošego gomme a kampa mosegare.
text_en: In the nomadic phase, army ants march at night and stop to camp during the day.

text: Koloni e thoma lemanoga la nomadic ge dijo tša goba gona di fokotšegile. Nakong ya lemanoga le, koloni e dira dihlara tša nakwana tšeo di fetolwago letšatši ka letšatši.
text_en: The colony begins a nomadic phase when available food has decreased. During this phase, the colony makes temporary nests that are changed everyday.

text: O mongwe le o mongwe wa mpherefere ye ya go se laolege goba megwanto e ba gona tekano ya matšatši a 17.
text_en: Each of these nomadic rampages or marches lasts for approximately 17 days.

text: Sele ke eng? Lentšu le sele le tšwa go lentšu la se Latin "cella", leo le bolelago gore "phaphuši ye nnyane", gomme le dirilwe pele ke microscopist yo a bego a lebeletše sebopego sa poropo.
text_en: What is a cell? The word cell comes from the Latin word "cella", meaning "small room", and it was first coined by a microscopist observing the structure of cork.

text: Sele ke uniti ya motheo ya tšeo di phelago ka moka, gomme diphedi di dirilwe ka sele ye tee goba go feta.
text_en: The cell is the basic unit of all living things, and all organisms are composed of one or more cells.

text: Disele ke motheo gape di bohlokwa kudu go thuto ya bophelo, ka therešo, gantši di bitšwa "dikarolo tša go aga bophelo".
text_en: Cells are so basic and critical to the study of life, in fact, that they are often referred to as "the building blocks of life".

text: Tshepedišo ya Methapo e hlokomela homeostasis ka go romela go betha ka methapo ka gare ga mmele go re go ela ga madi go dule go le gona le go re go se šitišege.
text_en: The Nervous System maintains homeostasis by sending nerve impulses through out the body to keep the flow of blood going as well as undisturbed.

text: Ditutuetšo tše tša methapo di ka romelwa ka ponyo-ya-leihlo godimo ga mmele ka moka tšeo di thušago go boloka mmele kgahlanong le kgonagalo ya tšhošetše.
text_en: These nerve impulses can be sent so quickly throughout the body which helps keep the body safe from any potential threat.

text: Dithonado di betha lefelo le lenyane ge go bapetšwa le madimo a mangwe a šoro, efela di ka senya tšhohle tseleng ya tšona.
text_en: Tornadoes strike a small area compared to other violent storms, but they can destroy everything in their path.

text: Dithonado di epolla mehlare, tša gagolantšha diporoto godimo ga meago, gomme tša fofišetša difatanaga godimo leratadimeng. Diperesente tše pedi tša dithonado tše šoro kudu di tšea tekano ya go feta diiri tše tharo.
text_en: Tornadoes uproot trees, rip boards from buildings, and fling cars up into the sky. The most violent two percent of tornadoes last more than three hours.

text: Madimo a a makgema a hudugetše go ya go 480 km/h (133 m/s; 300 mph).
text_en: These monster storms have winds up to 480 km/h (133 m/s; 300 mph).

text: Batho ba be ba šomiša dikgalase bakeng sa go bonela kgauswi bakeng sa makgolo le makgolo a mengwaga.
