text_en: Humans have been making and using lenses for magnification for thousands and thousands of years.

text: Efela, diteleskopo tša nnete tša mathomo di dirilwe go la Yuropa go ya mafelelong a ngwagakgolo wa bo 16.
text_en: However, the first true telescopes were made in Europe in the late 16th century.

text: Ditheleskoupu tše di šomošitše hlakanyo ya dikgalase tše pedi go dira gore selo sa kgole se bonale se le kgauswi e le se segolo.
text_en: These telescopes used a combination of two lenses to make distant objects appear both nearer and larger.

text: Megabaru le go inaganela ka noši go tla dula go na le rena gomme ke hlago ya tšhomišano-mmogo gore ge bontši bo holega go tla dula go na le go gontši goo go ka hwetšwago nakong ye nnyane ka go inaganela ka noši
text_en: Greed and selfishness will always be with us and it is the nature of cooperation that when the majority benefit there will always be more to gain in the short term by acting selfishly

text: Ka kholofelo, bontši bja batho ba tla lemoga gore monyetla wa bona o mo kaone wa lebaka le le telele ke go šoma mmogo le ba bangwe.
text_en: Hopefully, most people will realise that their long term best option is to work together with others.

text: Batho ba bantši ba lora ka letšatši leo batho ba kgonago go ya polaneteng yenngwe gomme ba bona mafase a mangwe, batho ba bangwe ba ipotšiša gore ke eng ka ntle seo ba bangwe ba dumelago gore di-alien goba bophelo bjo bongwe bo ka ba gona polaneteng yenngwe.
text_en: Many people dream of the day when humans can travel to another star and explore other worlds, some people wonder what's out there some belive that aliens or other life may live on another plant.

text: Efela, ge se se ka tsoga sa direga mohlomongwe se ka se direge bakeng sa lebaka le le telele. Dinaledi di phatlaletše kudu moo go nago le sekgoba sa dimaele tše trillion gare ga dinaledi tšeo e lego "baagišane".
text_en: But, if this ever does happen probably won't happen for a very long time. The stars are so spread out that there are trillions of miles between stars that are "neighbors".

text: Mohlomongwe ka letšatši le lengwe, ditlogolokhukhu tša gago di tla ba di eme pele ga lefase la di-alien ba ipotšiša ka badimo ba bona ba kgalekgale.
text_en: Maybe one day, your great grandchildren will be standing atop an alien world wondering about their ancient ancestors?

text: Diphoofolo di dirilwe ka disele tše dintši. Dija dilo gomme tše di šilaganya ka gare. Diphoofolo tše dintši di kgona go sepela.
text_en: Animals are made of many cells. They eat things and digest them inside. Most animals can move.

text: Ke diphoofolo fela di nago le bjoko (le ge e le gore ga se diphoofolo kamoka; jellyfish, ka mohlala, ga e na bjoko).
text_en: Only animals have brains (though not even all animals do; jellyfish, for example, do not have brains).

text: Diphoofolo di hwetšwa gohle lefaseng. Di epa fase, tša rutha ka mawatleng, gomme tša fofa lefaufaung.
text_en: Animals are found all over the earth. They dig in the ground, swim in the oceans, and fly in the sky.

text: Sele ke thulaganyo le tšhomo ye nnyanennyane ya uniti ya sephedi (dilo).
text_en: A cell is the smallest structural and functional unit of a living (things) organism.

text: Lentšu la sele le tšwa go lentšu la Latin la cella leo le rago gore kamora ye nnyane.
text_en: Cell comes from the Latin word cella which means small room.

text: Ge o ka lebelela dilo tša go phela ka fase ga maekrosko, o tla bona gore di dirilwe ka disekwere goba dibolo tše nnyane.
text_en: If you look at living things under a microscope, you will see that they are made of small squares or balls.

text: Robert Hooke, rathutaphedi go tšwa England, o bone disekwere tše nnyane ka gare ga poropo ka mikrosekoupo.
text_en: Robert Hooke, a biologist from England, saw small squares in cork with a microscope.

text: Di lebelega bjalo ka diphaphuši. Ke motho wa mathomo wa go bona di sele tša go hwa.
text_en: They looked like rooms. He was the first person to observe dead cells

text: Dielement le diripa di ka šuta go tloga nageng ye tee go ya go yenngwe gomme tša se fetoge.
text_en: Elements and compounds can move from one state to another and not change.

text: Nitrogen bjalo ka kgase e sa na le didirišwa tša go swana le tša nitrogen ya meetse. Maemo a seela ke a makoto efela dikarolwana di sa swana.
text_en: Nitrogen as a gas still has the same properties as liquid nitrogen. The liquid state is denser but the molecules are still the same.

text: Meetse ke mohlala o mongwe. Meetse a go ya godimo a dirilwe ka di hydrogen atoms tše pedi le oxygen atom ye tee.
text_en: Water is another example. The compound water is made up of two hydrogen atoms and one oxygen atom.

text: E na le sebopego sa go tswana sa molecular go sa kgathalege gore ke kgase, seela, goba sa go tia.
text_en: It has the same molecular structure whether it is a gas, liquid, or solid.

text: Le ge boemo bja yona bo ka fetoga, boemo bja yona bja khemikale bo dula bo tswana.
text_en: Although its physical state may change, its chemical state remains the same.

text: Nako ke selo seo se lego gona gohle mo re bego, gomme e ama tšhohle tše re di dirago, efela e bothata go e kwešiša.
text_en: Time is something that is all around us, and affects everything we do, yet is difficult to understand.

text: Nako e ithutetšwe ke dibadi tša sedumedi, filosofi, le saentshebakeng sa mengwaga ye diketekete.
text_en: Time has been studied by religious, philosophical, and scientific scholars for thousands of years.

text: Re itemogela nako bjalo ka tatelano ya ditiragalo tša go feta go tšwa bokamosong go ya go lehono go ya go maloba.
text_en: We experience time as a series of events passing from the future through the present to the past.

text: Nako ke gape ka moo re bapetšago nako (botelele) bja ditiragalo.
text_en: Time is also how we compare the duration (length) of events.

text: O ka maraka go feta ga nako ka bo wena ka go lebelela poeletša ya tiragalo. Poeletšo ya tiragalo ke se sengwe seo se diregago gape le gape makga a mantši.
text_en: You can mark the passing of time yourself by observing the repetition of a cyclical event. A cyclical event is something that happens again and again regularly.

text: Dikhomphuthara lehono di šomišwa go laola dinepe le dibiteo.
text_en: Computers today are used to manipulate pictures and videos.

text: Dipopae tšeo di hlabologilego di ka dirwa godimo ga di khomphuta, gomme mohuta wo wa dipopae o šomišwa ka go oketšega mo thelebišeneng le difiliming.
text_en: Sophisticated animations can be constructed on computers, and this kind of animation is increasingly being used in television and films.

text: Mmino o gatišwa gantši go šomišwa dikhomphuthara tša go hlakahlakantšha go sepediša le go hlakanya medumo mmogo.
text_en: Music is often recorded using sophisticated computers to process and mix sounds together.

text: Bakeng sa nako ye telele nakong ya mengwaga ya bo lesomesenyane le masomepedi, go be go dumelwa gore baagi ba pele ba New Zealand e be e le batho ba Maori, bao ba bego ba tsoma dinonyane tše di kgolokgolo tša go bitšwa moas.
text_en: For a long time during the nineteenth and twentieth centuries, it was believed the first inhabitants of New Zealand were the Maori people, who hunted giant birds called moas.

text: Theory yeo ka morago ya tšweletša mogopolo wa gore batho ba ma-Maori ba hudugile go tšwa Polynesia ka Great Fleet gomme ba tšea New Zealand go tšwa go ma-Moriori, ba thoma setšhaba sa tša temo.
text_en: The theory then established the idea that the Maori people migrated from Polynesia in a Great Fleet and took New Zealand from the Moriori, establishing an agricultural society.

text: Efela, bohlatse bjo boswa bo šišinya gore Moriori e be e le sehlopa sa ka gare ga naga sa Maori seo se tlogilego go tšwa New Zealand go ya Dihlakahlakeng tša Chatham, sa dira setšo sa sona sa go ikgetha, sa khutšo.
text_en: However, new evidence suggests that the Moriori were a group of mainland Maori who migrated from New Zealand to the Chatham Islands, developing their own distinctive, peaceful culture.

text: Gobe gape go na le moloko o mongwe go dihlakahlaka tša Chatham ye e be e le Maori woo o hudugilego go tšwa New Zealand.
text_en: There was also another tribe on the Chatham islands these were Maori who migrated away from New Zealand.

text: Ba ipeditše ma-Moriori go ba go na le ma-skirmishes a mmalwa gomme mafelelong, ma-Moriori a tlošwa.
text_en: They called themselves the Moriori there were a few skirmishes and in the end, the Moriori were wiped out

text: Batho bao ba bego ba amega bakeng sa mengwagangwaga ba re thušitše go rata maatla a rena le tšeo re di ratago mola ba lekola maima le go palelwa.
text_en: Individuals who had been involved for several decades helped us appreciate our strengths and passions while candidly assessing difficulties and even failures.

text: Ge re theeleditše batho ba bolela ka dikanegelo tša bona, malapa le mekgahlo ya bona, re hwetša lesedi ka gare ga tšeo di fetilego le ka ga batho ba bangwe bao ba hueditšego go loka goba go senyega ga setšo sa mokgahlo
text_en: While listening to individuals share their individual, family, and organizational stories, we gained valuable insight into the past and some of the personalities who influenced for good or ill the culture of the organization.

text: Le ge go kwešiša histori ya motho yo mongwe go sa akanye gore o kwešiša setšo, gantši e thuša batho go ba le hlaloganyo ya gore ba wela kae mo historing ya mokgatlo.
text_en: While understanding one’s history does not assume understanding of culture, it does at least help people gain a sense of where they fall within the history of the organization.

text: Ge go lebelelwa katlego le go ba le maitemogelo a go palelwa, batho le batho ka moka bao ba tšeago karolo ba hwetša boleng, morero, di maatla a ditšhutšumetšo tša go tsenelela tša mokgahlo.
text_en: While assessing the successes and becoming aware of failures, individuals and the whole of the participating persons discover more deeply the values, mission, and driving forces of the organization.

text: Lebakeng le, go gopola makgetlo a go feta a maitshwaro a tša kgwebo le dipoelo tša dikatlego go thušitše batho gore ba bulege bakeng sa diphetogo tše diswa le ditsela tše diswa bakeng sa kereke ya gae.
text_en: In this instance, recalling previous instances of entrepreneurial behavior and resulting successes helped people to be open to new changes and new direction for the local church.

text: Dikanegelo tše bjale tša katlego di fokoditše poifo ya phetogo, mola di hlola ditumo tše dintši go lebiša go phetogo bokamosong.
text_en: Such success stories lessened the fears of change, while creating positive inclinations toward change in the future.

text: Mekgwa ya kgopolo yeo e kopanago ke mekgwa ya go rarolla bothata yeo e amanyago dikgopolo tša go fapana goba mafelo a go hwetša tharollo.
text_en: Convergent thinking patterns are problem solving techniques that unite different ideas or fields to find a solution.

text: Morero wa kgopolo ye ke lebelo, go ganana le go nepa, gape le go tseba dintlha, go diriša gape mekgwa, go kgoboketša tsebišo.
text_en: The focus of this mindset is speed, logic and accuracy, also identification of facts, reapplying existing techniques, gathering information.

text: Se bohlokwa kudu ka mogopolo wa ke: go na le karabo yeo e nepagetšego ye tee fela. O ka nagana ka dikarabo tše pedi fela, tšeo e le go yeo e nepagetšego le yeo e fošagetšego.
text_en: The most important factor of this mindset is: there is only one correct answer. You only think of two answers, namely right or wrong.

text: Mohuta wo wa go nagana o tswalantšwa le saentshea itšego goba tshepedišo ya go tlwaelega.
text_en: This type of thinking is associated with certain science or standard procedures.

text: Batho ba goba le mohuta wo wa go gopola ba na megopolo ya go kwagala, ba kgona go gopola diphethene, go rarabolla mathata le go šoma ka diteko tša thutahlale.
text_en: People with this type of thinking have logical thinking, are able to memorize patterns, solve problems and work on scientific tests.

text: Batho go fihla ga bjale ke bona mehuta ya diphedi tše di nago le talente ye kgolo ya go bala megopolo ya ba bangwe.
text_en: Humans are by far the most talented species in reading the minds of others.

text: Seo  se ra gore re kgona go nagana ka katlego  gore batho ba bangwe ba nagana eng, ba ikemišeditše eng, ba dumela eng, ba tseba eng goba ba duma eng.
text_en: That means we are able to successfully predict what other humans perceive, intend, believe, know or desire.

text: Gare ga makgoni a, go kwešiša maikemišetšo a batho ba bangwe go bohlokwa kudu. Go re thuša go rarabolla go sekwešiše go go ka bago gona ga magatho a mmele.
text_en: Among these abilities, understanding the intention of others is crucial. It allows us to resolve possible ambiguities of physical actions.

text: Bakeng sa mohlala, ge o be o ka bona motho o mongwe a roba lefasetere la safatanaga, o ka tloga o nagana gore o leka go utswa safatanaga ya motho wo a sa mo tsebego.
text_en: For example, if you were to see someone breaking a car window, you would probably assume he was trying to steal a stranger’s car.

text: O be a tlo ahlolwa ka go fapanego ge nkabe a lahlegetšwe ke dinotlelo tša safatanaga ya gagwe gomme e be e le safatanaga ya gagwe yeo a bego a leka go e pšhatla.
text_en: He would need to be judged differently if he had lost his car keys and it was his own car that he was trying to break into.

text: MRI e ikeme ka karolo ya physics yeo e bitšwago modumo wa magnete wa nuclear (NMR), yeo e hweditšwego ka bo 1930 ke Felix Bloch (a bereka Yunibesithi ya Stanford) lr Edward Purcell (wa go tšwa Yunibesithi ya Havard).
text_en: MRI is based on a physics phenomenon called nuclear magnetic resonance (NMR), which was discovered in the 1930s by Felix Bloch (working at Stanford University) and Edward Purcell (from Harvard University).

text: Ka go galagatša modumo wo, lefelo la makenete le maphoto a sealemoya di hlola di atoms tša go fa ditšhupo tše nnyane tša sealemoya.
text_en: In this resonance, magnetic field and radio waves cause atoms to give off tiny radio signals.

text: Ka ngwaga wa 1970, Raymond Damadian, ngaka ya tša maphelo le monyakišiši wa tša mahlale, o hweditše motheo bakeng sa go šomiša bonagantšo ya modumo wa magenete bjalo ka sedirišwa bakeng la hlahlobo ya tša tša maphelo.
text_en: In the year 1970, Raymond Damadian, a medical doctor and research scientist, discovered the basis for using magnetic resonance imaging as a tool for medical diagnosis.

text: Mengwaga ye mene ka morago sehlare se dumeletšwe, seo e bego e le sehlare sa mathoto sa lefase seo se filwego lefapeng la MRI.
text_en: Four years later a patent was granted, which was the world's first patent issued in the field of MRI.

text: Ka 1977, Ngk. Damaduan o feditše go dira tebeledišišo ya pele ya "mmele-ka moka", yeo a e biditšego "Indomitable".
text_en: In 1977, Dr. Damadian completed the construction of the first “whole-body” MRI scanner, which he called the ”Indomitable”.

text: Poledišano yeo e ikemego e hlohleletša nako ya go inaganišiša le go arabela go ba bangwe.
text_en: Asynchronous communication encourages time for reflection and reaction to others.

text: E dumelela baithuti bokgone bja go šoma ka lebelo la bona le go laola lebelo la tsebešo ya ditaelo.
text_en: It allows students the ability to work at their own pace and control the pace of instructional information.

text: Go tlaleletša, go na le dipeelo tše nnyane tša nako tša kgonagalo ya diiri tša go šoma tša go kobega. (Bremer, 1998)
text_en: In addition, there are fewer time restrictions with the possibility of flexible working hours. (Bremer, 1998)

text: Tšhomišo ya inthanete le Wepo ya Lefase ka Bophara e dumelela barutwana go hwetša tshedimošo ka dinako ka moka.a.
text_en: The use of the Internet and the World Wide Web allows learners to have access to information at all times.

text: Baithuti ba iša gape dipotšišo go bahlahli nako yengwe le yengwe ya letšatši gomme ba letele dikarabelo tša ka pele ka moo go ka kgonegago, go na le go ema go fihla nakong yeo e sa tlo tlago ya kopano ya go bonana-ka-sebele.
text_en: Students can also submit questions to instructors at any time of day and expect reasonably quick responses, rather than waiting until the next face-to-face meeting.

text: Tsela ya ka morago ga sebjalebjale ya go ithuta e abelana ka tokologo go bao ba feleletšego. ga go tsela ye tee ye botse ya go ithuta.
text_en: The postmodern approach to learning offers the freedom from absolutes. There is no one good way to learn.

text: Gabotsebotse, ga go selo se sebotse se se tee seo motho a ka ithutago sona. Go ithuta go direga mong maitemogelo a magareng ga moithuti le tsebo yeo e fiwago.
text_en: In fact, there is not one good thing to learn.Learning takes place in the experience between the learner and the knowledge presented.

text: Maitemogelo a rena a bjale le polelo ya go itirela le tshedimušo, diswantšhetšo tša thuto ya thelebišeneng di šupetša ntlha ye.
text_en: Our current experience with all the do-it-yourself and information presenting, learning-based television shows illustrates this point.

text: Bontši bja rena re ikhwetša re lebeletše lenaneo la telebišene leo le re tsebišago ka tshepetšo yeo goba maitemogelo ao re ka se tsogilego re tšere karolo ka gare gawona goba ra šomiša tsebo yeo.
text_en: So many of us find ourselves watching a television show that informs us of a process or experience in which we will never participate or apply that knowledge.

text: Re ka se tsoge ra fetola safatanaga, ra aga mothopo ba morago ga jarata ya rena, ra etela Peru go lebelela mašope a kgale, goba ra mpšhafatša ntlo ya moagišane wa rena.
text_en: We will never overhaul a car, build a fountain in our backyard, travel to Peru to examine ancient ruins, or remodel our neighbour's house.

text: Ditebogo go kopantšo ya ditapo tša fiber tša ka fase ga lewatle go Yuropa le satalaete ya broadband, Greenland e tloga e kgokagane ka 93% ya batho bao ba nago le inthanete.
text_en: Thanks to undersea fiber optic cable links to Europe and broadband satellite, Greenland is well connected with 93% of the population having internet access.

text: Hotele ya goba baamogedi ba gago (ge e ba o dula ntlong ya baeti goba legae la ka sephiring) ba ka ba le wifi goba PC yeo e gokaganego le inthanete, gomme mafelo ka moka a na le mabenkele a inthanete goba lefelo le lengwe la wifi ya bohle.
text_en: Your hotel or hosts (if staying in a guesthouse or private home) will likely have wifi or an internet connected PC, and all settlements have an internet cafe or some location with public wifi.

text: Bjale ka ge go boletšwe ka godimo, le ge lentšu "Eskimo" le dula le amogelegile go la United States, le sa tšeiwa bjalo ka nyenyefatšo ke batho ba bantši ba ma Arctic ba go se ba sa U.S., kudu go la Canada.
text_en: As mentioned above, though the word "Eskimo" remains acceptable in the United States, it is considered pejorative by many non-U.S. Arctic peoples, especially in Canada.

text: Le ge o ka kwa lentšu le le šomišwago ke batho bao ba Belegetšwego Greenlandic, tšhomišo ya yona e swanetše go efogwa ke batšwantle.
text_en: While you may hear the word used by Greenlandic Natives, its use should be avoided by foreigners.

text: Badudi ba setloga ba Greenland ba ipitša Inuit ka Canada le Kalaalleq (bontši Kalaallit), moGreenland, ka Greenland.
text_en: The native inhabitants of Greenland call themselves Inuit in Canada and Kalaalleq (plural Kalaallit), a Greenlander, in Greenland.

text: Bosenyi, le bonaba go matšwantle ka kakaretšo, ga di tsebje Greenland. Le ditoropopong, ga go na "mafelo a bothata."
text_en: Crime, and ill-will toward foreigners in general, is virtually unknown in Greenland. Even in the towns, there are no "rough areas."

text: Mohlomongwe phefo ke yona kotsikotsi yeo  bao ba sa itokišetšago ba tlilego go lebana le yona.
text_en: Cold weather is perhaps the only real danger the unprepared will face.

text: Ge o ka etela Greenland ka nako ya dihla tša go tonya (o gopola gore ge o ntše o eya leboa, go tonya kudu), go bohlokwa go tla le dikobo tša borutho.
text_en: If you visit Greenland during cold seasons (considering that the further north you go, the colder it will be), it is essential to bring warm enough clothing.

text: Matšatši a matelele ka selemo a ka iša mathateng a go hwetša boroko bjo lekane le mathata a tša maphelo a go amana.
text_en: The very long days in the summer can lead to problems getting sufficient sleep and associated health issues.

text: Ka selemo, o hlokomele gape menang ya Nordic. Le ge e sa phatlalatše malwetši, e a selekiša.
text_en: During the summer, also watch out for the Nordic mosquitoes. Although they do not transmit any diseases, they can be irritating.

text: Le ge ekonomi ya San Francisco e amantšhwa le go goka baeng ga maemo a godimo lefaseng, ekonomi ya gona e a fapana.
text_en: While San Francisco's economy is linked to it being a world-class tourist attraction, its economy is diversified.

text: Mafapha a go thwala bašomi a magologolo ke ditirelo tša semmušo, mmušo, tša ditšhelete, go gwebišana, le boeti.
text_en: The largest employment sectors are professional services, government, finance, trade, and tourism.

text: Go tšwelela ga yona gantši ka gare ga mmino, difilimi, dingwalwa le ditšo tša go tuma go thušitše go dira motse le mafelo a wona a go tsebalega gore di tsebege lefaseng ka bophara.
text_en: Its frequent portrayal in music, films, literature and popular culture has helped make the city and its landmarks known throughout the world.

text: San Francisco e tšweleditšepele metheo ya tša boeti ka dihotele tše mmalwa, mafelo a go jela, le mafelo a maemo a godimo a kopanelo.
text_en: San Francisco has developed a large tourist infrastructure with numerous hotels, restaurants, and top-notch convention facilities.

text: San Francisco gape ke yengwe ya mafelo a makaone nageng bakeng sa dijo tše dingwe tša Asia: Korean, Thai, Indian, le Japanese.
text_en: San Francisco is also one of the best places in the nation for other Asian cuisine: Korean, Thai, Indian, and Japanese.

text: Go etela Walt Disney World go emela karolo ye kgolo ya boeti bjo bokgethwa bakeng sa malapa a mantši a ma-America.
text_en: Traveling to Walt Disney World represents a major pilgrimage for many American families.

text: Ketelo yeo ya "go sere selo" e na le go fofela ka Boemafofane bja Ditšhaba bja Orlando, go putlela hoteleng ya lefelong la Disney, go tšea tekano ya beke ntle le go tloga thotong ya Disney, le go boela gae.
text_en: The "typical" visit involves flying into Orlando International Airport, busing to an on-site Disney hotel, spending about a week without leaving Disney property, and returning home.

text: Gona le kgonagalo ya diphapaphapano tša go se fele, efela se ke seo batho ba bantši ba bolelago ka go sona ge ba bolela ka "go ya Disney World".
text_en: There are infinite variations possible, but this remains what most people mean when they talk of "going to Disney World".

text: Dithekete tše dintši tšeo di rekišitšwego mo dikgolaganyong tša inthanete ka diweposaete tša fantisi tše bjalo ka eBay goba Craigslist go ke dithekete tšeo di šomišitšwego gannyane letšatšing leo.
text_en: Many tickets sold online through auction websites such as eBay or Craigslist are partially used multi-day park-hopper tickets.

text: Le ge se e le mošongwana wa tlwaelo, o ganetšwa ke Disney: dithekete ga di fetišetšwe.
text_en: While this is a very common activity, it is prohibited by Disney: the tickets are non-transferable.

text: Go khampa go gongwe le go gongwe ga ka fase ga motheo go la Grand Canyon go hloka thumelelo ya ka morago ga naga.
text_en: Any camping below the rim in Grand Canyon requires a backcountry permit.

text: Ditumelelo di beetšwe go šireletša maope, gomme di ba gona ka letšatši la 1 la kgwedi, kgwedi tše nne pele ga go thoma ga kgwedi.
text_en: Permits are limited to protect the canyon, and become available on the 1st day of the month, four months prior to the start month.

text: Kafao, thumelelo ya bomorago bja naga bakeng sa letšatšikgwedi le lengwe le lengwe la go thoma ka May e ba gona ka 1 Jan.
text_en: Thus, a backcountry permit for any start date in May becomes available on 1 Jan.

text: Sekgoba bakeng sa mafelo a go tuma, bjalo ka Bright Angel Campgraund go lebana le Phantom Ranch, gantši di tlatša ke dikgopelo tšeo di amogelwago ka letšatšikgwedi la mathomo ge ba bula bakeng sa dipeelo ka thoko.
text_en: Space for the most popular areas, such as the Bright Angel Campground adjacent to Phantom Ranch, generally fill up by the requests received on first date they are opened to reservations.

text: Go na le ditumelelo tše badilwego tšeo di beetšwego bakeng sa dikgopelo tša go tsena ka maoto tšeo di bego gona bakeng sa bao ba tlago pele.
text_en: There are a limited number permits reserved for walk-in requests available on a first come, first served basis.

text: Go tsena Borwa bja Afrika ka safatanaga ke tsela ye botse ya go bona bobotse kamoka bja selete gammogo le go fihla mafelong ao a sego mebileng ya go tlwaelega ya boeti.
text_en: Entering Southern Africa by car is an amazing way to see all the region's beauty as well as to get to places off the normal tourist routes.

text: Se se ka dirwa ka gare ga safatanaga ya go tlwaelega ka peakanyo ya hlokomela efela 4x4 ke yona e eleletšwago kudu gomme mafelo a mantši a hwetšega ka 4x4 ya maotwana a godimo.
text_en: This can be done in a normal car with careful planning but a 4x4 is highly advised and many locations are only accessible with a high wheel base 4x4.

text: Dula o gopola ge o beakanya gore le ge Borwa bja Afrika bo sa šute ga se dinaga kamoka tša baaigišane tšeo di sa šutego.
text_en: Keep in mind while planning that although Southern Africa is stable not all neighboring countries are.

text: Dinyakwa tša visa le ditshenyagalelo difapana go tšwa nageng go ya nageng gomme di ama ke naga yeo o tšwago go yona.
text_en: Visa requirements and costs vary from nation to nation and are affected by the country you come from.

text: Naga yenngwe le yenngwe le yona e na le melawana ya go ikgetha yeo e kgethago gore ke didirišwa dife tšeo di hlokago go ba ka gare ga safatanaga.
text_en: Each country also has unique laws requiring what emergency items need to be in the car.

text: Diphororo tša Victoria ke toropo go la bodikela bja karolo ya Zimbabwe, go tshela leporogo go tšwa Livingstone, Zambia le kgauswi le Botswana.
text_en: Victoria Falls is a town in the western portion of Zimbabwe, across the border from Livingstone, Zambia, and near Botswana.

text: Toropo e kgauswi ka pele le diphororo tša go latela, gomme ke dikgogedi tše dikgolo, efela lefelo le la go tuma la baeti le abelana go bobedi bao ba nyakago go bona dilo tše dibotse le ba go nyaka go bona mafelo ka menyetla ye mentši bakeng sa go dula nakwana.
text_en: The town lies immediately next to the falls, and they are the major attraction, but this popular tourist destination offers both adventure seekers and sightseers plenty of opportunities for a longer stay.

text: Sehlang sa dipula (Nofemere go fihla go Matšhe), bolumu ya meetse e tla ba godimo gomme Mawa a tla phagama kudu.
text_en: In the rainy season (November to March), the water volume will be higher and the Falls will be more dramatic.

text: O netefaletšwa go tapa ge o ka tshela leborogo goba wa sepela kgauswi le ditsejana tša go ba thoko ga Diphororo.
text_en: You are guaranteed to get wet if you cross the bridge or walk along the trails winding near the Falls.

text: Ka letsogong le lengwe, ke ka lebaka la gore tekano ya meetse e godimo kudu ka moo go lebelela ga gago ga go tšholloga go ka šitišwago - ke meetse kamoka!
text_en: On the other hand, it is precisely because the volume of water is so high that your viewing of the actual Falls will be obscured—by all the water!

text: Lebitla la Tutankhamun (KV62). KV62 e ka ba e le mabitla a go tuma kudu Seleteng, ponagatšo ya temogo ya Howard Carter ya 1922 ya poloko ya ka bogošing yeo e bego e ka ba e sa le gabotse ya kgoši ye nnyane.
text_en: Tomb of Tutankhamun (KV62). KV62 may be the most famous of the tombs in the Valley, the scene of Howard Carter's 1922 discovery of the almost intact royal burial of the young king.

text: Go bapetšwa le bontši bja dirapa tša bokgoši a mangwe, serapa sa Tutankhamun ga se sa swanelwa le ke go etelwa, e le le lennyane ebile le na le go kgabišwa go go nnyane.
text_en: Compared to most of the other royal tombs, however, the tomb of Tutankhamun is barely worth visiting, being much smaller and with limited decoration.

text: Ge go na le yo a nago le kgahlego ya go bona bohlatse bja tsenyego godimo ga setopo yeo e dirilwego nakong ya go leka go se tloša go tšwa ka gare ga lepokisi o tla nyama ka ge go bonala hlogo e magetla fela.
text_en: Anyone interested in seeing evidence of the damage to the mummy done during attempts to remove it from the coffin will be disappointed as only the head and shoulders are visible.

text: Mahumo a mabotse a lebitla ga a sa le ka gare ga lona, efela a tlošeditšwe go ya Egyptian Museum go la Cairo.
text_en: The fabulous riches of the tomb are no longer in it, but have been removed to the Egyptian Museum in Cairo.

text: Baeti ba go ba le nako ye nnyane go ka ba kaone ge ba ka fetša nako ya bona go gongwe.
text_en: Visitors with limited time would be best to spend their time elsewhere.

text: Phnom Krom, 12 km borwa-bodikela bja Siem Reap. Tempele ye ya godimo ga mmoto e agilwe go ya mafelelong a ngwagakgolo wa bo 9, nakong ya pušo ya Kgoši Yasovarman.
text_en: Phnom Krom, 12 km southwest of Siem Reap. This hilltop temple was built at the end of the 9th century, during the reign of King Yasovarman.

text: Tikologo ye botse ya tempele le pono go tšwa godimo ga letsha la Tonle Sap di dira gore go namela go ya mmotong go be ga go se senye nako.
text_en: The gloomy atmosphere of the temple and the view over the Tonle Sap lake make the climb to the hill worthwhile.

text: Ketelo ya lefelo e ka hlakantšwa le leeto la sekepe go ya letsheng.
text_en: A visit to the site can be conveniently combined with a boat trip to the lake.

text: Angkor Pass ea hlokega go tsena ka gare ga tempele kafao o se ke wa lebala go tla le pasepoto ya gago ge o leba Tonle Sap.
text_en: The Angkor Pass is needed to enter the temple so do not forget to bring your passport along when heading to Tonle Sap.

text: Jerusalem ke toropokgolo le toropo ye kgolo ya Israele, le ge dinaga tše dingwe tše dintši le United Nations ga di e bone bjalo ka toropokgolo ya Israel.
text_en: Jerusalem is the capital and largest city of Israel, though most other countries and the United Nations do not recognize it as Israel's capital.

text: Motse wa kgale go la Judean Hills o na le histori ya go makatša ya go rarela mengwa ye diketekete.
text_en: The ancient city in the Judean Hills has a fascinating history spanning thousands of years.

text: Motse ke o mokgethwa go ditumelo tše tharo tša go ikema ka noši - Judaism, Christianity le Islam, gomme di hlankela bjalo ka bogare bja semoya, sedumedi le setšo.
text_en: The city is holy to the three monotheistic religions - Judaism, Christianity and Islam, and serves as a spiritual, religious, and cultural center.

text: Ka lebaka la bohlokwa bja sedumedi sa toropo, gomme gabotse mafelo a mantši a lefelo la Old City, Jerusalem ke ye tee ya mafelo a magolo a boeti ka Israel.
text_en: Due to the religious significance of the city, and in particular the many sites of the Old City area, Jerusalem is one of the main tourist destinations in Israel.

text: Jerusalema e na le mafelo a mantši a setšo a historu, gammogo le mafelo a kgahliša a go tlala a go reka, dikhefi, le mabenkele a go jela.
text_en: Jerusalem has many historic, archeological and cultural sites, along with vibrant and crowded shopping centers, cafés, and restaurants.

text: Ecuador e nyaka badudi ba Cuba ba amogele lengwalo la memo pele ba tsena Ecuador ka boemafofane bja boditšhabatšhaba goba dintlha tša kamogelo ya ka pele.
text_en: Ecuador requires that Cuban citizens receive an invitation letter prior to entering Ecuador through international airports or frontier admission points.

text: Lengwalo le le swanetše go beiwa molaong ke Ecuadorian Ministry ya Foreign Affairs, gomme e obamele dinyakwa tše diitšego.
text_en: This letter must be legalized by the Ecuadorian Ministry of Foreign Affairs, and comply with certain requirements.

text: Dinyakwa tše di hloletšwe go abelana ka boelo bja bafaladi bjoo bo beakantšwego gare ga dinaga tše tše pedi.
text_en: These requirements are designed to provide an organized migratory flow between both countries.

text: Badudi ba Cuba bao e lego baswari ba karata ye tala ya US ba swanetše go etela Motseta wa Ecuadorian go hwetša tumelelo ya senyakwa se.
text_en: Cuban citizens who are US green card holders should visit an Ecuadorian Consulate to obtain an exemption to this requirement.

text: Pasepoto ya gago e swanetše go ba e šoma bakeng sa bonnyane bja dikgwedi tše 6 go ya ka morago ga matšatšikgwedi a gago a go etela. Setlankana sa leeto la go dukuluga/go ya pele se a hlokega go bontša botelele bja go dula ga gago.
text_en: Your passport must be valid for at least 6 months beyond your travel dates. A round/onward trip ticket is needed to prove the length of your stay.

text: Tša boeti e ba tša tefelo ya fase bakeng sa dihlopa tše dikgolo, kafao ge eba o tee goba o no ba le mogwera o tee, leka go kopana le batho ba bangwe gomme le dire sehlopa sa batho ba bane go iša go tshela bakeng sa tefelo ya motho ka o tee ye kaone.
text_en: Tours are cheaper for larger groups, so if you're by yourself or with just one friend, try to meet other people and form a group of four to six for a better per-person rate.

text: Efela, se ga se a tswanela go ba taba ya gago, ka lebaka la gore gantši baeti ba šutišetšwa kua le kua go tlatša disafatanaga.
text_en: However, this shouldn't really be off your concern, because often tourists are shuffled around to fill the cars.

text: Go bonagala e tloga e le tsela ya go fekeetša batho go dumeleng gore ba swanetše ba lefel go feta.
text_en: It seems actually to be more a way of tricking people into believing they have to pay more.

text: Bokagodimo bja ka godimo bja mafelelo a leboa la Machu Picchu ke thaba ya go rotoga, gantši ke bomorago bja diswantšho tše dintši tša mašope a.
text_en: Towering above the north end of Machu Picchu is this steep mountain, often the backdrop to many photos of the ruins.

text: E bonagala e tšhoša go tšwa ka fase, gomme ke go mmoto ebile ke go go namelelago ga go thatafa, efela batho ba go tloga ba le maemong a mmele a mabotse ba ka kgona go fihla ka metsotso ye e ka bago ye 45.
text_en: It looks a bit daunting from below, and it is a steep and difficult ascent, but most reasonably fit persons should be able to make it in about 45 minutes.

text: Dikgatho tša maswika di beilwe bontšing bjale tsejana, gomme dithapo tša tšhipi tša dikarolo tša go namelela di abelana ka thekgo ya go swara ka letsogo.
text_en: Stone steps are laid along most of the path, and in the steeper sections steel cables provide a supporting handrail.

text: Seo seboletšwego, letela go felelea ke moya, gomme o hlokomele dikarolong tša go nyogela, kudu ge go tapile, ka ge go ka tloga gwa bakotsi.
text_en: That said, expect to be out of breath, and take care in the steeper portions, especially when wet, as it can become dangerous quickly.

text: Go na le lewa le lennyane kgauswi le ntlhora leo go swanetšwego go fetwa go lona, le tloga le le fase gomme le pitlaganetša kutšwana.
text_en: There's a tiny cave near the top that must be passed through, it is quite low and a rather tight squeeze.

text: Go bona mafelo le diphoofolo tša naga tša Galapagos go botse ge go dirwa ka sekepe, bjalo ka ge Charles Darwin a dirile ka 1835.
text_en: Seeing the sites and wildlife of the Galapagos is best done by boat, just as Charles Darwin did it in 1835.

text: Dikepe tša boeti tša go feta tše 60 di feta meetse a Galapos - di fapana ka tekano go tloga go banamedi ba 8 go ya go ba 100.
text_en: Over 60 cruise ships ply the Galapagos waters - ranging in size from 8 to 100 passengers.

text: Bontši bja batho ba tšea dikgoba tša mafelo a bona kapela (ka ge dikepe gantši di phela di tletše ka sehla sa godimo).
text_en: Most people book their place well in advance (as the boats are usually full during the high season).

text: Netefatša gore moemedi yoo o dirago dipeelo ka yena ke setsebi sa Galapagos ka tsebo ye botse ya dikepe tša go fapafapana.
text_en: Be sure the agent through whom you book is a Galapagos specialist with a good knowledge of a wide variety of ships.

text: Se se tla netefatša gore ditumo le/goba tšhitišo tša gago tše itšego di bapetšwa le kamano ya go ba tswanela thwii.
text_en: This will ensure that your particular interests and/or constraints are matched with the ship most suitable to them.

text: Pele ga ge ma Spanish a fihla ka ngwagakgolo wa bo 16, leboa la Chile le be le le ka fase ga molao wa Inca mola ma Araucanian (Mapuche) a be a dula bogare bja le borwa bja Chile.
text_en: Before the Spanish arrived in the 16th century, northern Chile was under Inca rule while the indigenous Araucanians (Mapuche) inhabited central and southern Chile.

text: Ma-Mapuche e be e le ba bangwe ba mafelelo ba go ikemela ba dihlopa tša setlogo tša America, tšeo di sa kago tša meletšwa ka gare ga molao wa go bolela se-Spanish go fihla ka morago ga go ikema ga Chile.
text_en: The Mapuche were also one of the last independent American indigenous groups, that were not fully absorbed into Spanish-speaking rule until after Chile's independence.

text: Le ge e ba Chile e boletšwe ge e ikeme ka 1810 (ka gare ga dintwa tša Napoleonic tšeo di tlogetšego Spain ntle le mmušo wa go šoma bakeng sa mengwaga ye mmalwa), phenyo yeo e baekantšwego ga sa ka ya fihlelelwa go ba go fihla ka 1818.
text_en: Although Chile declared independence in 1810 (amid the Napoleonic wars that left Spain without a functioning central government for a couple of years), decisive victory over the Spanish was not achieved until 1818.

text: Dominican Republic (Spanish: República Dominicana) naga ya Caribbean yeo e tšeago seripa sa bohlabela bja sehlakahlaka sa Hispaniola, seo e se abelanelago le Haiti.
text_en: The Dominican Republic (Spanish: República Dominicana) is a Caribbean country that occupies the eastern half of the island of Hispaniola, which it shares with Haiti

text: Ka ntle ga mabopo a disanta tše tšweu le mafelo a ditaba, naga ke legae go motse o mogologolo wa Yuropa go la Americas, bjale e le karolo ya Santo Domingo.
text_en: Besides white sand beaches and mountain landscapes, the country is home to the oldest European city in the Americas, now part of Santo Domingo.

text: Sehlakahlaka se dutšwe pele ke ma-Taínos le Caribes. Ma-Caribes e be e le ba go bolela se-Arawakan bao ba fihlilego ka bo 10,000 BCE.
text_en: The island was first inhabited by the Taínos and Caribes. The Caribes were an Arawakan-speaking people who had arrived around 10,000 BCE.

text: Ka korago ga mengwaga ye mmalwa ye mekopana ya go fihla ga basepedi ba ma-Europe, batho ba Tainos ba be ba fokotšegile kudu ke bafenyi ba ma-Spanish.
text_en: Within a few short years following the arrival of European explorers, the population of Tainos had significantly been reduced by the Spanish conquerors

text: Go ya le ka Fray Bartolomé de las Casas (Tratado de las Indias) gare ga 1492 le 1498 bafenyi ba ma Spanish ba bolaile ba Taínos ba e ka bago ba 100,000.
text_en: Based on Fray Bartolomé de las Casas (Tratado de las Indias) between 1492 and 1498 the Spanish conquerors killed around 100,000 Taínos.

text: Jardín de la Unión. Sekgoba se se agilwe bjalo ka atrium se agelwa kopano ya ngwagakgolo wa bo 17, yeo Templo de San Diego e lego moago o tee woo o sa emego.
text_en: Jardín de la Unión. This space was built as the atrium for a 17th-century convent, of which the Templo de San Diego is the sole surviving building.

text: Gabjale e šoma bjalo ka sentara ya plaza, gomme e dula e na le dilo tše dintši tšeo di diregago, mosegare le bošego.
text_en: It now functions as the central plaza, and always has a lot of things going on, day and night.

text: Go na le mafelo a go jela a mmalwa go dukuluga tšhemo, gomme mathapameng le bošego go ba le diponagatšo tša go se lefelwe tšeo di fiwago gantši go tšwa morithing wa tente.
text_en: There are a number of restaurants surrounding the garden, and in the afternoons and evening there free concerts are often given from the central gazebo.

text: Callejon del Beso (Alley of the Kiss). Mabato a ka godimo a mabedi ao a arogantšwego ka disentimitara tše 69 fela ke legae la kakapa ya go tšofala ya lerato.
text_en: Callejon del Beso (Alley of the Kiss). Two balconies separated by only 69 centimeters is home of an old love legend.

text: Bakeng sa dipeni nyana tše nnyane bana ba tla go botša padi ye.
text_en: For a few pennies some children will tell you the story.

text: Sehlakahlaka sa Bowen ke lefelo la boeti ba leeto la letšatši goba mafelelo a beke lago tuma la go abelana ka kayaking, go tšea leeto le le telele ka maoto, mabenkele, mafelo a go jela, le tše dingwe.
text_en: Bowen Island is a popular day trip or weekend excursion offering kayaking, hiking, shops, restaurants, and more.

text: Setšhaba se sa nnete se hwetšwa ka Howe Sound go tšwa gannyane ka Vancouver, gomme se a hwetšega ka ditekisi tša meetse tša go beakantšwa go tloga Granvill Island bofase bja toropo ya Vancouver.
text_en: This authentic community is located in Howe Sound just off Vancouver, and is easily accessed via scheduled water taxis departing Granville Island in downtown Vancouver.

text: Bakeng sa bao ba ratago ditiragatšo tša ka ntle, go sepela ka tsejana ya go ya Lewatleng go ya Lefaufaung go bohlokwa.
text_en: For those who enjoy outdoor activities, a trek up the Sea to Sky corridor is essential.

text: Whistler (leeto la go leka diiri tše 1.5 go tloga Vancouver) e a thura efela e a tsebega ka lebaka la di Oyympic tša Marega a 2010.
text_en: Whistler (1.5 hour drive from Vancouver) is expensive but well-known because of the 2010 Winter Olympics.

text: Ka marega, ipšhine ka go fofa lehlweng go gobotse go la Leboa la America, gomme ka selemo o leke go namela ditaba ka paesekela ga mmakgonthe.
text_en: In the winter, enjoy some of the best skiing in North America, and in the summer try some authentic mountain biking.

text: Ditumelelo di swanetše go beelwa ka thoko e sa le nako. O swanetše go ba le tumelelo go dula bošego go la Sirena.
text_en: Permits must be reserved in advance. You must have a permit to stay overnight at Sirena.

text: Sirena ke sona setiši fela sa meraka seo e abelanelago ka marobalo a ka gare le dijo tša go fiša godimo ga go kampa. La Leona, San Pedrillo, le Los Patos di abelana ka go kampa fela ntle le tirelo ya dijo.
text_en: Sirena is the only ranger station that offers dormitory lodging and hot meals in addition to camping. La Leona, San Pedrillo, and Los Patos offer only camping with no food service.

text: Go a kgonega go hwetša ditumelelo tša go emiša difatanaga Setišing sa Ranger go la Puerto Jiménez, efela ga ba amogele dikarata tša sekoloto.
text_en: It is possible to secure park permits directly from the Ranger Station in Puerto Jiménez, but they do not accept credit cards

text: Park Service (MINAE) ga e ntše ditumelelo tša diphaka go feta kgwedi ye tee pele ga go fihla goo go lebeletšwego.
text_en: The Park Service (MINAE) does not issue park permits more than one month in advance of anticipated arrival.

text: CafeNet El Sol o aba tirelo ya polokelo ka tefo ya US$30, goba $10 ka go feta ga letšatši le tee; dintlha di letlakaleng la bona la Corcovado.
text_en: CafeNet El Sol offers a reservation service for a fee of US$30, or $10 for one-day passes; details on their Corcovado page.

text: Dihlakahlaka tša Cook ke naga ya sehlakahlaka ya go ba le kamano ya go lokologa le New Zealand, e hwetšwa Polynesia, gare ga Lewatle la Borwa bja Pacific.
text_en: The Cook Islands are an island country in free association with New Zealand, located in Polynesia, in the middle of the South Pacific Ocean.

text: Ke sehlopa sa dihlakahlaka tše 15 tšeo di phatlaletšego godimo ga di km2 tše dimiliyone tše 2.2 tša lewatle.
text_en: It is an archipelago with 15 islands spread out over 2.2 million km2 of ocean.

text: Ka nako ya go tswana le ya Hawaii, dihlakahlaka ka nako yengwe di naganwa bjale ka "Hawaii ka fase".
text_en: With the same time zone as Hawaii, the islands are sometimes thought of as "Hawaii down under".

text: Le ge e le ye nnyane, e gopotša baeti ba bangwe ba batšofe ka Hawaii pele ga pušo ntle le dihotele tše di kgolo tša baeti le ditšwelopele tše dingwe.
text_en: Though smaller, it reminds some elderly visitors of Hawaii before statehood without all the large tourist hotels and other development.

text: Dihlakahlaka tša Cook ga di na metsana efela di dirilwe ka dihlakahlaka tša go fapafapana tše 15. Tše kgolo ke Rarotonga le Aitutaki.
text_en: The Cook Islands do not have any cities but are composed of 15 different islands. The main ones are Rarotonga and Aitutaki.

text: Dinageng tšeo di tšweletšego pele, go abelana ka maloa a makaone le dijo tša mesong go phagamišitšwe go ya go lebopo la bokgabo.
text_en: In developed countries today, providing deluxe bed and breakfasts has been raised to a sort of art-form.

text: Kua godimo mafelelong, di B&B di tloga di phenkgišana kudu le dilo tše kgolo tše pedi: borobalelo le dijo tša mesong.
text_en: At the top end, B&Bs obviously compete mainly on two main things: bedding and breakfast.

text: Ka tshwanelo, mafelong a makaone a mabjalo motho o swanetše go hwetša tša go alwa mpheteng tša mabaibai, mohlomongwe sealwa sa go dirwa ka matsogo goba mephete wa mohlakgale.
text_en: Accordingly, at the finest such establishments one is apt to find the most luxurious bedding, maybe a handmade quilt or an antique bed.

text: Dijo tša mesong di ka akaretša mabose a sehla a selete goba dijo tša go ikgetha tša moamogedi.
text_en: Breakfast may include seasonal delights of the region or the host's speciality dish.

text: Lefelo e ka ba moago wa histori wa kgale wa go ba le diphatlo tša sekgale, bofase boo bo pentilwego le letangwana la go rutha.
text_en: The setting might be an historic old building with antique furnishings, manicured grounds and a swimming pool.

text: Go tsena ka gare ga sefatanaga sa gago ka noši gomme wa tšeya leeto le le telele go na le kgogedi ye bohlokwa ka gare ga go nolofala ga gona.
text_en: Getting into your own car and heading off on a long road trip has an intrinsic appeal in its simplicity.

text: Go se tswane le disafatanaga tše dikgolo, o šetše mohlomongwe o tlwaetše go otlela safatanaga ya gago gomme o tseba le magomo a yona.
text_en: Unlike larger vehicles, you are probably already familiar with driving your car and know its limitations.

text: Go hloma tente thotong ya prabete goba ka gare ga toropo ya saese yengwe le yengwe go ka gogela hlokomologo ya go se nyakege ga bonolo.
text_en: Setting up a tent on private property or in a town of any size can easily attract unwanted attention.

text: Ka bokopana, go šomiša sefatanaga sa gago ke tsela ye botse ya go tšea leeto efela ga se gantši ka bo yona e le tsela ya go "kampa".
text_en: In short, using your car is a great way to take a road trip but seldom in itself a way to "camp".

text: Go kampa ka safatanaga go kgonega ge e le gore o na le bene ye kgolo, SUV, Sedan goba Station Wagon sa go ba le ditulo tša go patlama.
text_en: Car camping is possible if you have a large minivan, SUV, Sedan or Station Wagon with seats that lay down.

text: Dihotele tše dingwe di na le bohwa go tšwa ngwageng wa kgale wa diporo tša muši le malakane a lewatle; pele ga Ntwa ya Bobedi ya Lefase, ka mengwagakgolo ya bo 19 le ka pela go wa bo 20.
text_en: Some hotels have a heritage from the golden age of steam railways and ocean liners; before the Second World War, in the 19th or early 20th centuries.

text: Dihotele tše e be e le moo bahumi le batsebalegi ba mehleng yeo ba dulago, gomme gantši ba eja gabotse le bophelo bja bošego.
text_en: These hotels were where the rich and the famous of the day would stay, and often had fine dining and nightlife.

text: Dikagare tša sekgale, go hloka di dirišwa tša sebjabjale, le botšofe bjo bo itšego bja mogau ke karolo ya dimelo tša bona.
text_en: The old fashioned fittings, the lack of the latest amenities, and a certain graceful agedness are also part of their character.

text: Le ge ka tlwaelo e le tša praebete, nako ye nngwe di akaretša dihogo tša dinaga tšeo di etelago le bahlomphegi ba bangwe.
text_en: While they are usually privately owned, they sometimes accommodate visiting heads of state and other dignitaries.

text: Moeti wa goba le tšhelete ye ntši a ka kgetha sefofane sa go dukuluga lefase, se arogantšitšwe ka go dula dihoteleng tše tše dintši.
text_en: A traveller with piles of money might consider a round the world flight, broken up with stays in many of these hotels.

text: Neteweke ya go fana ya tša dijo ke mokgahlo wa go hlakantša baeti le badudi ba gae ka ditoropong tšeo ba yago go di etela.
text_en: A hospitality exchange network is the organization that connects travelers with locals in the cities they are going to visit.

text: Go tsenela neteweke gantši go nyaka go tlatša fomo ya online; le ge dineteweke tše dingwe di aba goba di nyaka kgonthišišo ya tlaleletšo.
text_en: Joining such a network usually just requires filling out an online form; although some networks offer or require additional verification.

text: Lenaneo la baamogedi bao ba lego gona le a abelanwa ka go gatišwa le/goba online, ka nako tše dingwe ka ditšhupetšo le ditebelelomorago ka baeti ba bangwe.
text_en: A listing of available hosts is then provided either in print and/or online, sometimes with references and reviews by other travelers.

text: Go eta le go dula le batho bao o sa ba tsebego go thomilwe ka Janawari 2004 morago ga gore setsebi sa dikhomphuthara Casey Fenton a hwetše sefofane sa mašeleng a fase sa go ya Iceland efela a hloka lefelo la go dula.
text_en: Couchsurfing was founded in January 2004 after computer programmer Casey Fenton found a cheap flight to Iceland but did not have a place to stay.

text: O rometše baithuti ba yunibesithi ya gae emeile gomme a amogela dipalopalo tše dintšhi tša go fana ka madulo a go se lefelwe.we.
text_en: He emailed students at the local university and received an overwhelming number of offers for free accommodation.

text: Dihostele di hlokomela bonnyane batho ba baswa - moeti wa mengwaga ye e ka bago ye masomepedi - efela gantši o ka hwetša le baeti ba bagolo gona moo gape.
text_en: Hostels cater primarily to young people – a typical guest is in their twenties – but you can often find older travellers there too.

text: Malapa a go ba le bana ke pono ye sa tlwaelegago, efela dihostele tše dingwe di a ba dumelela ka diphaphušing tša bona tša noši.
text_en: Families with children are a rare sight, but some hostels do allow them in private rooms.

text: Motse wa Beijing ka China e tla ba motse wa go swaMotse wa Beijing ka China e tla ba motse wa go swara Dipapadi tša Marega tša di Olympic ka 2022, seo e tlo o dira gore e be motse wa mathomo wa go swara bobedi bja di Olympic tša selemo le marega.
text_en: The city of Beijing in China will be the host city of the Olympic Winter Games in 2022, which will make it the first city to have hosted both the summer and winter Olympics.

text: Beijing e tla swara meletlo ya go bula le go tswalela le ditiragalo tša ka gare tša aese.
text_en: Beijing will host the opening and closing ceremonies and the indoor ice events.

text: Ditiragalo tše dingwe tša skii di tla ba lefelong la Taizicheng la ski ka Zhangjiakou, 220 km (140 miles) go tloga Beijing.
text_en: Other skiing events will be at the Taizicheng ski area in Zhangjiakou, about 220 km (140 miles) from Beijing.

text: Bontši bja ditempele bo na le Mekete ya Ngwaga ka ngwaga go thoma ka mafelelo a November go fihla gare ga May, yeo e fapanago go ya ka tšhupamabaka ya ngwaga ka ngwaga ya tempele yenngwe le yenngwe.
text_en: Most of the temples do have an Annual festival starting from November end to Mid of May, which varies according to each temple's annual calendar.

text: Bontši bja mekete ya tempele bo ketekwa bjalo ka karolo ya segopotšo sa ngwaga sa tempele goba letšatši la matswalo la modingwana goba tiragalo yenngwe le yenngwe ye kgolo ya go amana le tempele.
text_en: Most of the temple festivals is celebrated as part of temple's anniversary or presiding deity's birthday or any other major event associated with the temple.

text: Meletlo ya tempele ya Kerala go a kgahliša go e bona, ka go tshepedišo ya tlwaelo ya  ditlou tšeo di kgabišitšwego, diphatla  tša tempele le meletlo ye mengwe.
text_en: Kerala's temple festivals are very interesting to see, with regular procession of decorated elephants, temple orchestra and other festivities.

text: World's Fair (ka tlwaelo e bitšwa Thutupišo ya Lefase, goba ka bokopana Thutupi) ke mokete wa ditšhaba wa bokgabo le tša mahlale.
text_en: A World's Fair (commonly called World Exposition, or simply Expo) is large international festival of arts and sciences.

text: Dinaga tšeo di tšeago karolo di aba diswantšho tša bokgabo le thutodi pavilion tša bosetšhaba go laetša mathata a lefase goba setšo sa naga le histori.
text_en: Participating countries present artistic and educational displays in national pavilions to showcase world issues or their country's culture and history.

text: Diponagatšo tša Ditšhabatšhaba tša Temo ke meletlo yeo e kgethegilego yeo e bontšago malomo, dirapana tša dimela le tše dingwe tša go amana le dimela.
text_en: International Horticultural Expositions are specialised events which showcase floral displays, botanical gardens and anything else to do with plants.

text: Le ge go ya ka polelo di ka diragala ngwaga ka ngwaga (ge fela e le dinageng tša go fapanafapana), go ya ka ditiragalo ga go bjalo.
text_en: Although in theory they can take place annually (so long as they are in different countries), in practice they are not.

text: Meletlo ye gantši e fetša nako ya go lekana gare ga dikgwedi tše tharo le tše tshela, gomme e tswarelwa mafelong a go se be bonnyane bja di hectara tše 50.
text_en: These events normally last anywhere between three and six months, and are held on sites no smaller than 50 hectares.

text: Gona le mamanoga a mantši a go fapana a difilimi ao a šomišitšwego mengwageng. Filimi ya 35 mm ya go lekanela (36 ka 24 mm negetifi) ke ya go tlwaelega kudu.
text_en: There are many different film formats that have been used over the years. Standard 35 mm film (36 by 24 mm negative) is much the commonest.

text: Gantši e ka tlaleletšwa botse ga bonolo ge o ka felelwa, gomme e fa ditlamo go bapetša ka go tswana le DSLR ya bjale.
text_en: It can usually be replenished fairly easily if you run out, and gives resolution roughly comparable to a current DSLR.

text: Dikhamera tša difilimi tše dingwe tša mehta ya magareng di šomiša mohuta wa 6 ka 6 cm, gabotse negetifi ya 56 ka 56 mm.
text_en: Some medium-format film cameras use a 6 by 6 cm format, more precisely a 56 by 56 mm negative.

text: Se sefa tharollo goo go nyakilego go ba makga a mane a neketifo  ya 35 mm (3136 mm2 kgahlanong le 864).
text_en: This gives resolution almost four times that of a 35 mm negative (3136 mm2 versus 864).

text: Diphoofolo tša naga di gare ga tše dingwe tša dikgatišo tša go tlhotla motšeadiswantšho, gomme go hloka hlakantšo ya mahlatse, go se fele pelo, maitemogelo le di dirišwa tše di kaone.
text_en: Wildlife is among the most challenging motifs for a photographer, and needs a combination of good luck, patience, experience and good equipment.

text: Go tšea diswantšho tša diphoofolo tša naga gantši go tšeelwa fase, efela go tswana le go tšea dinswantšho ka kakaretšo, setswantšho se na le boleng bja matšu a dikete.
text_en: Wildlife photography is often taken for granted, but like photography in general, a picture is worth a thousand words.

text: Go tšea diswantšho tša diphoofolo tša naga gantši go hloka telephoto lens, le ge dilo tša go swana le sehlopa sa dinonyane goba sephedi se se nnyane di hloka di lens tše dingwe.
text_en: Wildlife photography often requires a long telephoto lens, though things like a flock of birds or a tiny creature need other lenses.

text: Diphoofolo tše dintši tšeo di sa tlwaelegago go boima gore o di hwetše, gomme diphaka ka dinako tše dingwe di na le melao mabapi le go tšea dinepe ka mabaka a kgwebo.
text_en: Many exotic animals are hard to find, and parks sometimes have rules about taking photographs for commercial purposes.

text: Diphoofolo tša naga di ka ba le dihlong goba bogale. Lefelo le ka ba le tonya, fiša, goba e le la go se amogele gabotse.
text_en: Wild animals might either be shy or aggressive. The environment might be cold, hot, or otherwise hostile.

text: Lefase le na le maleme a go feta 5,000 a go fapafapana, go akaretša go feta masomepedi ka dimilion tše 50 goba go feta tša diboledi.
text_en: The world has over 5,000 different languages, including more than twenty with 50 million or more speakers.

text: Mantšu ao a ngwadilwego gantši a bonolo go kwešišega go feta mantšu ao a boletšwego, gape. Se ke e tloga e le nnete ka dipego, tšeo gantši di lego thata go di bitša gabotse.
text_en: Written words are often easier to understand than spoken words, also. This is especially true of addresses, which are often difficult to pronounce intelligibly.

text: Dinaga tše dintši kamoka di tseba English ka botlalo, gape le go ba bantši o ka letela tsebo yeo nnyane - kudu gare ga bana ba bannyane.
text_en: Many entire nations are completely fluent in English, and in even more you can expect a limited knowledge - especially among younger people.

text: Nagana, ge e ba o ka kgona, Mancunian, Bostonian, Jamaican le Sydneyside ba dutši tafoleng ba eja dijo tša matena lefong la dijo go la Toronto.
text_en: Imagine, if you will, a Mancunian, Bostonian, Jamaican and Sydneysider sitting around a table having dinner at a restaurant in Toronto.

text: Ba thabišana ka dikanegelo go tšwa mageng a bona, di anegelwa ka digalo tša bona tša go fapana le maleme a mebotwana ya bona ya gae.
text_en: They're regaling each other with stories from their hometowns, told in their distinct accents and local argot.

text: Go reka dijo mabenkeleng ka setlwaedi ke tsela ya theko ya fase kudu ya go ja. Ntle le menyetla ya go apea, dikgetho e ba tša dijo di šetšego di dirilwe.
text_en: Buying food in supermarkets is usually the cheapest way to get fed. Without cooking opportunities, choices are however limited to ready-made food.

text: Ka go oketšega mabenkele a dijo a oketšega ka go fapana ga karolo ya dijo tšeo di aeilwego. Tšedingwe ebile di abelana ka obene ya go tutetša goba mekgwa ye mengwe ya go tutetša dijo.
text_en: Increasingly supermarkets are getting a more varied section of ready-made food. Some even provide a microwave oven or other means to heat food.

text: Dinageng tše dingwe goba mehuta ya mabenkele go na le bonnyane bjo tee bja lefelo la go jela, gantši la go se be la semmušo la diteko tša go lefelega.
text_en: In some countries or types of stores there is at least one on-site restaurant, often a rather informal one with affordable prices.

text: Dira le go swara dikhophi tša molaotshepedišo wa gago le dintlha tša tshedimušo ya inšorense ya gago.
text_en: Make and carry copies of your policy and your insurer's contact details with you.

text: Ba swanetše go laetša emeile ya moabi wa inšhorense le dinomoro tša mogala wa ditšhaba bakeng sa keletšo/tumeleo le go dikgopelo.
text_en: They need to show the insurer's e-mail address and international phone numbers for advice/authorizations and making claims.

text: Swara khophi ye nngwe ka gare ga morwalo wa gago le inthaneteng (ithomele emeile ya go ba le seromelwa, goba o e lote ka gare ga "leru").
text_en: Have another copy in your luggage and online (e-mail to yourself with attachment, or stored in the "cloud").

text: Ge o sepela le laptop goba tablet, boloka khopi ka gare ga kgopotša ya yona goba deski (yeo e hwetšagalago ntle le inthanete).
text_en: If traveling with a laptop or tablet, store a copy in its memory or disc (accessible without the internet).

text: Gape abelana ka dikhope tša polise/boikgokaganye go bao o tšeago leeto le bona goba ba leloko le metswalle morago gae bao ba ikemišeditšego go thuša.
text_en: Also give policy/contact copies to traveling companions and relatives or friends back home willing to help.

text: Moose (yeo e tsebegago gape ka elk) ga e bogale bjalo ka tswalo, efela e tla ikemela ge e bona kotsi.
text_en: Moose (also known as elk) aren't inherently aggressive, but will defend themselves if they perceive a threat.

text: Ge batho ba sa bone dikgamakgolo di na le bokgoni bja go ba kotsi, ba ka di batamela kudu gomme ba ipea kotsing.
text_en: When people don't see moose as potentially dangerous, they may approach too closely and put themselves at risk.

text: Enwa dino tša go ba le madila ka go kala. Madila a ama mang le mang ka go fapana, gomme go tseba magomo a gago go bohlokwa kudu.
text_en: Drink alcoholic drinks with moderation. Alcohol affects everyone differently, and knowing your limit is very important.

text: Kgonagalo ya ditiragalo tša lebaka le le telele go tšwa go nweng kudu e ka akaretša go senyega ga sebete le go foufala le lehu. Kotsi yeo e ka bago gona e oketšega ge go nwewa madila a go tšweletšwa ka tsela ya go se be molaong.
text_en: Possible long term health events from excessive drinking can include liver damage and even blindness and death. The potential danger is increased when consuming illegally produced alcohol.

text: Ditagi tša go se be molaong di ka ba le diela tša go se hlweke tše kotsi go akaretša methanol, yeo e ka tlišago bofofu goba lehu le ge e tšetšwe gannyane.
text_en: Illegal spirits can contain various dangerous impurities including methanol, which can cause blindness or death even in small doses.

text: Dikgalase tša mahlo di ka rekega ka teko ya fase nageng ya ka ntle, kudu dinageng tša letseno la fase moo ditshenyagalelo tša tefelo ya bašomi e lego fase.
text_en: Eyeglasses can be cheaper in a foreign country, especially in low-income countries where labour costs are lower.

text: Kgetha go dira tlhahlobo ya leihlo ka gae, kudu ge e le gore inšorense e a le lefela, le go tliša taelelo gammogo gore e bolokwe go gongwe.
text_en: Consider getting an eye exam at home, especially if insurance covers it, and bringing the prescription along to be filed elsewhere.

text: Diforeime tša maina a godimo mafelong a mabjale di ka ba le mathata a mabedi; tšedingwe e kaba bofora, gomme tša nnete tšeo di rekilwego ka ntle di ka thura kudu go feta gae.
text_en: High-end brand-name frames available in such areas may have two problems; some may be knock-offs, and the real imported ones may be more expensive than at home.

text: Kofi ke yenngwe ya dilo tšeo di rekišwago kudu lefaseng, gomme o ka humana mohlomongwe mehuta ye mentši seleteng sa legae la gago.
text_en: Coffee is one of the world's most traded commodities, and you can probably find many types in your home region.

text: Le ge go le bjalo, go na le mekgwa ye mentši ya go fapana le kofi ya go nwa lefase ka bophara yeo e swanetšwego go lemogwa.
text_en: Nevertheless, there are many distinctive ways of drinking coffee around the world that are worth experiencing.

text: Go tshela meedi (goba: papadi ya go tshela meedi) go mabapi le go ya tlase ga moedi, woo ekabago o omile goba o tletše ka meetse.
text_en: Canyoning (or: canyoneering) is about going in a bottom of a canyon, which is either dry or full of water.

text: Go tshela meedi go kopanya dikarolo go tloga go go rutha, go namela le go fofa--efela go nyaka tlhahlo ye nnyane goba lebopo la seemo gore go thomiwe (go bapetšwa le namela maswika, go nwelela ka gare ga meetse ka sedirišwa sa go thuša go hema goba go thelela godimo ga lehlwa, ka mohlala).
text_en: Canyoning combines elements from swimming, climbing and jumping--but requires relatively little training or physical shape to get started (compared to rock climbing, scuba diving or alpine skiing, for example).

text: Go tšea leeto le le telele ke modiro wa ka ntle wa go ba le go sepela lefelong la hlago, gantši ditsejaneng tša maeto a matelele.
text_en: Hiking is an outdoor activity which consists of walking in natural environments, often on hiking trails.

text: Go namela dithaba mosegare go akaretša dikgoba tša ka fase ga khilomitara go fihla go dikgoba tše ditelele tšeo di ka fihlelelwago ka letšatši le tee.
text_en: Day hiking involves distances of less than a mile up to longer distances that can be covered in a single day.

text: Bakeng sa go sepelela go ya go namela dithaba ka tselajana ye nnyane ye bonolo go hlokega ditokišetšo tše di nnyane, gomme motho o mongwe le o mongwe wa go itekanela ga botse a ka ipšhina ka tšona.
text_en: For a day hike along an easy trail little preparations are needed, and any moderately fit person can enjoy them.

text: Malapa a bana ba bannyane a ka hloka ditukišetšo tše dingwe, efela letšatši ka ntle le direga ga bonolo le ka bana ba masea le bana ba go ya go thoma sekolo.
text_en: Families with small children may need more preparations, but a day outdoors is easily possible even with babies and pre-school children.

text: Ditšhabatšhabeng, go na le mekgahlo ya go lekana 200 yeo e dirago tša maeto. Bontši bja tšona bo šoma ka go ikema.
text_en: Internationally, there are nearly 200 running tour organizations. Most of them operate independently.

text: Mohlahlami wa Global Running Tours, Go Running Tours e kopantša baabi ba sightrunning ba bantšintši go dikontinente tše nne.
text_en: The Global Running Tours successor, Go Running Tours networks dozens of sightrunning providers on four continents.

text: Ka medu go Ralala ga go Kitima go Barcelona ga Barcelona le go Kitima go Copenhagen ga Copenhagen, go kopantšhitšwe ka pela ke go Ralala ga go Kitima ga Prague go go lego Prague le go gongwe.
text_en: With roots in Barcelona's Running Tours Barcelona and Copenhagen's Running Copenhagen, it was quickly joined by Running Tours Prague based in Prague and others.

text: Gona le dilo tše dintši tšeo o swanetšego go di nagana pele le ge o tšea leeto.
text_en: There are many things you have to take into consideration before and when you travel somewhere.

text: Ge o tšea leeteo, letela dilo gore di se ke tša tswana le ka moo di bego ka gona "morago gae". Mekgwa, melao, dijo, kelo ya sephetephete, marobalo, maemo, polelo bjale le bjale di tla fapana le tša mo o dulago gona ka mokgwa wo o rilego.
text_en: When you travel, expect things not to be like they are "back home". Manners, laws, food, traffic, lodging, standards, language and so on will to some extent differ from where you live.

text: Se ke selo seo o swanetšego go dula o se beile ka mogopolong, go efoga manyami goba mohlomongwe go se rate mekgwa ya selegae ya go dira dilo.
text_en: This is something you always need to keep in mind, to avoid disappointment or perhaps even distaste over local ways to do things.

text: Mekgahlo ya tša maeto e bilego gona go tloga ka ngwagakgolo wa bo 19. Moemedi wa leeto gantši ke kgetho ye kaone bakeng sa leeto leo le fetago maitemogelo a go feta a moeti a hlago, setšo, leleme goba dinaga tša letseno la fase.
text_en: Travel agencies have been around since the 19th century. A travel agent is usually a good option for a journey which extends beyond a traveller's previous experience of nature, culture, language or low-income countries.

text: Le ge makgotla a mantši a ikemišeditše go tšea dipeelothoko tša go tlwaelega, baemedi ba bantši ba šoma ka mehutye itšego ya maeto, go lekalekanetšwa ga tšhelete yeo e beetšwego ka thoko goba mafelo ao go iwago go wona.
text_en: Although most agencies are willing to take on most regular bookings, many agents specialise in particular types of travel, budget ranges or destinations.

text: Go ka ba kaone go šomiša moemedi yoo a hlwago a dira dipeelo tša maeto a go swana le la gago.
text_en: It can be better to use an agent who frequently books similar trips to yours.

text: Lebelela gore ke maeto afe ao moemedi a a godišago, e kaba wepesaeteng goba lesthikangopeng la lebenkele.
text_en: Take a look at what trips the agent is promoting, whether on a website or in a shop window.

text: Ge e ba o nyaka go bona lefase ka theko ya fase, ka tlhokego, mohuta wa go phela goba hlotlo, go na le ditsela tša go dira seo.
text_en: If you want to see the world on the cheap, for necessity, lifestyle or challenge, there are some ways to do that.

text: Gabotse, di wela ka gare ga magoro a mabedi: Go šoma o ralala le mafelo goba go leka go kgaoletša ditshenyagalelo tša gago. Sengwalwa se se lebeletše kgang ya mafelelo.
text_en: Basically, they fall into two categories: Either work while you travel or try and limit your expenses. This article is focused on the latter.

text: Bakeng sa bao ba ikemišeditšego go itima boiketlo, nako le go akanyetša pele go kgoromeletša ditshenyagalelo go ya fase go lefela, bona bonnyane bja peakanyo ya tšhelete ya go tšeya maeto.
text_en: For those willing to sacrifice comfort, time and predictability to push expenses down close to zero, see minimum budget travel.

text: Keletšo e etšea gore baeti ga ba utswe, ga ba tsele ntle le tumelelo, ga ba tšekarolo ka gare ga mebaraka ya go se be molaong, ga ba kgopele, goba mohlomongwe ga ba foraforetše batho ba bangwe bakeng sa go holega.
text_en: The advice assumes that travellers do not steal, trespass, participate in the illegal market, beg, or otherwise exploit other people for their own gain.

text: Lefelo la go hlola batšwantle gantši e ba lefelo la mathomo moo go emiwago gona ge o fologa sefofane, sekepe, goba senamelwa se sengwe.
text_en: An immigration checkpoint is usually the first stop when disembarking from a plane, a ship, or another vehicle.

text: Ka gare ga ditimela tša go tselaganya maborogo dihlahlobo di dirwa ka gare ga setimela sa go sepela gomme o swanetše o be le ID ya go šoma go wena ge o namela yengwe ya ditimela tše.
text_en: In some cross-border trains inspections are done on the running train and you should have valid ID with you when boarding one of those trains.

text: Go diterene tša ba go robala bošego, dipaseporoto di ka kgoboketšwa ke molaodi gore o se šitišwe boroko.
text_en: On night sleeper trains, passports may be collected by the conductor so that you do not have your sleep interrupted.

text: Boingwadišo ke senyakwa se sengwe sa go hlokega bakeng sa tshepedišo ya visa. Dinageng tše dingwe, o swanetše o ngwadiše bogona bja gago le aterese ya moo o dulago gona le bamolao ba selegae.
text_en: Registration is an additional requirement for the visa process. In some countries, you must register your presence and address where you are staying with the local authorities.

text: Se se ka hloka go tlatša foromo le maphodisa a selegae goba go etela dikantoro tša bafaladi.
text_en: This might require filling out a form with the local police or a visit to the immigration offices.

text: Dinageng tše dintši tša go ba le melao ye me bjalo, dihotele tša gae di tla swaragana le boingwadišo (netefatša gore o a botšiša).
text_en: In many countries with such a law, local hotels will handle the registration (make sure to ask).

text: Makgeng a mangwe, ke bao ba dulago ka ntle ga mafelo a marobalo bao ba hlokago go ngwadiša. Efela, se se dira molao gore o kobege kudu, kafao nyakišiša pele ga nako.
text_en: In other cases, only those staying outside of tourist accommodations need to register.  However, this makes the law much more obscure, so find out beforehand.

text: Thutaboagi go mabapi le go akanyetša le go aga meago. Kago ya lefelo gantši e ba bogogedi bja baeti ka noši.
text_en: Architecture is concerned with the design and construction of buildings. The architecture of a place is often a tourist attraction in its own right.

text: Meago ye mentši e botse gomme le moo o lebelelago o le moagong o motelele goba go tloga go lefesetere leo le beilwego ka bohlale go botse.
text_en: Many buildings are quite beautiful to look at and the view from a tall building or from a cleverly-positioned window can be a beauty to behold.

text: Thulaganyo ya meago e tloga e tsenelela ka gare ga dithutišetše tse dingwe go akaretša lenaneo la ditoropo, boentšeneare bja tša go aga, bokgabo bja go kgabiša, bokgabo bja ka ntlong le bokgabo bja ka ntle.
text_en: Architecture overlaps considerably with other fields including urban planning, civil engineering, decorative arts, interior design and landscape design.

text: Go ya le ka moo bontši bja di pueblo di bego kgole ka gona, o ka se kgone go hwetša bophelo bja bošego bjo bontši ntle le go ya Albuquerque goba Santa Fe.
text_en: Given how remote many of the pueblos are, you won't be able to find a significant amount of nightlife without traveling to Albuquerque or Santa Fe.

text: Efela, go nyakile eke dikhasino ka moka tšeo di ngwadilwego mo lenaneong la ka godimo di rekiša dino, gomme tše dingwe tša tšona bja tšona bo tliša boithabišo bja maina-ina (gagolo tše kgolo tšeo di potapotilego Albuquerque le Santa Fe)
text_en: However, nearly all of the casinos listed above serve drinks, and several of them bring in name-brand entertainment (primarily the large ones immediately surrounding Albuquerque and Santa Fe).

text: Hlokomela: dipara tša ditorotswana tše nnyane ga e dule e le mafelo a mabotse bakeng sa baeti ba go tšwa ka ntle gore ba ka dula.
text_en: Beware: small-town bars here are not always good places for the out-of-state visitor to hang out.

text: Bakeng la se tee, leboa la Mexico o Moswa le na le mathata a mantši a go reilwa go tagilwe, gomme maemo a go tagwa a baaotledi a godimo kgauswi le dibara tša diporopo tše dinnyane.
text_en: For one thing, northern New Mexico has significant problems with drunk driving, and the concentration of intoxicated drivers is high close to small-town bars.

text: Diswantšho tšeo di thadilwego goba di ngwalwangwadilwego di tsebega bjalo ka graffiti.
text_en: Unwanted murals or scribble is known as graffiti.

text: Le ge e le kgole le kgopolo ya sebjalebjale, batho ba bantši ba tloga ba e tswalanya le tsenyo ya dikgaruru ya baswa thotong ya mmušo le ya praebete ka go šomiša pente ya go fafametša.
text_en: While it's far from a modern phenomenon, most people probably associate it with youth vandalizing public and private property using spray paint.

text: Le ge go le bjalo, matšatši a go na le borabokgabo ba dithalwa bao ba tšweletšego, meletlo ya dithalwa le maboto a go ba "molaong". Dithalwa tša go pentwa ka se sebaka gantši di emetše mošomo wa bo kgabo go na le ditag tša go se be molaong.
text_en: However, nowadays there are established graffiti artists, graffiti events and "legal" walls. Graffiti paintings in this context often resemble artworks rather than illegible tags.

text: Go foša boomerang ke bokgoni bjo bo tumilego bjoo baeti ba bantši ba nyakago go ba le bona.
text_en: Boomerang throwing is a popular skill that many tourists want to acquire.

text: Ge e ba o nyaka go ithuta go foša boomerang yeo e boago letsogong la gago, netefatša gore o na le boomerang ya maleba ge e tlo boa.
text_en: If you want to learn throwing a boomerang that comes back to your hand, make sure you have a suitable boomerang for returning.

text: Bontši bja di-boomerang tšeo di lego gona ka Australia ka nnete ga di boele morago. Go kaone go bathomi gore ba se leke go foša ge go na le moya.
text_en: Most boomerangs available in Australia are in fact non-returning. It is best for beginners to not try throwing in windy

text: Dijo tša Hangi di apeiwa ka gare ga sekoti sa go fiša mo fase.
text_en: A Hangi Meal is cooked in a hot pit in the ground.

text: Molete o ka ba o thuteditšwe ka maswika a go fiša go tšwa mollong, goba ka di nako tše dingwe phišo ya geothermal e dira mafelo a fase gore a fiše ka hlago.
text_en: The pit is either heated with hot stones from a fire, or in some places geothermal heat makes areas of ground naturally hot.

text: Hangi gantši e dirišwa go apea dijo tša setšo tša go mokgwa wa go gadikwa tša matena.
text_en: The hangi is often used to cook a traditional roast style dinner.

text: Mafelo a mmalwa go la Rotorua a abelana ka geothermal hangi, mola di hangi tše dingwe di ka bonwa go la Christchurch, Wellington le go gongwe.
text_en: Several places in Rotorua offer geothermal hangi, while other hangi can be sampled in Christchurch, Wellington and elsewhere.

text: MetroRail e na le maemo a mabedi go banamedi ba ditereni ka gare le tikologong ya Cape Town: MetroPlus (e bitšwa gape Maemo a Pele) le Metro (e bitšwa Maemo a Boraro).
text_en: MetroRail has two classes on commuter trains in and around Cape Town: MetroPlus (also called First Class) and Metro (called Third Class).

text: MetroPlus e iketlile kudu gape ga ya tlala efela e tura kudu gannyane, le ge e sa lefelega go feta dithekete tša metro ka Europe.
text_en: MetroPlus is more comfortable and less crowded but slightly more expensive, though still cheaper than normal metro tickets in Europe.

text: Setimela se sengwe le se sengwe se na le materokis a MetroPlus mmogo le Metrom; materokisi a MetroPlus a dula le kua morago ga setimela kgauswikgauswi le Cape Town.
text_en: Every train has both MetroPlus and Metro coaches; the MetroPlus coaches are always on the end of the train nearest Cape Town.

text: Go hlokomela ba bangwe - O se tlogele merwalo ya gago o sa e lebelela, kudu ge o tshela mellwane ya boditšhabatšhaba.
text_en: Carrying for others - Never let your bags out of your sight, especially when you are crossing international borders.

text: O ka ikhweša o šomišwa bjalo ka morwadi wa diokobatši ntle le tsebo ya gago, seo se ka go tsenya ka gare ga mathata a magolo kudu.
text_en: You could find yourself being used as a drug carrier without your knowledge, which will land you in a great deal of trouble.

text: Se se akaretša go ema laene, bjale ka ge dimpšha tša go nkgelela diokobatši di ka šomišwa nako yengwe le yengwe ntle le go lemoga.
text_en: This includes waiting in line, as drug-sniffing dogs could be used at any time without notice.

text: Dinaga tše dingwe di na le dikotlo tše šorošoro le go ditshenyo tša mathomo; tše di ka akaretša dikatlolo tša go feta mengwaga ye 10 tša go ya kgolegong goba lehu.
text_en: Some countries have exceedingly draconian punishments even for first time offenses; these can include prison sentences of over 10 years or death.

text: Mekotla ya go se elwe šedi ke yeo e lebeletšwego gore e ka utšwiwa gomme gape e ka goga mahlo go tšwa go bamolao bao ba hlokomologago ditšhošetši tša dithuthupi.
text_en: Unattended bags are a target for theft and can also attract attention from authorities wary of bomb threats.

text: Ka gae, ka baka la go pepentšwa ga go se fela go ditwatši tša gae, kgonagalo di godimo kudu gore o ka ba o šetše o se sa lwatša ke tšona.
text_en: At home, due to this constant exposure to the local germs, odds are very high that you're already immune to them.

text: Efela ka gare ga dikarolo tše dingwe tša lefase, moo fauna ya paketheria e lego ye ntshwa go wena, o kgauswi kudu le go kopana le mathata.
text_en: But in other parts of the world, where the bacteriological fauna are new to you, you're far more likely to run into problems.
