text: Gape, maemong a boso a go ruthelanyana dibaketeria di gola gape le go phela nako ye telele ka ntla ga mmele.
text_en: Also, in warmer climates bacteria both grow more quickly and survive longer outside the body.

text: Kafao dikotlo tša Delhi Belly, Thogako ya Pharaoh, Tefeletšo ya Montezuma, le bagwera ba bona ba bantši.
text_en: Thus the scourges of Delhi Belly, the Pharaoh's Curse, Montezuma's Revenge, and their many friends.

text: Bjalo ka mathata a go hema ka gare ga maemo a leratadima a go tonya, mathata a mala ka gare ga maemo a leratadima a tloga a tlwaelegile gomme dinakong tše dintši a šišimiša efela ga a tloge a le kotsi.
text_en: As with respiratory problems in colder climates, intestinal problems in hot climates are fairly common and in most cases are distinctly annoying but not really dangerous.

text: Ge o etetše naga yeo e sa tšwelagopele bakeng la mathomo - goba karolong ye ntsa ya lefase - o se ke wa nyatša go makala ga setšo go go ka bago gona.
text_en: If traveling in a developing country for the first time – or in a new part of the world – don't underestimate the potential culture shock.

text: Bontši bja baeti bao ba sa fetogego ba fentšwe ke boswa bja boeti bja naga bjoo bo tšwelago pele, moo diphetogo tše nnyane tša setšo di ka tlaleletšago ka pela.
text_en: Many a stable, capable traveler has been overcome by the newness of developing world travel, where many little cultural adjustments can add up quickly.

text: Kudu matšatšing a gago a pele, nagana go šomiša mašeleng a gago go mekgwa ya setoropong le dihotele tša maemo, dijo tša maemo, le ditirelo tša maemo go thuša go tlwaela.
text_en: Especially in your initial days, consider splurging on Western-style and -quality hotels, food, and services to help acclimatize.

text: O se ke wa robala godimo ga leterase goba sa go ala fase mafelong ao o sa tsebego dimela le diphoofolo tša ona.
text_en: Do not sleep on a mattress or pad on the ground in areas where you do not know the local fauna.

text: Ge e ba o tlo kampa ka ntle, e tla le koto ya go ya kampeng goba hammock go go bea kgole le dinoga, diphephen le tše bjalo.
text_en: If you are going to camp out, bring a camp cot or hammock to keep you away from snakes, scorpions and such.

text: Tlatša legae la gago ka kofi ya go topela mesong le teye ya chamomile mantšiboa.
text_en: Fill your home with a rich coffee in the morning and some relaxing chamomile tea at night.

text: Ge o le madulong a maikhutšo, o na le nako ya go ihlokomela le go tšea metsotso ye mengwe ye mmalwa go bediša se sengwe sa makgethe.
text_en: When you're on a staycation, you have the time to treat yourself and take a few extra minutes to brew up something special.

text: Ge e ba o ikwela o na le sebete, tšea monyetla wa go gamola goba go šilantša dino tša boreledi:
text_en: If you're feeling more adventurous, take the opportunity to juice or blend up some smoothies:

text: Mohlomongwe o tla hwetša seno se bonolo seo o ka se dirago ka nako ya dijo tša difihlollo ge o boetše tshepedišong ya gago.
text_en: maybe you'll discover a simple beverage that you can make for breakfast when you're back to your daily routine.

text: Ge o dula motseng wa go ba le setšo sa nwa sa go fapanafapana, sepela dipareng goba dipubong tša metseng ya kgauswi tšeo o sa yego gantši.
text_en: If you live in a city with a varied drinking culture, go to bars or pubs in neighborhoods you don't frequent.

text: Bakeng sa bao ba sa tlwaelago leleme la tša dihlare, mantšu a go tšelega le go fetela a na le phapano ya dihlaloso.
text_en: For those unfamiliar with medical jargon, the words infectious and contagious have distinct meanings.

text: Bolwetši bja go fetela ke boo bo hlotšwego ke twatši, bjalo ka kokwanahloko, bakteriam, fungus goba diphelakadingwe tše dingwe.
text_en: An infectious disease is one that is caused by a pathogen, such as a virus, bacterium, fungus or other parasites.

text: Bolwetši bja go fetela ke bolwetši bjoo bo fetelanago ga bonolo ka go ba kgauswi le motho yoo a tšetšwego.
text_en: A contagious disease is a disease which is easily transmitted by being in the vicinity of an infected person.

text: Mebušo ye mentši e nyaka gore baeti bao ba tsenago, goba badudi bao ba tlogago dinageng tša bona ba hlabelwe ka moento wa malwetši a go fapana.
text_en: Many governments require visitors entering, or residents leaving, their countries to be vaccinated for a range of diseases.

text: Dinyakwa tše gantši di ka ya le gore ke dinaga dife tšeo moeti a di etetšego goba tšeo a ikemišeditšego go di etela.
text_en: These requirements may often depend on what countries a traveller has visited or intends to visit.

text: Bo tee bja mabokgoni a Charlotte, North Carolina, ke gore e na le bontši bja dikgetho tša maemo a godimo tša malapa.
text_en: One of strong points of Charlotte, North Carolina, is that it has an abundance of high-quality options for families.

text: Badudi ba go tšwa mafelong a mangwe gantši ba bolela ge bogwera bja malapa e le lebaka le legolo la go hudugela moo, baeng gantši ba hwetša motse o le bonolo go ipšhina ka wona le bana ba le gona.
text_en: Residents from other areas often cite family-friendliness as a primary reason for moving there, and visitors often find the city easy to enjoy with children around.

text: Mengwageng ye 20 ya go feta, bontši bja dikgetho tša go ba gabotse go bana go la Uptown Charlotte go gotše kudukudu.
text_en: In the past 20 years, the amount of child-friendly options in Uptown Charlotte has grown exponentially.

text: Ditekisi ga di tloge di šomišwa ke malapa go la Charlotte, le ge di ka ba le mohula o itšego maemong a mangwe.
text_en: Taxis are not generally used by families in Charlotte, though they can be of some use in certain circumstances.

text: Go na le tefedišo ya godimo bakeng sa go ba le banamedi ba go feta 2, kafao kgetho ye e ka ba ya tefelo ya godimo go feta ka moo go hlokegago.
text_en: There is a surcharge for having more than 2 passengers, so this option might be more expensive than necessary.

text: Antarctia ke lefelo la go tonya kudukudu mo Lefaseng, gomme le dukulogile South Pole.
text_en: Antarctica is the coldest place on Earth, and surrounds the South Pole.

text: Maeto a baeti a bitša, a nyaka go emega go gobotse ga mmele, go ka tšeakarolo fela ka selemo Nov-Feb, gomme bontši a beetšwe go la Peninsula, Dihlakahlaka le Lewatle la Ross.
text_en: Tourist visits are costly, demand physical fitness, can only take place in summer Nov-Feb, and are largely limited to the Peninsula, Islands and Ross Sea.

text: Bašomi ba dikete tše mmalwa ba dula mo ka selemo ka dikgaolo tše nne gantši ditulong tšeo; nomoro ye nnyane e dula ka marega.
text_en: A couple of thousand staff live here in summer in some four dozen bases mostly in those areas; a small number stay over winter.

text: Nagabogare ya Antarctica ke lešope la mmoto la go akaretšwa ke 2-3km ya aese.
text_en: Inland Antarctica is a desolate plateau covered by 2-3 km of ice.

text: Boeti bja moyeng bja ditsebi bja Lebakanyana bo ya nageng, go namela thaba goba go fihla Pole, moo go nago le motheo o mogolo.
text_en: Occasional specialist air tours go inland, for mountaineering or to reach the Pole, which has a large base.

text: South Pole Traverse (goba Highway) e šaletše morago ga 1600 km go tšwa Setišing sa McMurdo go la Ross Sea go ya Pole.
text_en: The South Pole Traverse (or Highway) is a 1600 km trail from McMurdo Station on the Ross Sea to the Pole.

text: Ke lehlwa la go tlalelana le maope a go tlala ka le go marakiwa ka difolaga. E ka sepelwa fela ka diterekere tša go ikgetha, dikoloyana tša go sepela lehlweng tša go ba le makhura le dilo.
text_en: It's compacted snow with crevasses filled in and marked by flags. It can only be traveled by specialized tractors, hauling sleds with fuel and supplies.

text: Tše ga di tloge di le bonolo ka fao mohlala o swanetše go fapogela go ya go dukuluga Transantarctic Mountains go fihla go nagagodimong.
text_en: These aren't very nimble so the trail has to take a long swerve around the Transantarctic Mountains to come onto the plateau.

text: Hlolo ya go tlwaelega bakeng sa dikotsi ka maregaa ke mebila ya go redimoša, dipabemente (bosepelelo bja ka mathoko) kudu distepes.
text_en: The most common cause for accidents in winter is slippery roads, pavements (sidewalks) and especially steps.

text: Ka bonnyane, o hloka dieta tša go ba le solo ya maleba. Dieta tša Selemo gantši di a redimuša godimo ga aese le lehlwa, le diputsu tše dingwe tša marega ga di a lekana.
text_en: At a minimum, you need footwear with suitable soles. Summer shoes are usually very slippery on ice and snow, even some winter boots are deficient.

text: Mosego o swanetše go subelela go lekanego, 5 mm (1/5 inch) goba go feta, gomme di dirišwa di be bonolo go lekanego dithemphereitšhara tša go tonya.
text_en: The pattern should be deep enough, 5 mm (1/5 inch) or more, and the material soft enough in cold temperatures.

text: Diputso tše dingwe di na le dikopopi gomme gona le di dirišwa tša tlaleletšo tša goba le dikopi bakeng sa maemo a go redimoša, di loketše dieta le diputso tše dintši, direthe goba direthe le solo.
text_en: Some boots have studs and there is studded add-on equipment for slippery conditions, suitable for most shoes and boots, for the heels or heels and sole.

text: Meboto e swanetše go ba fase gomme e bulede. Santa, lekgwara goba letswai (calcium chloride) gantši di patlalatšwa ditseleng goba ditsejana go kaonafatša tsepetšo.
text_en: Heels should be low and wide. Sand, gravel or salt (calcium chloride) is often scattered on roads or paths to improve traction.

text: Maphoto a lehlwa ga se seo se sa tlwaelegago; mafelo a go rotogela a ka kgona go swara go nanya go go kalo, gomme dibolumu tša bontši di tla kgokologa bjalo ka maphoto a lehlwa.
text_en: Avalanches are not an abnormality; steep slopes can hold only so much slow, and the excess volumes will come down as avalanches.

text: Bothata ke gore lehlwa le a kgomarela, ka fao le hloka sekgorometše gore se tle, gomme lehlwa le lengwe la go theogela fase e ka ba sekgorometše go se sengwe.
text_en: The problem is that snow is sticky, so it needs some triggering to come down, and some snow coming down can be the triggering event for the rest.

text: Ka dinako tše dingwe maemo a go thakgoša ke letšatši ge le thutetša lehlwa, ka nako tše dingwe go wa lehlwa le lengwe gape, nako tše dingwe ditiragalo tše dingwe tša hlago, gantši batho.
text_en: Sometimes the original trigging event is the sun warming the snow, sometimes some more snowfall, sometimes other natural events, often a human.

text: Ledimo la sesasedi ke go dikologa ga kholomo ya kgatelelo ya fase ya moya, yeo e gogelago moya wa kgauswi ka gare le go ya godimo.
text_en: A tornado is a spinning column of very low-pressure air, which sucks the surrounding air inward and upward.

text: Di tšweletša memoya ya godimo (gantši dimile/iri tše 100-200) gomme di ka kgona go phagamiša dili tša boima, go di rwala bjale ka ge ledimo le legolo la pula le šuta.
text_en: They generate high winds (often 100-200 miles/hour) and can lift heavy objects into the air, carrying them as the tornado moves.

text: Di thoma bjalo ka di fanele go tšwa godimo go maru a ledimo, gomme dia ba "ditornadoe" ge di kgoma fase.
text_en: They begin as funnels descending from storm clouds, and become "tornadoes" when they touch the ground.

text: Baabi ba VPN (virtual private network) ya motho ka noši ke tsela ye kaone ya go kgaotša bobedi tšhiretšo ya sepolotiki le IP-geofiltering ya thekišo.
text_en: Personal VPN (virtual private network) providers are an excellent way of circumventing both political censorship and commercial IP-geofiltering.

text: Ke tše dikgolo go di proxy tše di wepesate bakeng sa mabaka a mmalwa: Di boetša moelo o montši wa inthanete, e sego fela di http.
text_en: They are superior to web proxies for several reasons: They re-route all Internet traffic, not only http.

text: Gantši di abelana ka bendwith ya godimo le tirelo ye kaone ya go tia. Di tšhireleditšwe gomme kafao ga di bonolo go di hlolela.
text_en: They normally offer higher bandwidth and better quality of service. They are encrypted and thus harder to spy on.

text: Dikhamphane tša ditaba gantši di bolela maaka ka morero wa se, di re ke ka ga go "thibela go utswa".
text_en: The media companies routinely lie about the purpose of this, claiming that it is to "prevent piracy".

text: Go iša nneteng, dikhoutu tša tikologo ga di na tswaetšo le ga tee go godimo ga go kopisa ga go se be molaong; go kopisa diski ga nnyane-ga-nnyane go tla raloka gabotse godimo ga sedirišwa se sengwe le se sengwe moo ya nnete e ka ralokago.
text_en: In fact, region codes have absolutely no effect on illegal copying; a bit-for-bit copy of a disk will play just fine on any device where the original will.

text: Morero o mogolo ke go fa dikhampani tšeo taolo ya tlaleletšo godimo ga mebaraka ya bona; ke fela ka ga go dukuluša tšhelete.
text_en: The actual purpose is to give those companies more control over their markets; it's all about money spinning.

text: Ka baka la gore megala e sepetšwa ka lenaneo inthaneteng, ga go hlokagale gore o šomiše mogala wa khamphane yeo e hwetšagalago mo o dulago gona goba mo o etelago gona.
text_en: Because calls are routed over the Internet, you do not need to use a phone company located where you live or where you travel.

text: Ga gona hlokego ya gore o hwetše nomoro ya selegae go tšwa motseng wo o dulago go wona; o ka hwetša kgokaganyo ya inthanete ya satalaete dithokgwe tša Chicken, Alaska gomme wa kgetha nomoro yeo e bolelago gore o Arizona ya letšatši.
text_en: There is also no requirement that you obtain a local number from the community in which you live; you can obtain a satellite Internet connection in the wilds of Chicken, Alaska and select a number which claims you're in sunny Arizona.

text: Gantši, o swanetše o reke nomorofase theko yeo e dumelelago dillathekeng tša PSTN go go letšetša. Moo nomoro e tšwago go dira phapano go batho bao ba go letšetšago.
text_en: Often, you have to buy a global number separately that allows PSTN phones to call you. Where the number is from makes a difference for people calling you.

text: Di dirišwa tša nnete tša go fetolela sengwala - di dirišwa tšeo di nago le bokgoni bja go fetolela mafoko ka moka a sengwalwa go tšwa lelemeng le tee go ya go le lengwe.
text_en: Real-time text translator apps – applications that are capable of automatically translating whole segments of text from one language into another.

text: Tše dingwe tša di dirišwa ka gare ga sehlopa se di ka kgona go fetolela dingwalwa go ya go malelme a dinageng tša kantle godimo ga maswao goba dilo tše dingwe lefaseng la nnete ge modiriši a lebantša founo ya go hlalefa le selo seo.
text_en: Some of the applications in this category can even translate texts in foreign languages on signs or other objects in the real world when the user points the smartphone towards those objects.

text: Dientšene tša hlatollelaleme di kaonafetše kudu, gomme bjale di abelana a bo kudu goba bonnyane bja diphetoleloleme tša nnete thwii (gomme ga se gantši e le ditšeabadimo), efela hlokomelo e bohlokwa, ka ge di ka ba di sa phoša.
text_en: The translation engines have improved dramatically, and now often give more or less correct translations (and more seldom gibberish), but some care is due, as they still may have gotten it all wrong.

text: Ye tee ya di app tše bohlokwa kudu ke lebakeng le ke Google Translate, yeo e dumelelago phetolelo ya offline morago ga go download data ya leleme leo o le nyakago.
text_en: One of the most prominent apps in this category is Google Translate, which allows offline translation after downloading the desired language data.

text: Go diriša di dirišwa tša GPS godimo ga founo ya gago ye bohlale ekaba tsela ye bonolonolo ya ka pela go hwetša tsela ge o tšwele nageng ya geno.
text_en: Using GPS navigation apps on your smartphone can be the easiest and most convenient way to navigate when out of your home country.

text: E ka boloka tšhelete go feta go reka mebepe ye mefsa bakeng sa GPS, goba sedirišwa seo se ikemego sa GPS goba go hira se sengwe go tšwa go khamphani ya go hiriša dikoloi.
text_en: It can save money over buying new maps for a GPS, or a standalone GPS device or renting one from a car rental company.

text: Ge o se na kgokaganyo ya inthanete bakeng sa founo ya gago, goba ge e le kgole le kgokaganyo, go šoma ga tšona go ka fokotšega goba gwa se be gona.
text_en: If you don't have a data connection for your phone, or when it is out of range, their performance can be limited or unavailable.

text: Lebenkele le lengwe le lengwe la sekhutlong le tletše ka dikarata tša megala ya go patelwaya tša go gakantša tšeo di ka dirišwago go tšwa megaleng ya go lefelwa goba megaleng ya go tlwaelegwa.
text_en: Every corner store is filled with a confusing array of pre-paid phone cards that can be used from pay phones or ordinary telephones.

text: Le dikarata tše dintši di loketše go leletša go gongwe le go gongwe, tše dingwe di na le bokgoni bja go aba ditefo tša megala tše dikaone go dihlopha tše di itšego tša dinaga.
text_en: While most cards are good for calling anywhere, some specialise in providing favourable call rates to specific groups of countries.

text: Go hwetšagala ga ditirelo tše gantši go ba ka mokgwa wa go letšetša nomoro ya mogala ya mahala yeo e ka letšetšwago go tšwa megaleng ye mentši ntle le tefelo.
text_en: Access to these services is often through a toll-free telephone number that can be called from most phones without charge.

text: Melao ka ga go tšea diswantšho gantši e ba gona le ka go gatišeng dibidio, mohlomongwe le go feta.
text_en: Rules regarding regular photography also apply to video recording, possibly even more so.

text: Ge e ba go no tšea senepe sa se sengwe ga go a dumelelwa, gona o se ke wa ba wa nagana ka go gatiša bedio ya yona.
text_en: If just taking a photo of something isn't allowed, then you shouldn't even think of recording a video of it.

text: Ge o šomiša setšeadiswantšho sa go fofa (drone), lekodišiša gabotse pele gore ke eng seo o dumeletšwego go se gatiša le gore ke ditumelelo dife goba dilaesense tša tlaleletšo  tšeo di hlokagalago.
text_en: If using a drone, check well in advance as to what you are allowed to film and what permits or additional licensing are required.

text: Go fofiša drone kgauswi le boemafofane goba ka godimo ga lešaba e dula e le mogopolo wa go se loke, le ge e se yeo e sego molaong tikologong ya geno.
text_en: Flying a drone near an airport or over a crowd is almost always a bad idea, even if it's not illegal in your area.

text: Matšatši a bjale boeti bja moyeng ga bo kgethwe kudu ka sefofane ntle le go lekola pele le go bapetša ditefelo.
text_en: Nowadays air travel is only rarely booked directly through the airline without first searching and comparing prices.

text: Ka dinako tše dingwe sefofane se tee se ka ba le ditefelo tša go fapana kudu mafelong a go fapana gomme go a patela go bapetša dipoelo tša go hlola le go lebelela wepesaete ya lekala la sefofane pele ga ge o beela ka thoko.
text_en: Sometimes the same flight can have vastly differing prices at various agregators and it pays to compare search results and to also look at the website of the airline itself before booking.

text: Le ge o ka se hloke visa bakeng sa ketelo ye kopana go ya dinageng tše dingwe bjalo ko moeti goba bakeng sa tša kgwebo, go ya moo bjalo ka moithuti wa go tšwa ka ntle ka kakaretšo go hloka ketelo ye teletšana go feta ge o le moeti wa go tlwaelega.
text_en: While you may not need a visa for short visits to certain countries as a tourist or for business, going there as an international student generally requires a longer stay than going there just as a casual tourist.

text: Ka kakaretšo, go dula ka nageng ya ka ntle nako ye telele go tla nyaka gore o hwetše visa e sa le nako.
text_en: In general, staying in any foreign country for an extended period of time will require you to obtain a visa in advance.

text: Divisa tša baithuti ka kakaretšo di na le dinyakwa tšeo difapafapanego le ditshepedišo tša kgopelo go tšwa go divisa tša boeti ba go tlwaelega goba tša kgwebo.
text_en: Student visas generally have different requirements and application procedures from normal tourist or business visas.

text: Bakeng sa dinaga tše ntši, o tla hloka go abelana ka lengwalo la lefelo leo o ratago go ithutela go lona, gape le bohlatse bja tšhelete ya go ihlokomela bakeng sa bonnyane bja ngwaga wa mathomo wa thuto ya gago.
text_en: For most countries, you will need an offer letter from the institution you wish to study at, and also evidence of funds to support yourself for at least the first year of your course.

text: Ikopanye le sehlongwa, gammogo le kgoro ya bofaladi mabapi le naga yeo o ratago go ithutela go yona go hwetša dinyakwa.
text_en: Check with the institution, as well as the immigration department for the country you wish to study in for detailed requirements.

text: Ntle ga ge o le motseta, go šoma mošamawatle ka kakaretšo go bolela gore o tla swanelwa ke go ingwaditšetša motšhelo wa letseno nageng yeo o lego go yona.
text_en: Unless you are a diplomat, working overseas generally means that you will have to file income tax in the country you are based in.

text: Motšhelo wa letseno o beakantšwe ka mo go fapafapanego dinageng tša go fapafapana, gomme dipeelo tša motšhelo di fapafapana kudu go tšwa nageng ye ngwe go ya go ye nwge.
text_en: Income tax is structured differently in different countries, and the tax rates and brackets vary widely from one country to another.

text: Dinaga tše dingwe tša pušo, bjalo ka United States le Canada, motšhelo wa letseno o lefišwa bobedi maemong a mmušo le maemo a gae, ka gona ditekanyo le maswaodikga di ka fapana go ya ka dilete.
text_en: In some federal countries, such as the United States and Canada, income tax is levied both at the federal level and at the local level, so the rates and brackets can vary from region to region.

text: Le ge go hlola ga go tsena ka nageng ka mehla go dula go se gona goba semmušo ge o tsena ka nageng ya geno, bolaodi bja merwalo go ka ba boima.
text_en: While immigration check is usually absent or a formality when you arrive in your homeland, customs control can be a hassle.

text: Netefatša gore o tseba seo o ka se tlišago le seo o ka se se tlišego gomme o ikane ka se sengwe le se sengwe magomong a molao.
text_en: Make sure you know what you can and cannot bring in and declare anything over the legal limits.

text: Tsela ye bonolonolo ya go thoma ka gare ga kgwebo ya bongwadi bja tša maeto ke go loutša makgoni a gago godimo ga wepesate ya dingwalwa tša maeto.
text_en: The easiest way to get started in the business of travel writing is to hone your skills on an established travel blog website.

text: Ka morago ga gore o tlwaele go beakanya le go rulaganya mo wepeng, ka moragonyana, o ka itirela weposaete ya gago.
text_en: After you become comfortable with formatting and editing on the web, then later, you might create your own website.

text: Go ithaopa mola o ile maetong ke tsela ye botse ya go dira phapano efela ga se ka  go fa fela.
text_en: Volunteering while travelling is a great way to make a difference but it's not just about giving.

text: Go dula le go ithaopa nageng ya ka ntle ke tsela ye botse ya go tseba ditšo tša go fapana, go kopana le batho ba baswa, go ithuta ka wena, go hwetša mokgwa wa kgopolo le go hwetša mabokgoni a maswa.
text_en: Living and volunteering in a foreign country is a great way to get to know a different culture, meet new people, learn about yourself, get a sense of perspective and even gain new skills.

text: E ka ba tsela ye botse ya go tlaramolotša mašeleng go dumelela go dula go go teletšana go gongwe ka ge mešomo ye mentši ya boithaopi e abelana ka phapoši le dijo gomme ye mmalwa e lefela mogolo o mo nnyane.
text_en: It can also be a good way to stretch a budget to allow a longer stay somewhere since many volunteer jobs provide room and board and a few pay a small salary.

text: Madira a ka meetseng a šomišitše ditsela tša meetse tša ma-Russia go fihla Lewatleng le Leso le Lewatleng la Caspain. Dikarolo tše dingwe tša ditsela tše di ka dirišwa le ga bjale. Hlola kgonagalo ya tumelelo ya makgehte, yeo e ka bago boima go e hwetša.
text_en: Vikings used the Russian waterways to get to the Black Sea and Caspian Sea. Parts of these routes can still be used. Check possible need for special permits, which may be difficult to get.

text: White Sea–Baltic Canal e kgokagantša Arctic Ocean go ya Baltic Sea, ka Lake Onega, Lake Ladoga le Saint Petersburg, kudu ka dinoka le matsha.
text_en: The White Sea–Baltic Canal connects the Arctic Ocean to the Baltic Sea, via Lake Onega, Lake Ladoga and Saint Petersburg, mostly by rivers and lakes.

text: Letsha la Onega le kgomagane gape le Volga, ka fao go tšwa Lewatle la Caspian go ya Russia go sa kgonega.
text_en: Lake Onega is also connected to Volga, so coming from the Caspian Sea through Russia is still possible.

text: Netefaletšega gore ka morago ga go fihla boemakepe dilo ka moka di tla ba molaleng. O tla kopana le ba bangwe ba go kgopela go namela dikepe tša babangwe gomme ba tla abelana le wena tsebišo ya bona.
text_en: Be assured that once you hit the marinas everything will be pretty obvious. You will meet other boat hitchhikers and they will share their information with you.

text: Gabotse o tla ba o bea ditsebišo tša go abelana ka thušo ya gago, o ya godimo le fase, o lata batho o hlwekiša dikepe tša bona, o leka go dira boikgokaganyi le boradikepe ka bareng, bjbj.
text_en: Basically you'll be putting up notices offering your help, pacing the docks, approaching people cleaning their yachts, trying to make contact with sailors in the bar, etc.

text: Leka go bolela le batho ba bantši ka moo go kgonegago. Ka morago ga sebaka batho ka moka ba tla go tseba gomme ba tla gofa dintlha gore ke sekepe sefe seo se nyakago motho.
text_en: Try to talk to as many people as possible. After a while everyone will know you and will give you hints as to which boat is looking for someone.

text: O swanetše go kgetha lekala la gago la difofane la go Fofa Gantši ka gare ga bothekgane gabotse.
text_en: You should choose your Frequent Flyer airline in an alliance carefully.

text: Le ge o ka nagana gore ke tšotšometšo go tsenela lekala la sefofane seo o fofago ka sona gantši, o swanetše o lemoge gore mephutso yeo e abelwago gantši ea fapana gomme dintlha tša go fofa kgafetša di ka ba kaone ka fase ga lekala la sefofane sa go ba ka gare ga mokgahlo o tee.
text_en: Although you may think it is intuitive to join the airline you fly most, you should be aware that privileges offered are often different and frequent flyer points may be more generous under a different airline in the same alliance.

text: Difofane tše bjalo ka Emirates, Etihad Airways, Qatar Airways & Turkish Airways di godišitše ditirelo tša tšona kudu go Afrika, gomme di abelana ka kgokaganyo go ya ditoropong tše dikgolo tša Afrika tše ntši ka ditefelo tše kaone go feta difofane tša Yuropa.
text_en: Airlines such as Emirates, Etihad Airways, Qatar Airways & Turkish Airlines have greatly expanded their services to Africa, and offer connections to many major African cities at competitive rates than other European airlines.

text: Makala a Difofane tša Turkey a fofela go ya mafelong a 39 dinageng tše 30 tša Afrika go tloga ka 2014.
text_en: Turkish Airlines flies to 39 destinations in 30 African countries as of 2014.

text: Ge o na le nako ya tlaleletšo ya go etela, hlola gore palomoka ya tefelo ya gago ya go ya Afrika e bapetšega bjang le tefelo ya go ralala lefase.
text_en: If you have additional travel time, check to see how your total fare quote to Africa compares with a round-the-world fare.

text: O se lebala go tlaleletša ditefelo tša tlaleletšo tša di-visa tša tlaleletšo, metšhelo ya go sepela, dinamelwa tša fase, bjbj. tša mafelo ao kamoka a ka ntle ga Afrika.
text_en: Don't forget to add in the extra costs of additional visas, departure taxes, ground transportation, etc. for all those places outside of Africa.

text: Ge e ba o nyaka go fofa go dukuluga lefase ka botlalo Karolong ya Borwa, kgetho ya difofane le mafelo ke ye nnyane ka baka la go hlokega ga ditsela tša go feta ka godimo ga lewatle.
text_en: If you want to fly around the world completely in the Southern Hemisphere, the choice of flights and destinations is limited due to the lack of transoceanic routes.

text: Ga gona lekgotla la difofane leo le akaretšago ditshelaganyo tše tharo tša lewatle ka gare ga seripa sa lefelo la Borwa (gomme SkyTeam ga se akaretša le ye tee ya ditshelaganyo tše).
text_en: No airline alliance covers all three ocean crossings in the Southern Hemisphere (and SkyTeam covers none of the crossings).

text: Efela, Star Alliance e gokaretša tšohle ntle le Pacific ya bodikela bja Borwa go tšwa Santiago de Chile go ya Tahiti, yeo e lego sefofane sa LATAM Oneworld.
text_en: However, Star Alliance covers everything except the eastern South Pacific from Santiago de Chile to Tahiti, which is a LATAM Oneworld flight.

text: Sefofane se ga se sona kgetho fela ge o nyaka go tshela Borwa bja Phasifiki le bodikela bja lebopo la Borwa bja Amerika. (bona ka fase)
text_en: This flight is not the only option if you want to skip the South Pacific and the west coast of South America. (see below)

text: Ka 1994, selete sa morafe wa maAmeniya Nagorno-Karabakh sa go la Azerbaijan se ile sa thoma ntwa gahlanong le maAzeri.
text_en: In 1994, the ethnically Armenian Nagorno-Karabakh region of Azerbaijan waged war against the Azeris.

text: Ka thekgo ya Armenia, rephapoliki ye mfsa e dirilwe. Efela, ga go naga yeo e hlomamišitšwego - le ge e le Armenia - e e lemoga semmušo.
text_en: With Armenian backing, a new republic was created. However, no established nation - not even Armenia - officially recognizes it.

text: Dingangišano tša ditherišano ka selete di tšwelapele go dikamano tša mar gare ga Armenia le Azerbaijan.
text_en: Diplomatic arguments over the region continue to mar relations between Armenia and Azerbaijan.

text: Canal District (Dutch: Grachtengordel) ke lefelo la go tuma la ngwagakgolo wa bo 17 go dukuluga Binnenstad ya Amsterdam.
text_en: The Canal District (Dutch: Grachtengordel) is the famous 17th-century district surrounding the Binnenstad of Amsterdam.

text: Selete ka moka se betšwe bjalo ka Lefelo la Bohwa bja Lefase la UNESCO bakeng sa setšo sa go ikgetha le boleng bja histori tša lona, gomme boleng bja thoto ba yona ke bo bongwe ba goba godimo ka nageng.
text_en: The whole district is designated as a UNESCO World Heritage Site for its unique cultural and historical value, and its property values are among the highest of the country.

text: Cinque Terre, yeo e bolelago gore Dinaga tše Hlano, e na le dinaga tša lebopong tše dinnyane tše hlano tša Riomaggiore, Manarola, Corniglia, Vernazza le Monterosso tšeo di lego seleteng sa Italy sa Liguria.
text_en: Cinque Terre, which means Five Lands, comprises the five small coastal villages of Riomaggiore, Manarola, Corniglia, Vernazza and Monterosso located in the Italian region of Liguria.

text: Di ngwadilwe godimo ga lelokelo la Bohwa bja Lefase la UNESCO.
text_en: They are listed on the UNESCO World Heritage List.

text: Go feta mengwagakgolo, batho ba agile merara mafelong a go theogela mebotong yeo e lego pele ga dinoka.
text_en: Over the centuries, people have carefully built terraces on the rugged, steep landscape right up to the cliffs that overlook the sea.

text: Karolo ye bobotse bja yona e hloka mokgahlo woo o bonalago wa tšwelopele. Ditsela, diterene le dikepe di kopanya dinagamagae, gomme disafatanaga di ka se di fihlelele go tšwa ka ntle.
text_en: Part of its charm is the lack of visible corporate development. Paths, trains and boats connect the villages, and cars cannot reach them from the outside.

text: Melolelwana ya go fapafapana ya se-French yoo e bolelwago ka Belgium le Switzerland e fapana gannyane go tšwa go se-French seo se bolalwago ka France, le ge e tswana go lekanego gore e ka nyalelana.
text_en: The varieties of French which are spoken in Belgium and Switzerland differ slightly from the French spoken in France, though they are similar enough to be mutually intelligible.

text: Kudu-kudu, tshepedišo ya dinomoro go la Belgium yeo go bolelwago se-French le Switzerland e na le dika tše dingwe tše itšego tše kgethegilego tša go fapana go tšwa go se-Freche seo se bolelwago go la France, gomme ka moo mantšu a mangwe a bitšwago ka gona go fapana ga nnyane.
text_en: In particular, the numbering system in French-speaking Belgium and Switzerland has some slight peculiarities that are different from the French spoken in France, and the pronunciation of some words is slightly different.

text: Le ge go le bjalo, ma-Belgian le ma-Swiss kamoka a go bolela leleme la se-French ba kabe ba ithutile French sekolong, gore ba kgone go go kwešiša le ge e le gore o šomišitše mokgwa wa French wa go balela.
text_en: Nevertheless, all French-speaking Belgians and Swiss would have learned standard French in school, so they would be able to understand you even if you used the standard French numbering system.

text: Dikarolong tše dintši tša lefase, go huduwa letsogo ke se šupo sa segwera, sešupo sa "dumela."
text_en: In many parts of the world, waving is a friendly gesture, indicating "hello."

text: Efela, go la Malaysia, bonnyane gare ga ma Malays dinagamagaeng, se bolela gore "etla," go tswana le monwana wa go šupa ge o kobetšwe go iša mmeleng, se šupo seo se dirišwago mafelong a dinaga tše dingwe go la Bodikela, gomme se swanetše go dirišwa bakeng sa seo fela.
text_en: However, in Malaysia, at least among the Malays in rural areas, it means "come over," similar to the index finger bent toward the body, a gesture which is used in certain Western countries, and should be used only for that purpose.

text: Ka go tswana, moeti wa mo-Britain go la Spain a ka tšea go laelwa ga go hwidihwitša letsogo moyeng ga go ba le bokagare bja seatla go lebeletše yoo a laelago (gona le motho yo a laelwago) bjalo ka seka sa gore a boele morago.
text_en: Similarly, a British traveller in Spain may mistake a wave goodbye involving the palm facing the waver (rather than the person being waved at) as a gesture to come back.

text: Maleme a bodulamadibogo ke a go se be a nnete goba maleme a go agwa a go dirwa ka morero wa go nolofatša poledišano magareng ga batho bao ka mehla ba ka bago le bothata bja go boledišana.
text_en: Auxiliary languages are artificial or constructed languages created with the intent of facilitating communication between peoples who would otherwise have difficulty communicating.

text: Di arogane go tšwa go di lingua franca, tšeo e lego dipolelo tša hlago goba tša nnete tšeo di tumilego bakeng sa lebaka le tee goba le lengwe bjalo ka mokgwa wa poledišano gare ga diboledi tša maleme a mangwe.
text_en: They are separate from lingua francas, which are natural or organic languages that become dominant for one reason or another as means of communication between speakers of other languages.

text: Ka gare ga phišo ya letšatši, baeti ba ka itemogela pono yeo e ba dirago gore ba bone tše nkego ba bona meetse (goba dilo tše dingwe).
text_en: In the heat of the day, travelers can experience mirages that give the illusion of water (or other things).

text: Tše di ka ba kotsi ge eba moeti a ka šala tsela ya bodutu morago, a senya mafolofolo a makgethe le meetse ao a šetšego.
text_en: These can be dangerous if the traveler pursue the mirage, wasting precious energy and remaining water.

text: Le maganata a go fiša kudu a ka tonya kudu bošego. Dithemphereitšhara tša mmele tša fase kudu ke kotsi kudu ntle le diaparo tša borutho.
text_en: Even the hottest of deserts can become extremely cold at night. Hypothermia is a real risk without warm clothing.

text: Ka selemo, kudu, o tla hloka go hlokomela menang ge e ba o kgetha go tšea leeto la maoto le letelele sethokgweng.
text_en: In summer, especially, you'll need to watch out for mosquitoes if you decide to hike through the rainforest.

text: Gaešita le ge o otlela sethokgweng sa pula e ntshi sa go ruthela, metsotso ye mmalwa ka mabati ao a butšwego ge o tsena ka gare ga sefatanaga ke nako yeo e lekanego ya gore menang e tsene ka gare ga sefatanaga le wena.
text_en: Even if you're driving through the subtropical rainforest, a few seconds with the doors open while you get inside the vehicle is enough time for mosquitoes to get in the vehicle with you.

text: Mpšhikela wa dinonyane, goba ka semmušo avian influenza, o ka tšhela dinonyane gammogo le batho.
text_en: Bird flu, or more formally avian influenza, can infect both birds and mammals.

text: Dipego tša ka fasana ga sekete di begilwe bathong, efela tše dingwe tša tšona di bile kotsi kudu.
text_en: Fewer than a thousand cases have ever been reported in humans, but some of them have been fatal.

text: Bontši bo akareditše batho bao ba šomago ka dikgogo, efela go na le dikotsi tše dingwe gape go bahlokomedi ba dinonyana.
text_en: Most have involved people who work with poultry, but there is also some risk to birdwatchers.

text: Go tlwaelegile go la Norway ke ditsejana tša ka gare ga meboto le meedi yeo ka pela e fago tsela go nagadimo ya go ba godimo, kudu goba ga nnyane.
text_en: Typical for Norway are steep fjords and valleys that suddenly give way to a high, more or less even plateau.

text: Dinagagodimo tše gantši di bitšwa bjalo ka "vidde" go go bolelago gore lefelo la bophara, la go bulega ga go hloka mehlare, molala wa go hloka magomo.
text_en: These plateaus are often referred to as "vidde" meaning a wide, open treeless space, a boundless expanse.

text: Go la Rogaland le Agder di bitšwa "hei" seo se rago re mohlaka wa go hloka mehlare woo gantši o khupeditšwego ke heather.
text_en: In Rogaland and Agder they are usually called "hei" meaning a treeless moorland often covered in heather.

text: Meela-kgapetla ga ea tsepama, efela e theogela fase go tšwa tabeng. Se se tla dira go pharoga, meepo, yeo e ka thibjwago ke magora a lehlwa.
text_en: The glaciers are not stable, but flow down the mountain. This will cause cracks, crevasses, which may be obscured by snow bridges.

text: Maboto le dihlaka tša mawa a lehlwa a ka wa le go pharoga a ka tswalelwa.
text_en: The walls and roofs of ice caves can collapse and cracks can get closed.

text: Mafelelong a meelakgapetla makwate a magolo a ngwatega, a wela fase gomme mohlomongwe fofela goba go pšhikulogela pele kudu go tloga moo mathomong.
text_en: At the edge of glaciers huge blocks break loose, fall down and perhaps jump or roll farther from the edge.

text: Sehla sa boeti bakeng sa ditiši tša meboto gantši bo tlala ka nako ya selemo sa India.
text_en: The tourist season for the hill stations generally peaks during the Indian summer.

text: Efela, ba na le bo botse le bogogedi bjo fapanego ka nako ya marega, meboto e amogela lehlwa le le botse le lentši le go abelana ka mediro ya go swana le go fofa lehlweng le go kitima lehlweng.
text_en: However, they have a different kind of beauty and charm during winter, with many hill stations receiving healthy amounts of snow and offering activities such as skiing and snowboarding.

text: Ke difofane tše mmalwa fela tšeo di abago mašeleng a go hlokofalelwa, tšeo di išago fase gannyane ditshenyagalelo tša leeto la motsotso wa mafelelo bakeng sa poloko.
text_en: Only a few airlines still offer bereavement fares, which slightly discount the cost of last-minute funeral travel.

text: Difofane tšeo di abelanago ka tše diakaretša Air Canada, Delta Air Lines, Lufthansa bakeng sa difofane tša go tšwa go la U.S. goba Canada, le WestJet.
text_en: Airlines that offer these include Air Canada, Delta Air Lines, Lufthansa for flights originating from the U.S. or Canada, and WestJet.

text: Mabakeng ka moka, o swanetše o beakanye ka mogala thwii le khamphane ya sefofane.
text_en: In all cases, you must book by phone directly with the airline.
